rows.name: Sandwalkers - Prologue
rows.short_description: Sandwalkers is a roguelike turn-based strategy game. Convoy goods to neighboring tribes, build relationships, survive hostile creatures, and discover a new world. Inspired by great games like Wartales, Curious Expedition, or For The King.
rows.description_html: WIshlist the full game About the Game Introduction: Play as a new Caravan and discover one of your ancestors' secrets, which will rekindle the hope of ending the Phithi era someday. Every decade, the tree city of Lecwasi sends a caravan of merchants and diplomats into the Phithi, the meteorological chaos ravaging the world of Uwando. Convoy goods to neighboring tribes, build relationships, survive the creatures that roam around the Phithi, and collect memories of your journey to send to your successors. Features: Guide a caravan of adventurers through ever-changing landscapes. Tame hostile creatures, rescue refugees, seek allies for mutual aid, or follow the blood path and loot everything you can. Seek rich arable soil to plant a new tree city for your people. Progress by passing on your knowledge to a new caravan. Repair the broken climate, and put an end to centuries of wandering. Sandwalkers is made by the same studio as Legend of Keepers: Career of a Dungeon Manager. Games/Series that inspired us: HeroQuest (board game), La Horde du Contrevent (Windwalkers, a French book), Kaamelott (the best French series), Monty Python (English series), Dune. Video games that inspired us: Curious Expedition, Renowned Explorers, Trials of Fire, Darkest Dungeon, Slay the Spire, Final Fantasy, Divinity, For The King, Chroma Squad, Battle Brothers, West of Loathing, and many more. Sandwalkers Prologue is a free version of the game Sandwalkers . What is the difference from the previous 'Sandwalkers: The 14th Caravan'? This version focuses more on the gameplay, whereas the previous one introduced the narrative part.

rows.name: Escape from Hornhead
rows.short_description: Escape from Horn head is 3D horror game. You need to find the keys and potions before he catches up with you. Explore the rooms, look for objects and avoid the pursuer. Try to find the best way, remember the movement of the Horned-headed demon chasing its victim, that is, you.
rows.description_html: Escape from Horn head A game 'find a way out of the room'-like, for those who love the horror genre. You are being chased by a Hornhead. You need to find the keys and potions before he catches up with you. The oppressive atmosphere is conveyed through the gloomy soundtrack, the dark and mysterious interior of the old mansion and the constant feeling that you are being watched. Some keys will be hanging in the most visible place, and some are hidden better. Explore the rooms, look for objects and avoid the pursuer. Try to find the best way, remember the movement of the Horned-headed demon chasing its victim, that is, you.

rows.name: Dark Throne
rows.short_description: Awaken as a knight in this 2D Metroidvania platformer. Explore, unlock abilities, and battle foes to escape a treacherous dungeon.
rows.description_html: Awaken, brave knight, in the depths of a mysterious cave. With no memory of how you arrived, you must explore, battle, and unlock powerful abilities to survive and escape this treacherous dungeon. As you progress, you'll navigate a sprawling, interconnected world in classic Metroidvania style, uncovering secrets and acquiring new skills that open up previously inaccessible areas. Engage in intense 2D platforming action, mastering precise movements and timing to overcome deadly traps and formidable foes. Unlock powerful abilities like dashing and double-jumping to enhance your mobility and combat prowess. As an indie game, this adventure offers a unique and personal touch, crafted with passion and attention to detail. Embark on a perilous quest filled with danger, mystery, and adventure. Will you uncover the secrets of your past and escape the dungeon's clutches, or will you fall victim to the horrors within?

rows.name: Body of Mine
rows.short_description: Body of Mine is an award-winning VR experience that allows you to step into the body of another gender and discover the stories of transgender individuals.
rows.description_html: IMPORTANT: This experience requires Vive Trackers and an HTC Vive (full minimum specs below). A standalone version is available on the Quest Store. Body of Mine is an award-winning Virtual Reality experience that allows you to step into the body of another gender and discover the stories of transgender individuals. Combining full-body, face, hand, and eye tracking with personal interviews of transgender interviews, the experimental storytelling experience allows you to immerse yourself into the skin of another, and discover lived stories of gender dysphoria and euphoria. Body of Mine is the recipient of the Producers Guild Innovation Award, the SXSW Special Jury Award, Best XR at Games for Change, a BAFTA Student Award, and premiered internationally at the Venice Film Festival. Body of Mine 'breaks through a psychological barrier that few pieces of media ever have' (WIRED), taking you on a profound journey of what it means to be a human being. This experience will not run without a specific hardware configuration and calibration, including 5x HTC Vive Trackers, an RTX 3090 graphics card or higher, and (optionally) an eye-tracking headset. Please read the README for detailed information. A trackerless, standalone adaptation is coming soon.

rows.name: The Hole Town
rows.short_description: To the town in the hole... a story about a place where I can't go.
rows.description_html: A super short visual novel based on the original poem by imayui. In Japan, it was released in 2014 as a way of telling stories and poems online. Just like a visual novel, you read through the story. Fancy opening BGM and simple animated illustration. It is a short story that ends within 2 or 3 minutes, and you can enjoy a strange sense of the extraordinary. ---story--- A very short and tasteful poetic story that begins with; Along the flat land spreading endlessly, There are many holes of various sizes...... ---feature--- ・All hand-drawn animation, text, and UI design. ・Original fancy opening BGM. ・You can read it within 3 minutes. ・Press the Enter key to continue reading. ・If you press the cancel key on the title screen, reading will proceed automatically. ・Press the Shift key to mute the reading voice, allowing you to read the story for yourself. ---About review, fan art, game commentary, and live broadcastse--- All welcome. *Secondary use, sale and redistribution of any material taken from this game is prohibited. *Unauthorized reproduction of this game in part or whole and unauthorized commercial use are prohibited.

rows.name: Dummy Guyz
rows.short_description: Dummy Guyz is a multiplayer physics sandbox with no predefined rules. Get creative by building or breaking things your way. The game is bare-bones with no theme and minimal graphics, focusing solely on physics interactions!
rows.description_html: Join us Our Channel YouTube: TOY Studio TikTok: TOY Studio About the Game Dummy Guyz: Multiplayer Physics Sandbox Game Welcome to 'Dummy Guyz' a quaint little multiplayer sandbox game with graphics so rudimentary they'd make a potato blush. It's a place where your grand ideas meet the unpredictable world of physics, all while trying not to fall flat on its face. The real magic happens when you team up. It's multiplayer mayhem at its finest—imagine a group of friends, each with the art skills of a distracted kindergartener, attempting to build the Eiffel Tower with nothing but spaghetti. Yep, it's that kind of party. Where you're not just a player; you're a pioneer. Here, your brilliant (or brilliantly bizarre) ideas fuel the game’s evolution. Discuss, debate, and help steer the ship through the wild waters of game development. And soon, with mods, you'll get to tweak, twist, and transform the game into something uniquely yours. Your imagination is the limit, and our Discord is the launchpad. What’s This All About? 'Dummy Guyz' is our love letter to the chaos of creativity. Inspired by the spirit of Garry's Mod, we thought, why not create a sandbox where everything doesn’t always go as planned? From building wobbly vehicles that defy gravity (for better or worse) to crafting forts that are more about character than structural integrity, we're all about the fun in the journey, not just the destination. Early Days, Humble Ways Fair warning: we're in the super early stages here. If 'Dummy Guyz' were a cake, we'd still be figuring out the difference between baking powder and baking soda. But that’s where the adventure begins, right? We’ve got the basics down: blocks, vehicle parts, and a physics engine that sometimes gets overly excited. As we grow, expect everything from minor improvements to major overhauls, all in the pursuit of crafting a sandbox game that’s as enjoyable to play as it is unpredictable. Here's a full list of features in the Early Access version: Local LAN or online multiplayer with very limited relay servers (only two nodes!) support A minimal bean-like character which you can only switch color for customization Relatively rich set of tools you can select and equip to your quickbar, including guns, swords, tools that manipulating other stuff, block building tools, car building tools and some very hacky tools that can change properties of other stuff. Some interactable objects that will respond to player interaction in different ways, such as moving, rotating, flying or simply let you take the drive seat. A few dull models that you can put together with other stuff to create your own toy. A collection of Nextbots with popular memes from the internet. A experimental feature that let you save your combination and level setups into XML file which you can load into the game anytime later. It's pretty limited feature wise but we don't add any restriction to how you can combine different objects and tools. Some of the tool effects even work on other players. So it's recommended to invite friends to play together and get either creative or stupid fun. What to Look Forward to The future's bright (we hope) with plans to introduce more building blocks, mechanical parts, better physics shenanigans, and features that YOU suggest. We're committed to making 'Dummy Guyz' a space where creativity, chaos, and community come together in a delightful mess.

rows.name: Breadborn
rows.short_description: Breadborn is a crazy action game where you command an army of crumb minions that came from very own body. Branches, axes, or a killer mini-gun? It's up to you to decide how to equip your army in order to sow chaos among the peasants and get to the PRINCE himself!
rows.description_html: Ever hear that gluten is bad for your health? Ha! Prepare to meet a SERIOUSLY lethal lump of dough! Cursed by an old hag, it's doomed to roam the earth and wreak destruction upon villages and towns. So head out on the attack, and remember—each failure only makes you stronger. Breadborn brings you dynamic and chaotic battles, set to a cheery soundtrack! Bready or not, here you come! Tear off a chunk of yourself, arm it with weaponry, and send it to fight the enemy. Nobody stands a chance against your army of crumbs—buck-toothed peasants and pesky bees alike. Even your most dangerous foe—the hungry hen—shall be defeated. Baking care of business Use a rich arsenal of melee and long-range weaponry! Grab anything that comes to hand, whether it's an ordinary stick or a top-of-the-range assault rifle—a gift from Baba Yaga, the forest witch. Even a block of juice powder or a balalaika might come in handy on the battlefield. How? Give it a shot and find out! Rise like dough! Over time, your lump will grow bigger, its army will get stronger, and its inner world will become richer. Earn achievements and unlock access to new weaponry, opponents, artifacts, and even in-game events. The sky's the limit! Your favorite recipe! Prepare your lump to your exact tastes. Use the in-game editor to give your high-carb hero its own unique style! Cause that's just how you roll! Investigate the vast and perilous world of Breadford County. Tons of varied locations, activities, and tough bosses await you. Take a plunge into the icy river Don, or battle the Deathless One in an abandoned cemetery.

rows.name: Astro Arena
rows.short_description: Astro Arena is a fast-paced, team-based space battleground where Rock, Paper, and Scissors clash. Choose your character, gather resources, and earn points to unlock powerful abilities like invisibility and speed. Outsmart your opponents and lead your team to victory!
rows.description_html: Step into the ultimate 2D space arena where strategy meets action in Astro Arena! In this fast-paced, team-based game, two opposing teams clash in a dynamic battleground, each vying for dominance with a unique twist on the classic rock-paper-scissors game you know and love. Choose your character type—Rock, Paper, or Scissors—and dive into the fray. Each type has its strengths and weaknesses: chase down the enemy characters you're strong against, and evade those who have the upper hand over you. The key to victory lies in outmaneuvering your opponents and using your environment to your advantage. But it’s not just about the chase! As you battle it out, gather valuable resources scattered across the arena to gain the upper hand. Earn points for every successful match and exchange them for powerful abilities like invisibility, speed boosts, and more. These abilities can be activated for a short time during the game, giving you the edge you need to turn the tide of battle. Formulate your team’s strategy, coordinate with your allies, and outplay your opponents to claim victory in this adrenaline-pumping battle royale. Will you lead your team to triumph or crumble under the pressure? Astro Arena is a fresh take on the classic game, offering hours of competitive fun. Are you ready to rise to the challenge and dominate the arena? Features: Classic Rock-Paper-Scissors Mechanics: Experience a thrilling twist on the timeless game. Team-Based Battles: Work with your team to outmaneuver and outsmart the opposition. Dynamic 2D Space Arena: Explore and fight in a vibrant, action-packed battleground. Resource Gathering: Collect and strategically use resources to gain the upper hand. Ability Upgrades: Earn points and unlock powerful abilities like invisibility and speed boosts to activate during battle. Intense Multiplayer Action: Engage in high-octane battles with friends or players around the world. Prepare for battle, strategize with your team, and may the best team win in Astro Arena!

rows.name: Coin Eruption
rows.short_description: Experience the thrill of a mountain-top coin pusher game in Coin Eruption! Drop coins, collect special upgrades, unlock rewards, and trigger epic volcano eruptions. Customize your game with avatars and backgrounds while leveling up through dynamic and exciting gameplay.
rows.description_html: Coin Eruption takes the classic coin pusher arcade experience to exhilarating new heights—literally! Set atop a majestic mountain, your goal is to strategically drop coins onto the pusher platform and watch as they cascade down, pushing more coins and prizes into your collection. Key Features: Epic Coin Pushing Action Drop your coins and watch the physics-based pusher mechanism at work. Time your drops perfectly to maximize your haul and push even more coins over the edge! Special Coins with Unique Effects Collect special coins with distinct abilities. Upgrade their effects to supercharge your gameplay. Whether it's doubling your coin output, creating explosive cascades, or triggering rare events, these special coins are your key to mastery. Unlockable Collectibles and Rewards As you play, gather unique collectibles that unlock a variety of in-game rewards. These treasures are not just for show—they can provide significant boosts and enhance your coin pushing strategy. Dynamic Volcano Eruptions Experience the thrill of a volcano eruption that showers coins onto the pusher platform. These eruptions are spectacular events that can turn the tide of your game in an instant, offering massive rewards and excitement. Autoplay Feature Sit back and let the game play itself with the autoplay feature. Perfect for when you want to relax and watch the coins stack up without lifting a finger. Avatars and Backgrounds Customize your experience by unlocking new avatars and backgrounds. Show off your progress and achievements as you level up, making your game uniquely yours. Leveling System Progress through the game and earn experience points to level up. Each level brings new challenges and rewards, ensuring that the gameplay remains fresh and engaging. Coin Eruption is not just a game; it's a captivating experience that combines strategy, skill, and a bit of luck. With stunning visuals, dynamic gameplay elements, and a plethora of features to explore, this game will keep you entertained for hours on end. Get ready to embark on an epic coin-pushing adventure and see how high you can climb!

rows.name: Teatime Samurai
rows.short_description: Up to four player retro arcade style twin-stick shooter featuring a colorful cast of monsters inspired by Japanese folklore.
rows.description_html: Who woulda thought sipping tea would could lead to an epic battle against the forces of the undead? Not us, surely, but here we are. In Teatime Samurai, you'll journey to ancient Japan, where your old dojo has been overrun by a fabulous army of zombies, skeletons, and assorted monsters from Japanese folklore. Your host? None other than the great Nashisama, the man who taught you everything you know about slinging fireballs and drinking tea. Twin-Stick Madness : Get ready to blast your way through hordes of enemies in classic arcade action. Dust off those dusty thumbs, it's arcade time, baby. Couch Co-op : Party started and looking for co-op action? Look no further than Teatime Samurai. Up to four players can join the fray on the same screen. Retro Vibes : With hand drawn retro pixel art graphics, this game is a nostalgic sendup to the golden age of arcade shooters – but with substantially more tea. Japanese Folklore Fun : From mischievous yokai to oversized oni, the enemies you'll face are straight out of Japanese mythology. It's like a very shoddy history lesson, where the teacher gets confused half way through and starts talking about magic pizza. Legendary Boss Battles : Face off against monstrous bosses. Martial arts champions, Oni Sorcerers, and Blues Keyboardists from 80s jam bands all await you. Two Fabulous Game Modes : In Classic Mode you'll dive into relentless action and kill as many enemies as possible, facing down six bosses. Rack up your score and etch your name onto the high score board, proving yourself the ultimate Teatime Samurai. In Defend the Shrine Mode you'll hold up against endless waves of enemies hell-bent on destroying your shrine. Strategize, defend, and prove your skills in this survival challenge. Grab your friends, your gamepads, your friend's gamepads, and a hot cup of tea. It’s Teatime. And this time, it's... Samurai... Teatime... Teatime Samurai.

rows.name: No Work No Life
rows.short_description: This game is a roguelike horror game. Beyond the door lies a completely white space where you must pick up items, offer them as sacrifices, and survive for as long as possible.
rows.description_html: One day, you are suddenly abducted to a completely white space. In this place, with only a door and an elevator, gather offerings to sacrifice and survive for as long as possible. Except for you or others who were captured with you, no one else exists in this space, so if you see anyone, run away immediately. If you encounter danger or decide you have gathered enough offerings, don't hesitate to escape through the exit to return to safety.

rows.name: Ashes Of Idunn: Tales Of Fimbulwinter
rows.short_description: Ashes Of Idunn: Tales Of Fimbulwinter is a small sneak peek into the future of the Ashes Of Idunn Metaverse. In this experience, you will follow the Berserker into battle in search of his people. After the fight with the Troll, the Berserker seeks the Voelver to get answers.
rows.description_html: Far away from home, sailing through unknown waters. I ask the Gods to show me mercy. My family, my people. Consumed by the tongues of fire. I never should have left them. There may still be hope. They may still be, somewhere… Only she can help me find the way… the way home. Gods give me strength, the strength to regain what I lost. Ashes Of Idunn: Tales Of Fimbulwinter is a sneak peek into the future of the Ashes Of Idunn Metaverse. In this experience, you will follow the Berserker into battle in search of his people. After the fight with the Troll, the Berserker seeks the Voelver to get answers. The world of Tales Of Fimbulwinter is vast and offers different types of animal life and vegetation. You can choose to explore the world freely but beware, some enemies might be camping around the corner. Enemies will try to stop your search. Thankfully, with the power of the Gods and your mighty axe, you can defeat them in old-fashioned melee combat But be careful, too many enemies at once may cause your demise. Low on health? With some mix of natural ingredients found in the world and a little rest at the resting runes that will not be a problem for long. These magical runes have the power of giving great comfort to our Berserker, this way, he is able to rest and regain his strength. The path may seem straightforward, but sometimes even the greatest need a guide. The runes will serve as a guide for your travels within this realm. Just follow the runes and you will eventually find your way to the Voelver and your people. Had fun with the experience and need more Ashes of Idunn? Do not fret, there is more to come...

rows.name: Beetle Ninja
rows.short_description: Saving the world sure gets stressful sometimes!
rows.description_html: STORY After unleashing an unfathomable cataclysm, Montrell Saint-Luc, the Beetle Ninja, must find a way to prevent it's inevitable arrival within two short weeks . Will you save the world, or will you spend the rest your time chilling at home? Ultimately, it's up to you. Either way, some insane cultish man on the street insists that the world is going to end soon. FEATURES 14 in-game days worth of content An ever-changing hub-world High replayablility 13 unique party members 11 different missions 70 custom music tracks by PostElvis, featuring guest compositions by Shane Mesa ( Mother 4 ) and ClassyJitto ( Frostix ) ( Pizza Tower ) Built for repeated playthroughs and varied strategies via an expansive roster of recruitable ninjas, a large selection of unique endings and secrets, and a mission-and-day-based structure, Beetle Ninja is a game that takes multiple separate playthroughs to truly appreciate! LEGACY Often called 'the biggest sleeper hit of 2020' by fans, Beetle Ninja is an RPGMaker 2003 game first released in 2020: with unique open-ended design that allows the player to simulate two weeks in the life of a vigilante-for-hire in whichever way he chooses.

rows.name: Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre
rows.short_description: Embark on an odyssey into the unknown! Behold the tale of Toadman, an enigmatic being born from alien tech and the mysteries of Radiant Verde. Witness his perilous quest through treacherous jungles to confront Captain Croak in an epic showdown! Welcome to 'Spawn of the Spore Spectre'!
rows.description_html: WHAT'S ALL THIS ABOOT? Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre is a 2D action platformer with a real focus on speed, Tarantino-style violence, and a wicked grapple feature that lets ya zip around like an acrobat, eh! This is a prequel chapter for Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada, and the full game’s gonna have, like, five times the content of this demo, buddy! So buckle up, ‘cause you’re in for a wild one, don’tcha know! BELLS AND WHISTLES, EH? Set in North Hollywood, Canada, the game’s a real nod to the golden-age of Hollywood Z-movie director Ed Wood and those early superhero flicks, eh! What really makes Croak Crusader stand out from the other grapple-based platformers, though, is the focus on combat and action, don’tcha know! Enemies burst into fountains of red pixels and body parts when you ram 'em through or chuck 'em against walls and floors with a good ol' 'crac' or 'paf!' It's a real hoot, buddy! A REAL BEAUT OF A STORY! In this prequel chapter, players take control of the mysterious doppelgänger, Toadman, on his quest for revenge against Captain Croak—the hero of the story, eh! Now, Toadman comes to life when a poor unsuspecting leech, stuck on Captain Croak, gets run over by a car and then mutated by the bizarre wildlife in Canada’s lush, exotic jungles. At this point in our story, those jungles have been infused with some strange alien tech, cooked up by the wicked Professor Creature! With a chip on his shoulder, Toadman vows to get even with Captain Croak and kick him out of the Canadian jungle he now calls home! MISC INFORMATION Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre is a demo chapter for what is intended to be a much larger experience! The full game, Croak Crusader: The Champion of Canada  will star the true hero of our story:

rows.name: Abrakajumpa
rows.short_description: Jump your way to the top!
rows.description_html: Abrakajumpa is a 2D platformer game set in a fantasy world where you have to reach the top of the level through jumping. Facing difficult jumps and obstacles, you must traverse these levels through strategy and Abrakajumpa is a 2D platformer game set in a fantasy world where you have to reach the top of the level through jumping. Facing difficult jumps and obstacles, you must traverse these levels through strategy and skill. -As you climb higher, be cautious of falling! A small mistake will cost you precious progress. -Time your jumps precisely and charge them carefully to avoid falling. -Nail-biting jumps and special platforms block your path. Learn what they do and overcome them! -Enjoy a variety of maps which include vanilla, procedural generation, and stealth. -Jump your way to the top and claim the fastest time on the leaderboards.

rows.name: Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz
rows.short_description: Think you're smart? Prove it by stepping into Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz—an educational experience for clever kids and curious minds! Just don't disappoint Mr. Pompy.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz! The only quiz to outbeat your brain! Welcome to the Extravagant Quiz! Step into Mr. Pompy's Extravagant Quiz, a narrative horror experience taking place in an early 2000s edutainment computer game. Your mission: solve Mr. Pompy's quizzes to recover the lost golden light bulbs, all while he attempts to speak to you beyond the screen. This is a tech demo, with the full game coming soon! How It Started Congratulations! You're among the few people who received our unique cereal box copies. *NOTE: Any future giveaways of this game are to be discontinued indefinitely. Any customers to get their hands on a copy are considered a lost cause. Meet the Crew! You've got PomPom! Her lively and boisterous personality can help you solve math problems and, all in all, lift your mood. Visit her store occasionally to purchase several treats. Next is Patrick! He will speed you through all you need to know about history and science. Perhaps even to the extent where you greatly surpass him. Visit his library whenever you have some free time to learn about interesting topics. Finally, we have Mr. Pompy himself! As your host, he will ensure that you win the game with nothing less than perfection and a more positive attitude towards life. Puzzles & Quizzes Do puzzles to proceed to the quiz! Test your smarts with our amazing quizzes!! See how well you did!!! Brought to you by Light Thoughts Game Company. Discover the light within your mind.

rows.name: Word on the hook
rows.short_description: An exciting intellectual fishing game, where you need to catch words (as a “fish”) and earn coins!
rows.description_html: An exciting intellectual fishing game for one or more players, where as a “fish” you need to catch words divided into two parts. Each player gets control of a boat and a fishing rod, with which they need to catch as many fish as possible. Each fish carries only one of the two parts of a word. For example, the word “game” will be divided into two fish “ig” and “ra”. Whoever catches both of these syllables will collect the word “game”. Whichever player caught the most words in a certain time won! About the game Simple rules: each player can either move left and right (to determine where to cast the fishing rod), or lower and raise the fishing rod. To catch a fish, you just need to “hook” it with a hook. To catch a word, you need to catch two fish - parts of this word. There is a mode for 1 player (catch as many word fish as possible against time and earn more coins). There is a mode for several (2-4) players on one screen (have time to catch more fish than your friends). Support for Russian and English languages (both in the interface and in gameplay). There are 2 difficulty levels for each language (the difficulty level affects the number and complexity of words; even preschoolers know words at an easy level) There are 9 fisherman characters to choose from. At the end of each round, each player receives a prize - coins (as many coins as he managed to catch the words). There is a store where you can spend the coins you earn and buy cool nautical jewelry. Timed game. The game uses cute cartoon graphics. The game has beautiful special effects and pleasant music!

rows.name: Katto: Rising Tides
rows.short_description: Katto: Rising Tides is a funny and dynamic platformer game! Enter the kingdom of Egatlea, face terrible Nari enemies, move and jump between floors and obstacles, and do your best to restore peace for your kingdom.
rows.description_html: Katto: Rising Tides is a funny and dynamic platformer game! Enter the kingdom of Egatlea, face terrible Nari enemies, move and jump between floors and obstacles, and do your best to restore peace for your kingdom. In the ancient kingdom of Egatlea, the Felyn lived in peace under the protection of Kathsa, the feline deity. To invoke her in case of danger, Kathsa had given five gems to each of the five cities of the kingdom: Kathse, Macska, Qattus, Catlantis, and Cathenas. These gems symbolized unity and mutual dependence between cities. However, one day, the Nari, inhabitants of the vast ocean that surrounded the kingdom, emerged with a powerful army and surprised the Felyn, usurping the temples of the five cities and seizing the five gems. With the loss of the gems, the cities were in danger of being wholly conquered. The deity Kathsa chose the protagonist, Katto, as the bearer destined to recover the gems and restore peace to the kingdom. Even though the gems' protectors had fallen prisoner to the Nari, Katto demonstrated skill by infiltrating the temples, fighting off the invaders, and recovering the stolen gems. Now, with the five gems in the hands of the Nari, Katto must fight to recover them and gather them in the ancient amulet to summon Kathsa and receive her help to expel the invading Nari and restore peace to the kingdom of Egatlea. Embark on an epic adventure through Catlantis! In this fast-paced 3D platformer, you must jump across gaps, dash past obstacles, scale walls with agile climbs, and defeat enemies by stomping or dashing into them. Navigate through winding corridors and bustling marketplaces, using your skills to overcome obstacles and enemies. Jump over pits, dash through hazards, and climb walls to reach new heights. Defeat enemies by carefully timing your jumps and dashes, landing on them with precision. Explore the richly detailed environments. Master the art of traversal as you leap and dash your way through this vibrant and challenging adventure. Key features: 3 unique levels & an epic boss fight Dynamic and easy-to-use gameplay Beautiful greco roman-inspired art style Amazing soundtrack made by students from Berklee College of Music Valencia

rows.name: Low Batt
rows.short_description: Step into the thrilling world of Low Batt, a heart-pounding Top Down Shooter that pits you against the formidable security forces of L.E.A.D. Industries. Navigate through intense challenges requiring a blend of skill and strength and embark on an epic robotic adventure to rescue your robo-dog.
rows.description_html: Have you ever dreamed of defeating an army of robots? Low Batt is the game for you. In this exhilarating, fast-paced shooting adventure, you assume the role of Andy, a friendly robot on a mission to retrieve batteries for his robo-dog, fiercely guarded by the nefarious corporation L.E.A.D. Industries. Explore a vibrant and captivating futuristic factory, meeting intriguing characters and dispatching hordes of guards in the most inventive ways. A FORMIDABLE ARSENAL AT YOUR DISPOSAL: From Roomba-like robots to mines and even the occasional nuclear weapon, Andy is well-equipped and can utilize various traps and environmental hazards, such as ground traps or electrified floors, to handle the moderately well-trained elite corps of guards. AN UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEY FOR ALL AGES: In Low Batt, you'll encounter unforgettable characters and a bustling robot factory teeming with life. Amidst the frantic combat, take breaks to uncover amusing secrets, anecdotes, and bizarre situations in which the workers of L.E.A.D. Industries find themselves entangled. JOIN ANDY AND TRY THE LOW BATT EARLY ACCESS! KEY FEATURES: Explore 2 unique and distinct sci-fi areas Experience nice, polished and creative combat Fight against multiple types of unique enemies Meet fun and memorable NPC Use machinery and traps to your advantage

rows.name: Shelley Manor
rows.short_description: Find your way through a puzzle filled manor while barely dodging human-eating monsters. You wake up in a dark room with one objective: escape those sharpened teeth. However, you should not worry; you will meet friends along the way.
rows.description_html: Shelley Manor is a combination of reality and fantasy, where the time seems to have stopped before entering the manor walls. You will meet known enemies, all of whom come from classical works, and some allies. Control Alex, a tourist that ended up there after being tricked by the townsfolk. Explore the hallways and rooms and help them escape before it’s too late. The player must run, push and throw to reach its goal by completing the various riddles the manor is covered with. With fixed cameras and dynamic puzzles, escaping seems harder with every passing time; encountering enemies every step of the way might make Alex lose hope, but fear not! They’re not alone in this tale. A friendly NPC will help guide them with different dialogues and save points along several rooms. Hide through the levels, distract enemies and interact with the level scenery to solve the different puzzles in front of you. Shelley Manor is a linear free exploration game where the player can choose how to use their time. Key features: Single-player game 5 Unique enemies Three different zones Rich and immersive environment Start your adventure through the manor and find your way out before it’s too late.

rows.short_description: Can Luna navigate this funky world to find Halloween? - Talk to strange and compelling characters! Freeze obstacles and activate the fast Chili Pepper Mode, but beware - it also makes you uncontrollably jumpy!

Try toggling the Chili Pepper Mode................. Find whatever the 'Halloween' is............................... In this 3D platformer, Luna can freeze certain obstacles! The Digital Domain??? When did I accept that anyway?? That sounds awful… What even is Halloween?? Dive into this funky world for free!

rows.name: Make Your Country Great Again
rows.short_description: Here is a global multiplayer clicker/idle game where players from all over the world unite for a chance to restore global justice and make their country the greatest among all others. There has never been a game this global and massive!
rows.description_html: Have you ever felt the injustice of the world order, thinking that your nation should be at the top of the food chain? Or that some countries are undeservedly high in the global hierarchy and it would be nice to bring them down? If these feelings resonate with you, then you have come to the right place. In our game, you can: Develop the countries you care about. Sink the ratings of disliked countries. Become stronger and have a greater impact on the world order. In our game: A truly unlimited number of players are honestly and simultaneously on the same server. The efforts of all players, potentially millions, are displayed in real-time. Our project offers you a fair way to compete with all the players on the planet for the ranking of countries in the global leaderboard. You will take part in a collective planetary battle and see the consequences of the collective actions of all players on the planet in real-time. You will realize your influence on countries and the world. How big or small that influence will be depends only on you. You just need to choose a country and launch your Energy Plant to increase the Might of the country: or to suppress it: The more Force you have, the stronger your 'Energy Plant': This seemingly simple tool will shine with new colors in the conditions of real-time competition with players from all over the world. We confidently declare that we have achieved an unprecedented level of massiveness for multiplayer games!

rows.name: Down the shaft
rows.short_description: Down the Shaft is a first person horror game where you take on the duty to keep an Elder God forever contain within the cave. In order to do that, you must keep the machines that maim them active. But beware, their minions are on the loose and they won't let you do your job so easy.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the mines War, death, pestilence, and famine are words one can use to describe our world as it is now. While this is damning for us humans, something grows stronger in the shadows. Waiting, just waiting, for their opportunity to strike and be freed of their chains. For centuries, this place has been guarded from the peeping eye. Hidden in plain sight to protect everyone on the surface from what lies below. Now it's your turn to work the shift and face the horrors down the shaft . Your first shift Welcome to the mines, rookie. Let's hope you survive your first day. You knew when you signed. You kept repeating it to yourself: 'This is no normal mining operation'. You know your duty. You know why you are here: 'I'm here to protect everyone else outside this shaft from the Elder God.' You know what will happen. You know it all too well: 'I won't make it out. But they won't either.' Your job as an engineer is to keep the machines running. You will have to keep them on as long as you can. Fail to do this, and the god will get off its slumber in no time, prematurely ending your shift. Fix machines, get new upgrades, and defend yourself from the creatures that lurk in the mines. Your shift ends at 06:00 AM. That, of course, if you survive that long. The clock is ticking The machines are rumbling down there, but the noise of creaking metal and twisted flesh is not everything audible in the mine. With the recent tragedies out in the world, the Elder God is more active than ever , and so are their obedient minions . Don't let them wake up, or the whole world will be gone in mere seconds. Midnight is approaching. If the clock reaches it, doomsday is nigh. Your survival is pointless if you let the Elder God unchecked. Even surviving the shift might end up killing you and everything else. Keep all the machines working at all times, even if that means taking risks. Learn from your mistakes. Adapt to your enemies. Be a better worker in the shaft. Maybe, just maybe, your effort won't be as pointless as it might look.

rows.name: MOMOCHIYO'S MONONOKETAIJI
rows.short_description: Ninja Puzzle Battle
rows.description_html: Ninja 'Momochiyo' goes on a journey to exterminate Mononoke. Let's defeat the cute monster girls that appear one after another! ◆How to fight 1.When Momochiyo meets the Yokai Girl, a battle begins. 2.Knowing your enemy is very important. Touch the Yokai Girl and observe her attack power and characteristics! 3.Choose a card and use the trick! Cards are randomly selected from the constructed deck.SP (skill points) are required to use techniques. (SP will gradually recover as the turn progresses.) ※If you don't see the card you want to use, press the arrow button at the bottom right to select a new card. 4.If you understand the characteristics of the technique well, you are sure that the technique will hit the enemy! 5.Next is the monster girls' turn! The Yokai Girl notices that Momochiyo has come and turns around, and the Yokai Girl who has already turned around attacks. 6.The treasure chests you sometimes find along the way contain new cards! Get more powerful cards and prepare for the monster girls who are getting stronger and stronger! (At this time, you must discard one card you already have. Of course, you can also give up a new card.) 7.The game is over when Momochiyo's health reaches 0. At this time, the deck at that time will be displayed. In order to advance the battle efficiently and advantageously and eliminate many monster girls, it is important to understand the techniques and enemy characteristics well! Feel free to post live streaming, fan art, etc. I would be happy if you could spread this game widely!

Explore a manga universe, recruit them to your team, grow your guild, and build up your hero to defeat other players in strategic battles! Discover the manga RGP adventure through the visual novel format with plenty of humor and hilarious references. Enjoy hundreds of original illustrations, accessible to all players for free. rows.name: Rally Mechanic Simulator: Light Edition
rows.short_description: Step into the world of rally car mechanics with Rally Mechanic Simulator: Prologue, a free introduction to the full game. Take your first steps as a rally mechanic, facing the challenges of fixing and tuning a rally car.
rows.description_html: Step into the world of automotive sports mechanics with the Rally Mechanic Simulator: Prologue . Test your skills and see if you have what it takes to manage the garage, handle parts and funds, and fix damaged rally cars. Tune them to perfection and take them to the rallies. Experience the challenges of bad weather, limited time, and fierce competition. Prove yourself and become the best rally mechanic. Are you ready for the challenge? Your journey begins with one car, two rallies, and a test track. See if you can handle the time pressure and turn a wreck into a winning rally car. Test your car on the track and compete for the best driving time using Steam Leaderboards. Start to build your career In the Rally Mechanic Simulator: Prologue, you will begin your journey towards becoming a top-tier rally mechanic. Experience the thrill of fixing and modifying cars while getting a taste of what's to come. This prologue is just the beginning, offering a glimpse into the exciting career that awaits you in the full version. Set the foundation for your future team, start negotiating your first sponsor deals, and manage the initial aspects of your career development. Get ready to step into a world of rally car mechanics and prepare for the full experience in Rally Mechanic Simulator. It's not just a car, it's a rally car Work with rally cars equipped with turbos, coilovers, proper tires, and performance transmissions. Keep an eye on the car's extra features and make it as good as possible to earn fans and money as part of a champion rally team. Prologue features: Prologue-exclusive: One car, two rallies, and a test track Compete for the best driving time using Steam Leaderboards Realistic rally car models with extensive interaction Work on car electronics Car damage and cleaning systems Ability to paint and customize your cars Equipped field workshop for on-the-go repairs Advanced vehicle development system Realistic graphics Advanced car appearance personalization system Timed repair segments Extensive tuning options Many achievements to unlock and much more in the full version of Rally Mechanic Simulator

Hope you enjoy them as much as we do!

rows.name: Droid Wars
rows.short_description: Droid Wars is an action-packed game with local multiplayer deathmatch and single-player survival modes. Customize your droid’s loadout, manage health, armor, and stamina, and battle in PvP and PvE environments. Survive waves of enemies or be the last droid standing.
rows.description_html: Droid Wars is an exciting game featuring both local multiplayer deathmatch and single-player survival modes. In deathmatch, 1-4 players battle it out with customized bots. Each match lets players personalize their droid’s loadouts from a variety of weapons, each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Players must strategically manage their droid’s health, armor, and stamina to outlast their opponents. The goal is simple: be the last droid standing. Featuring both PvP (Player vs. Player) and PvE (Player vs. Environment) elements, Droid Wars offers intense player battles and opportunities to defeat NPCs for valuable bonuses. These advantages include items that boost damage, speed, armor, and access to unique weapons. The single-player survival mode challenges players to endure waves of increasingly difficult enemies, testing their skills and strategy.

rows.name: Runeflame
rows.short_description: Runeflame is a point-and-click fantasy adventure with an open world and an emphasis on puzzle-solving. Guide your custom character through the immersive world of Runeflame, where secrets and magic have minds of their own.
rows.description_html: Is the mist playing with your eyes, or do you really see before you... a girl with a scorpion tail? Runeflame is a top-down adventure puzzle RPG featuring archery that places you in a world of riddle magic and tangled conflicts between people and spirits. Create a unique character from one of four fantasy races and begin to uncover the mysteries of this strange place. To make your way out of the fog, you must hone your skill with the bow and solve the puzzles that keep you trapped. And beyond the walls of your prison, what else will you discover? Each adventure is a standalone module that your character can explore, and new modules for individual purchase will continually be added to expand the world. There are no other items to purchase in the game, only secrets for you to unearth with curiosity and logic. Runeflame - a role-playing fantasy adventure game in the vein of old-school point-and-click adventures and computer RPGs.

rows.name: Trial of Sacrifice
rows.short_description: A cult, devoted to the dark god, Chernobog, has opened a rift between the mortal world and Chernobog's realm, where he has been imprisoned for centuries. From within the rift, darkness spreads out and threatens to envelope the entire world.
rows.description_html: A cult devoted to the evil god Chernobog has summoned a portal to the realm of the living. As the god of darkness, Chernobog spreads a corruption to the mortal world, that slowly destroys the surrounding lands and causing an illness to spread. In the many attempts to close the realm connecting Chernobog to the world, the leaders of nearby kingdoms have sacrificed all of their soldiers and are now running out of options. Our protagonist Viktor, a humble farmer; has been forced to be the next to enter the realm and attempt to defeat Chernobog. Viktor must succeed in this task, otherwise he will lose his life. Follow along in Viktor's story; fighting skeletons and completing unique challenges, such as time trial completions or using unique fighting style choices. Features A unique single player dungeon crawler that focuses on a slower paced third-person combat system A Linear dungeon design that increases in difficulty; designed for a one-shot adventure Local leaderboard system for speed run enthusiast Breakable resources scattered throughout the dungeon, used for upgrading gear. Armour and Weapon upgrade system, to further enhance the player's combat during their playthrough Skeleton enemies utilizing 3 different weapon styles, with varying damage and attack speeds. A final boss with multiple unique attack styles and two final endings possible to Viktor's story About 'Above Average Catfish' Above Average Catfish is a 9 person indie company consisting of recent college graduates with varying focuses in the gaming industry. We were tasked with creating a game from scratch with only 12 weeks to complete it! We decided to push ourselves to make something on a larger scale and we hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed working on it!

rows.name: Monster Ops
rows.short_description: NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim! With dangerous missions and an unpredictable commander, soldiers Wraith and Tide must count on each other to survive. Will their bond as battle-brothers evolve into something more? Monster Ops: Military Special Forces hunting rogue monsters! Episodes 1-12 OUT NOW!
rows.description_html: NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim! Plucky Lieutenant Tide has been drafted into the Monster Ops: A military taskforce that hunts monsters who've escaped from a top-secret experiment. He joins the no-nonsense veteran soldier Wraith and the peaceful human-loving monster Balasque. This is an open-ended series with no ending planned. It's like a TV show that will continue until it's canceled. Tide's past screw-ups make him a questionable choice for the high-stakes black ops, but he's determined to prove himself to Wraith. He can't help but look up to their badass leader. Wraith seems rough around the edges, but he warms up to Tide quickly. When the nature of their missions turn sexual, romantic possibilities open up for the two that neither had considered. With increasingly dangerous missions and an unpredictable commander, Wraith and Tide know they must count on each other to survive. Will their bond as battle-brothers evolve into something more? An on-going visual novel series with new 1 to 2 hour stand-alone game episodes coming out monthly in 2025! Our season premieres will be free, and subsequent episodes paid.

rows.name: Super Trailblazers
rows.short_description: A fast-paced, local multiplayer arcade game. Race around a neon grid with your friends, strategically weaving through the trails of light you leave behind. Use clever tactics and special abilities like missiles, bombs, and invisibility to be the last driver standing!
rows.description_html: Get ready for a blast from the past with Super Trailblazers, a retro-inspired, local multiplayer arcade game! Up to 4 players face off on a neon grid, with the hopes of being the last driver standing. As you race around, you leave behind a neon trail of light - forcing you to weave and dodge through the constantly changing landscape. MULTIPLAYER ONLY Super Trailblazers requires at least two players to start the battle. This means one player can play using the keyboard, and controllers are required for any additional players. DYNAMIC GAMEPLAY Disrupt the competition with an array of exciting abilities. Dash forward to cut off your rivals, launch missiles to blast through walls or strike your foes down head on, lay down bombs to clear your path, and even go invisible to flank enemies or make a daring escape. The competition is fierce, the action is electric, so grab your controllers, fire up Super Trailblazers, and prepare for an unforgettable party experience!

rows.name: Astro Wars
rows.short_description: Astro Wars is a Free Multiplayer Space Strategy Game. You start at the edge of the galaxy where you can build up, colonize and take over planets in competition with players from all over the world!
rows.description_html: Astro Wars is a Free Multiplayer Space Strategy Game. You start at the edge of the galaxy where you can build up, colonize and take over planets in competition with players from all over the world! You can decide various strategies and take over new areas in the galaxy by building piece by piece. Astrowars wants to achieve: fair play. communication between players. social interaction between players. epic battles in the end. a game requiring strategic and diplomatic skills to win. easy to learn and interesting in the long run. Astrowars does not want to achieve: multis and cheaters. no communication. a big single player game where the only interaction is to compare points. all about the first player/alliance to win. a game where a single player with perfect build up skills can win with no contacts. difficult to learn and becomes boring.

rows.name: GameLib
rows.short_description: GameLib is an application that brings together several 3D multiplayer mini-games, such as Werewolves Online, Ludo, and Connect 4 (4 in a row). GameLib features an in-app voice chat function, so you can communicate with other players during the game.
rows.description_html: GameLib is an application that brings together several 3D multiplayer mini-games, such as Werewolves Online, Ludo, and Connect 4 (4 in a row). GameLib features an in-app voice chat function, so you can communicate with other players during the game, whether you're trying to discover a suspect, set the course of a game, or simply have a good time together. You can also add players as friends and communicate with them via an in-app messaging system to keep in touch. Werewolves Online: Up to 15 players can join this role-playing, strategy, and bluffing game. At the start of each game, you're given a card representing a unique role: villager, werewolf, or solo role. No matter which clan you belong to, the objective is the same for everyone: to win the game! Without revealing your role, by using strategy and the powers you've been given, you'll have to do everything you can for yourself or your team/pack to succeed and win. If you don't, you'll be devoured by werewolves, eliminated by the village using a voting system at sunrise, or face some other fate... Ludo: Play Ludo, a classic and friendly board game for 2 to 4 players. Roll the dice, move your pawns around the board, and be the first to reach the center of the board to win! But be careful, strategy is key: block your opponents and plan your movements to gain the advantage. Tactics and luck combine for fun and competitive games on GameLib! Connect 4: Immerse yourself in the strategic universe of Connect 4, a classic and timeless game. Compete against your friends or other online players. Line up 4 tokens of your color horizontally, vertically, or diagonally before your opponent. But be careful, every move counts, and a single mistake can cost you victory! Simplicity, reflection, and competition: take up the challenge and become the master of Connect 4 on GameLib! You'll have the choice of playing with close friends or joining public games with unknown players to add a little suspense to your games! Come and discover our application by downloading it, and show off your talents to other players!

rows.name: Board Wars - Trick Or Treat
rows.short_description: Board Wars ToT is a couch-op, local multiplayer board game intended for family/friend game nights. Take turns rolling dice to manually RUN across the board to Trick-Or-Treat and deliver more candy than the other players!
rows.description_html: Developer's Notes ***Welcome all players. We want to first thank you for visiting our page. Our biggest goal is that you have an enjoyable experience while trick-or-treating. We want you to feel you struck a deal with this game! This game started 3 years ago as a learning project and has developed into a full blown game along the way after realising how much fun we were having. Now that we reached our goal of publishing, we are now working on post release content and updates, there are still many suprises we want to bring to this game. You can help by taking time out to fill out this survey so that we know we are going in the right direction. Survey:   Thank you in advance -Category Zero*** About the Game Board Wars ToT is a couch-op, local multiplayer board game intended for family/friend game nights. Players will take turns rolling dice to RUN across the board and Trick-Or-Treat. Instead of allowing the dice determine how many tiles you move, you as the player will have a certain amount of time to travel across the board to your desired tile. Land at a house to Trick-Or-Treat or land on a Special tile to switch up the score board. But be careful, as long as you have candy in your pockets, it can be stolen from other players and even other greedy monsters trying to catch your spoils. As a monster on Hallow's eve, you have only one goal, DELIVER THE MOST CANDY TO BIG BOSS !!!

rows.name: East Defense
rows.short_description: East DefenseYour duty is to protect the castle by strategically building & upgrading towers to stop monsters from coming their way!
rows.description_html: East Defense Is a tower defense game that focuses on achieving a good balance between entertainment and challenge, being suitable for both hardcore and casual players who would love to either explore tower defense games style or challenge themselves against various waves of monsters by strategically placing and upgrading multiple towers to prevent the monsters from reaching the castle along the path! Core game mechanics Monsters will try to reach the castle, and you have to build and upgrade towers to prevent them from doing so. There are various types of monsters, which you can learn more about as you encounter them in the game. Each tower has a special skill to boost its power, which can be unlocked by upgrading the tower. Winning each level without allowing any monster to reach the castle grants you 3/3 stars, which can be later used to unlock special levels with unique gameplay mechanics! Towers There are 10 tower types to use in the game. Unlock towers' maximum potential by placing them in the optimum spot to make the most use of their power. Each tower can be upgraded five times and has its own special skill unlocked. Using a variety of towers is the key to defeating all types of monster waves.  Monsters Monsters aim to reach the castle in waves, each with its own speed and health. Killing monsters grants you gold, which can be used to build and upgrade towers. Each monster can have multiple traits to make it stronger and more dangerous. On the 10th wave and every 5 waves, bosses will appear! And they are harder to defeat and will cause high damage to the castle if they pass through your defenses! Don't wait anymore! Explore the wonderful world of East Defense and be the one to repeal all monster waves!

rows.name: Night Project
rows.short_description: Indie project in the horror genre, the purpose of which is to solve the big plot of the game universe by searching for notes, talking to people, exploring locations, as well as dreams. The main villain, whose name is 'Kili', will interfere with you.
rows.description_html: Night Project is an indie horror project that will introduce you to the history of the Degeons Intertainment corporations. As the game progresses, you will be able to find notes that will fully describe to you the entire deep history of the largest corporation in this game universe. The main antagonist is the unsuccessful experiment of the Degeons Laboratories companies, called the 'Kili project'. You play in the first person of an ordinary guy named Adrian. Your task is not only to find keys and notes, but also to simultaneously trick the AI, whose task is to scare you as much as possible. Explore the location, talk to people who may know something about this company... You also have to dig into your dreams, which are associated with very bad memories.. Explore the office at night, open all the doors and run away from the terrible creature Kili.. Take him next to you..

rows.name: Senile Zombies
rows.short_description: Senile Zombies is a magic-themed zombie survival shooter that can be played alone or in co-operative multiplayer. Shoot your way through multiple rounds of increasingly strong enemies, while upgrading your own powers to keep up.
rows.description_html: Senile Zombies is a magic-themed zombie survival shooter that can be played alone or in co-operative multiplayer. Shoot your way through multiple rounds of increasingly strong enemies, while upgrading your own powers to keep up. Senile Zombies offers many customization settings to tailor the game's difficulty and feeling to your taste and offer replayability and ever increasing challenges. Story When wizards become increasingly starved of mana, they completely lose their minds. Such 'Senile Zombies' roam the world and gather wherever mana crystals are to be found. These 'Senile Zombies' also hungrily attack any aspiring Wizard brimming with mana. On your search for mana, power, and knowledge, you have stumbled into ruins swarming with Senile Zombies. Fight them off or be devoured! Features Singleplayer Mode Multiplayer Mode 1 Map with five rooms. rows.name: Dysarmia
rows.short_description: An intergalactic RPG full of love and animals.
rows.description_html: Welcome to DYSARMIA. In this RPG you play as Astrid and Phoenix, two lovebirds who are separated by a meteor throwing them both on to the opposite person’s home planet. Your goal is to find the scattered bridge pieces to help bring our lovers back together. You will fight monsters, pets, and unidentified life forms in order to connect the bridge between the two back together. features: Talk to people in order to unlock clues to where the bridge piece is. Dodge enemy attacks in an open world and fight back with your weapon. Original art and soundtrack brimming with personality. Character-rich cutscenes with a lot of personality. Created by a team of four. Escape. Cats. Talking Cats. Bats and Scorpions. Save your progress and come back later. Survive, run away if you have to.

rows.name: Frostflame
rows.short_description: Frostflame is a Brazilian Soulslike developed by a single person. In the game you control Chihiro, disciples of the great master Hori Masashi on a mission to advance to the lowlands and bring back peace, ending the war of the five kingdoms and eliminating the power of the Frstlame.
rows.description_html: Frostflame is a Brazilian Souls like developed by just one person. The game features third-person combat mechanics based on an action RPG system, where you have the possibility of facing enemies in rhythmic combat inspired by Feudal Japan, collecting their flame sparkles to become stronger by upgrading your character and preparing to face even greater challenges. Explore the village of Kakure and face great challenges ranging from the frozen, corrupted by the flame to the great Shokushu soldiers who dominate the icy flame like no one else. Meet the characters who can tell you a little more about the events of the lowlands, collect more powerful armor and weapons, explore the depths of the mines and the castle in the large square. Make way for the lowlands. About the game's lore: Frostflame will take place in the lowlands, a fantasy location, inspired by Feudal Japan, during a time of war between the five kingdoms of the lowlands, namely: the Golden Hills, the Land of Rain, the Water Gate, the Central Desert and , lastly Borda. Just like in real life, war occurs due to the search for power and control, but amidst the chaos, a clan called the Shokushu emerges and has been gaining strength using the mysterious power of the Frozen Flame, which gives power and immortality to the Shokushu soldiers, in addition to dominating and controlling those who survive the clan's attacks, transforming them into “frozen”, insane, aggressive and immortal creatures. In the game you will control Chihiro, disciple of the great Master Hori Masashi. Chihiro lives in the village of Kakure, a place founded by the great Master to shelter those who abandoned the terror of the Lowland wars. Unfortunately, the village is found, attacked by the Flame clan and Chihiro ends up being captured and taken to some mysterious place. The Shokushu dominate the lowlands and the world descends into chaos and Flame. Ten years after her disappearance, Chihiro returns as a frozen creature. Master Hori is now an elder who has spent all this time studying the flame and, upon seeing his disciple return, he sends her to open the way to the lowlands, restore peace and eliminate the power of the Frostlame once and for all.

rows.name: Undergoes
rows.short_description: Descend into endless mines. Pilot your drill ship. Survive the unknown. Undergoes is a surreal survival crafting game where players navigate a machine through procedurally generated mines, gather resources, craft tools, and build bases while fending off dangerous enemies.
rows.description_html: Overview Undergoes is an intense survival crafting game that plunges players into the depths of the earth, where danger and discovery await at every turn. You take command of a powerful drill ship, navigating through a labyrinth of procedurally generated mines in search of valuable minerals and hidden treasures. Each mine offers a unique and unpredictable environment, ensuring no two expeditions are ever the same. In Undergoes , survival is paramount. You must gather resources, craft essential tools and weapons, and construct massive underground bases to withstand the horrors lurking in the darkness. With a wide variety of minerals to discover and enemies to confront, players must remain vigilant and strategic to thrive in this subterranean world. Key Features Procedurally Generated Mines: Each mine you explore is randomly generated, offering endless variety and new challenges with every expedition. Resource Gathering and Crafting: Mine a diverse array of minerals and craft tools, weapons, and crafting tables to aid in your survival. Base Building: Construct extensive underground bases using a multitude of blocks, creating a safe haven from the dangers that lurk in the mines. Survival Horror Elements: Face off against a multitude of enemies, each posing a unique threat. Stay alert and prepared as you delve deeper into the darkness. Exploration and Discovery: Pilot your drill ship from mine to mine, uncovering secrets and treasures hidden beneath the earth's surface. Gameplay In Undergoes, players must master the balance between exploration, resource management, and combat. Navigate your drill ship to new mining sites, extract valuable resources, and use them to craft essential gear and structures. The game's crafting system allows for the creation of various tools, from pickaxes to shotguns, enabling you to tailor your approach to the challenges you face. The procedurally generated nature of the mines ensures that each playthrough offers a fresh experience, with new layouts, resources, and threats. The horror elements add a layer of tension, as players must constantly be on the lookout for enemies that could strike at any moment. Graphics and Design Undergoes features a stylized, hand-drawn graphical style that brings the underground environment to life with a unique aesthetic. The detailed, artistic design of the mines, coupled with dynamic lighting and shadows, enhances the game's eerie atmosphere. The diverse range of enemies and the intricate details of your drill ship and constructions add depth and a distinctive visual charm to the experience.

rows.name: Masterplan Tycoon: Foundations
rows.short_description: Foundations is a free version of Masterplan Tycoon, a minimalist resource management sim. The world is your playground: start with simple production lines for basic needs and evolve into a production powerhouse in an elegant and stress-free setting
rows.description_html: BUY THE FULL GAME About the Game This is the free first chapter of Masterplan Tycoon, a minimalist resource management sim. It will guide you through the initial missions, teaching you to identify resources, build, and set up production lines. The whole world is connected, and in Masterplan Tycoon, you take control of these connections, turning the world into a perfectly functioning production line where nothing goes to waste Your task in this game is to manage the available space and connect everything correctly so the products get delivered to the intended destination. Masterplan Tycoon depicts all the elements schematically, which means you may focus on managing the flow of resources with nothing to distract you from this exciting process. The game doesn't penalize you. Mistakes don't lead to losses. The process of immersion and learning is easy and relaxed. With each new mission, the chains will become more complex and require more ingenuity. Conduct research to facilitate resource production and monitor the system you have constructed. Build a quarry next to the mountain, build a storage facility and create a link between them. Easy enough, right? Well, now you are ready to start your journey as a logistics master. It is time to expand your production chains to new areas! Discover the minimalistic world of resource management. Take time to think about how to build chains properly. Find new resources. Change your decisions, rinse and repeat. Master the game mechanics, which at first glance might look easy.

rows.name: Perfect World
rows.short_description: Perfect World is an anti-capitalist art platformer. It is an environmentalist parable that subverts player incentivization and proposes that a sustainable future exists if we declare “I have enough.” It is a hallucination, a dream, a nightmare.
rows.description_html: Perfect World is Quake-coded grindset simulator . Extract profits from the environment by traversing open-ended levels using abilities like a grappling hook and jetpack. Finally become your own boss, buy a deluxe condo, and achieve the good life, at any cost. Features: Realistic mushroom-type gameplay. Accurate capitalism simulation. Money. Advertising. Environmental destruction. Multiple platforming abilities including a grappling hook, jetpack, and SLAM .

rows.name: Bump
rows.short_description: Keep moving. Chain your hits. Punish EVERYTHING. BUMP is a fast-paced third-person shooter where standing still is a death sentence (sorry campers). Weaponize gravity and unleash physics-based brutality in a game where you either Get Good... or Get Splattered.
rows.description_html: MAJOR UPDATE: DEDICATED SERVERS (DEC 19) No excuses. Pure skill. We killed P2P host advantage so you can really show off your skills. Consistent connections. Fair hit registration. If you lose, you can only blame your skills (or lack thereof...). This update brings a massive polish pass to the entire game, delivering the smoothest, most responsive version of BUMP to date. About the Game GET GOOD... OR GET SPLATTERED. BUMP is a fast-paced third-person shooter where standing still is a death sentence (sorry campers) . Fight for dominance across the skyline of a futuristic city, where touching the ground puts a massive target on your back. EXPLOSIVE PHYSICS Forget chipping away at health bars. In BUMP , you don't just shoot enemies, you detonate them. Explosions on Impact: Your bullets carry massive kinetic energy and explode on contact. Don't aim at them; aim around them. Use the splash damage to control their trajectory. The Ring Out: The arena is open. Your goal is to force your enemies out of the map cube. Blast them off the edge, launch them into the skybox, or slam them sideways into the void. There are no invisible walls to save them. UNCAPPED MOVEMENT CEILING The physics engine is your playground. The movement system is built to be broken, chained, and mastered. Advanced Tech: Discover hidden mechanics like the Dash-Bullet-Time (DBT) . Lock your velocity vector to become a drift missile, allowing you to fly in one direction while shooting in another. Total Fluidity: The movement logic is deep. Chain wall runs, dashes, and hovers to traverse the entire map without ever touching the floor. Infinite Skill Gap: There is no speed limit here. If you have the mechanical skill to chain your inputs, you can turn the arena into a playground where you are untouchable. KING OF THE HILL The map is a weapon. Control the Skyline: High ground is power, but the edges are dangerous. You need to control the center power positions while constantly moving to avoid being targeted. No Safe Zones: There is nowhere to hide. If you aren't fighting for position, you are already dead. THE CITY IS WATCHING BUMP brings the arcade energy back. Neon-Soaked Chaos: Immerse yourself in a vibrant, cel-shaded cyberpunk metropolis. It is loud, bright, and fast—designed to keep the adrenaline spiking. Respect the Grind: This isn't a game you just play; it's a game you master. The skill ceiling is non-existent. There is always a faster line, a harder hit, and a cleaner kill.

rows.name: Dungeon Reborn
rows.short_description: Prepare to descend into the depths of Dungeon Reborn, a thrilling RPG dungeon crawler that will test your courage and cunning. Explore treacherous dungeons, battle hordes of fearsome foes, and uncover powerful loot.
rows.description_html: Dungeon Reborn: Delve into Darkness Embark on an epic journey into the heart of Dungeon Reborn, a captivating RPG dungeon crawler where danger lurks around every corner and untold treasures await the brave. A World Plunged into Chaos For a thousand years, monsters existed only in legend. Then a colossal tower erupted from the earth, spewing forth hordes of creatures that terrorized cities and villages across the land. In response, the Hunter Guild established an elite order of warriors to push back the darkness. Your Destiny Awaits Years have passed since the last hero fell within the tower's cursed halls. Now you have been chosen to take up their mantle—to ascend the treacherous floors, face the ancient evil that lurks in the boss chambers above, and keep the monster threat contained. But beware: even defeated foes will return stronger than before if left unchecked for too long. Will you become the hero the world desperately needs, or will you join the countless souls lost to the tower's depths? Features: 🗡️ Become a Legendary Hero Ascend the mysterious tower and unlock your true potential. As you climb higher, discover rare resources to craft powerful gear and enchant your abilities. Transform from a novice adventurer into an unstoppable force of legend. ⚒️ Craft Your Arsenal Master the intricate art of creation through scavenging and experimentation. Forge devastating weapons, craft resilient armor, and brew life-saving potions. Combine different materials and unlock secret recipes to create legendary equipment that will give you the edge in even the most brutal encounters. 🌙 Conquer Nightmare Dungeons Unlock access to twisted realms corrupted by dark forces as you progress through the tower. These special dungeons harbor unique resources and unimaginable horrors. Brave their cursed depths, vanquish the corrupted monsters within, and claim exclusive rewards found nowhere else. 🔍 Unravel the Mystery A malevolent force stirs within the tower's depths, corrupting the land and spawning endless hordes of monstrous creatures. Piece together fragments of a forgotten history as you delve deeper into the abyss. Meet intriguing characters, complete challenging quests, and uncover the dark secrets behind this growing evil. Prepare to face the ultimate test of skill and courage. Forge your destiny in Dungeon Reborn.

rows.name: Roswell Ranch
rows.short_description: Howdy, stranger! Hide from a vigilant UFO, find weapon components, and protect the farm from malevolent extraterrestrial threats.
rows.description_html: Howdy, stranger! Hide from a vigilant UFO, find weapon components, and protect the farm from malevolent extraterrestrial threats. Can you save the farm? After an ominous 9-1-1 call, the police captain has sent you to investigate some strange sightings on a farm. The caller? Why, that's ol' Reed Redmond, the local conspiracy nut. At least, that's what the other residents of Roswell, New Mexico think. Little do they know, extraterrestrial threats are coming - and you can bet Reed is prepared. Unfortunately, Reed had to flee town before he could finish assembling his latest project. It's your job to find the components of BERTHA, the world's first anti-extraterrestrial firearm. Solve puzzles around the farm to find all the parts, and you might just stand a chance against those big-headed invaders! Oh, and be careful - a watchful UFO patrols the area, eager to abduct any humans it finds... Replayability Even after the game has been beaten, Roswell Ranch offers a varied experience with each playthrough. The keys needed to solve puzzles spawn in a controlled set of randomized locations. This is to ensure that items are continually difficult to find, but not so difficult that finding them is impossible (i.e., items that are required to beat the game do not spawn in the cornfield or other hard to reach areas). Additionally, upon completion, players are presented with a completion time that they can try to beat in their next playthrough. How fast can YOU save the farm? Collectibles Find all 10 UFO collectibles hidden around the map to earn an achievement and enable UFO Mode, a game mode in which BERTHA fires UFO projectiles. Alternatively, find the hidden cowboy hat to give the aliens some good ol' country style... but be warned, the cowboy hat spawns in a random location every game!

rows.short_description: A silly game about hitting a ball back and forth. Play against a friend or a computer in 12 levels awesome style.
rows.description_html: Rectangulong is a game where two paddles hit a ball back and forth and is the first video game in history to do so. Anyway here's some features and stuff that are in the game I guess. - 12 different games modes with unique 'fun' mechanics like multi ball, bouncy fish, walls of explosives, and some other stuff. - Play against a CPU or a friend on all 12 levels! Wow! Amazing! - A full manual exploring the deep lore of Rectangulong's characters and world, as well as the complex gameplay mechanics. - Lots of silly little guys. - Easter eggs maybe.
