rows.name: Solridge
rows.short_description: Solridge is an educational video game aligned with third-grade Common Core competencies. As the player, you will obtain gold by helping the townsfolk with their problems. If you want to save the village from disaster, you must continue gathering gold and growing stronger!
rows.description_html: Overview Solridge is an educational video game aligned with third-grade Common Core competencies. As the player, you will obtain gold by helping the townsfolk with their problems. If you want to save the village from disaster, you must continue gathering gold and growing stronger! All of the townsfolk's questions are presented in a word problem format, teaching students the “real-world” applications of their classroom learnings. Concepts Covered: Finding perimeter and area of 2-D figures Solving 3 digit addition and subtraction problems Solving multiplication and division problems within 100 Partitioning a quantity into equal parts and naming those parts as fractions Recount details of the text Where, when, why and how key events occur Determine meaning of words and phrases Describe characters in a story Tense practice (present/past/future) Subject verb agreement Pronoun antecedent agreement Comparatives and superlatives Capitalization of words in titles Possessive nouns Commas and quotations marks in dialogue If you come across any bugs, please email me at fastbrother@me.com . In your email, please detail the bug and how to reproduce it. I will be starting school in July, but will try to fix the bug ASAP. Thank you!

rows.name: Tales of Fearless
rows.short_description: Tales of Fearless Online is a 2D MMORPG. This old-style hardcore game has pixelated graphics that bring a nostalgic feel. With 17 unique classes and profession systems, it offers a rich and diverse gaming experience. Get ready to embark on an epic open-world adventure!
rows.description_html: I present to you Tales of Fealess (ToFo) a 2D MMORPG. The game is based on a fantasy/medieval world, where you decide to leave your home island to help in the war against the demons that have returned to invade the continent after two millennia sealed in the Underworld. When creating the account you can choose one of several races, all with their unique classes, the races and classes are: Human Physical Affinity: Rogue (DPS Single Target / High Damage Late Game, Main Stats 'AGI') Physical Affinity: Gladiator (Tank/Control) Magical Affinity: Mysticist (Wizard/Group Control) Elf Physical Affinity: Ranger (Ranged DPS / High Damage Early game, Burst Late Game, base atk passes through target, Main Stats 'AGI') Physical Affinity: Protector (Tank Single Target / Full tank, with invulnerability skills, two Taunts, one in area and barrier, best for Raid Bosses) Magical Affinity: Spiritual (Healer / Buffer, Essential for all types of roles) Orc Physical Affinity: Brutal (High DPS Melee / Full burst, class with the highest Strength in the game, Difficulty in PvP High) Magic Affinity: Warlock (High DPS Single Target / Group Control, High DPS) Tidal Physical Affinity: Viper (High DPS Melee Single Target / Full Burst One of the best classes for PvP, Main Stats 'AGI') Magic Affinity: Shaman (High DPS Burst / Off Support / Heal MP and Debuffs Clenase, PvP Late Game) Maluk Physical Affinity: Feral (High DPS Melee Single Target/Full burst, no crowd control, strongest AA of all, Insane Late Game, High PvP Difficulty) Magical Affinity: Infernal (Ultra DPS Single Target / Full Burst, Anti Fighters, Ultra Massive Damage, Medium and Late Game Insane) Dracov Physical Affinity: Lancer (Medium DPS AOE / Easy Gameplay, multiple AOE skills) Physical Affinity: Draconic Paladin (Off Tank DPS / High DPS, has Taunt, focused on Attack) Physical Affinity: Draconic Warrior (High DPS Melee / Class with high difficulty in PvP, PvE has medium difficulty) Saralos Physical Affinity: Gloomstriker (High DPS bow user, Direction skills, Class for taunt the mobs, at mass PvP is a good class) Magic Affinity: Pyromancer (High DPS AoE, most skills are in areas, best class for group farming, but it is a glass cannon). The various in-game systems ensure that players don't have to be bored, some of them are: Life skills: Fishing, mining, harvesting, forging, cooking, alchemy and many others, Guild, Guild Boss, and GvAll Castle Siege Many quests, some of which are secret. Raid bosses with difficulty, not all of them are easy. Solo and group dungeons, all of which can be done once a day. Crafts, item enchantment (at the moment only the weapon) And much more, I ask for everyone's help with ideas, and as I say, criticism is welcome. The game is in beta, that is, everything is part of a large test, and one thing or another can be modified. Thank you in advance for everyone's attention. Follow the discord where you can download and the game channel on YouTube, there are videos of all classes. Join the game's Discord: Thank you in advance for everyone's attention.

rows.name: Crossbow Quest
rows.short_description: Whether you're a seasoned gamer looking for a new challenge or someone seeking a relaxing yet engaging experience, Cross Bow Quest promises to deliver an unforgettable adventure. Sharpen your skills, find your zen, and take on the quest of a lifetime.
rows.description_html: In Cross Bow Quest, you will find yourself navigating through the intricately designed fantasy environments of a massive crossbow-focused simulation, each one demanding a unique set of skills and strategies. The game's highly detailed physics engine ensures that every shot you take is influenced by real-world factors like wind, gravity, and the tension of your bowstring. This attention to detail creates an unparalleled level of realism that will both challenge and reward you. But Cross Bow Quest is more than just a test of accuracy and reflexes. It incorporates elements of sonic-based therapeutic stimuli and task repetition hypnosis, designed to have a calming and stress-relieving effect on players. The game's ambient soundscapes and rhythmic tasks work together to create a meditative experience that helps reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. Key Features Realistic Crossbow Simulation: Experience the most accurate and detailed crossbow mechanics ever seen in a game, with physics-based interactions that require true skill and precision. Therapeutic Gameplay: Enjoy the unique combination of first-person shooter action and therapeutic elements designed to reduce stress and anxiety through sonic stimuli and repetitive tasks. Stunning Visuals: Built entirely in Unreal Engine 5, Cross Bow Quest features breathtaking graphics and immersive environments that draw you into its world. Engaging Challenges: Test your abilities in a variety of settings and scenarios, each presenting unique challenges that require strategic thinking and quick reflexes. Short and Satisfying: Perfect for quick play sessions, Cross Bow Quest offers a fulfilling experience that you can enjoy without a significant time investment.

rows.name: Grand Fantasia : ORIGIN
rows.short_description: New engine, New gameplay, New adventure, the classic MMORPG 《Grand Fantasia：ORIGIN》technological innovation, reigniting the heart of adventure, and composing a new chapter of the fantasy World with Sprites.
rows.description_html: New engine, New gameplay, New adventure, the classic MMORPG 《Grand Fantasia：ORIGIN》technological innovation, bringing an unprecedented gaming experience. Players can explore, fight, and grow in a broader world. Embark on a new adventure journey with your Guardian Sprite. [Engine Fully Upgraded] From the land to the forest, Rivers to the ocean, Villages to towns, the game's graphics will be significantly enhanced! From small details like water ripples and ground plants to large elements like lighting, shadows, and building scenery, everything has been upgraded to be more magnificent and refined, allowing players to once again experience the fantastical and beautiful continent of Saphael. [Classic Class Gameplay Returns ] In recent years, Class adjustments have significantly changed the gameplay that players were accustomed to with their original class. In this Orgin, we will restore the previous gameplay basics, allowing players to reclaim their most powerful and proficient playstyles and return to adventuring in Grand Fantasia! [Optimizations and Remakes] Compared to previous versions, the Orgin version will feature more optimizations, including batch synthesis, quick split flow, reduced loading times, quick gear switching, and Archive system, allowing players to reminisce about past adventures while enjoying the various convenient operations common in modern games. [Multilingual Translation] In this global version, in addition to the existing Chinese language, it will also support 'English, Japanese,' and other languages, allowing more players worldwide to join our big family~ [Orgin Version Exclusive New Class] In Grand Fantasia, each Class has its unique gameplay. By combining Talent Cards and equipment, every player can create their own unique style. In the Orgin version, a mysterious new Class will join the World of Grand Fantasia. Let's look forward to it together!

rows.name: Fortress Fury
rows.short_description: Fortress Fury is a survivor multiplayer tower defense roguelite. Endless hordes of enemies want to crush your tower! Buy weapons and upgrades to craft an array of overpowering builds. Will you be able to survive all waves and be the last tower?
rows.description_html: Roadmap About the Game Fortress Fury Multiplayer Tower Defense. Roguelite Chaos. Pure Survival. The monsters have arrived, and there is nowhere left to run. Build your tower, hold your ground, and outlast everyone else. When every other fortress has fallen, only yours will remain. Collect gold, upgrade your weapons, and crush rival players in quick, intense sessions that never play the same way twice. Key Features Dynamic Builds: Choose from more than 16 weapons and experiment with countless combinations. Every run is unique. Competitive Ranks: Prove your skill in live matches and climb the global leaderboards. Evolving Arsenal: Unlock new towers and upgrades as you refine your defenses. Fast, Addictive Sessions: Designed for 10 to 20 minute bursts of chaos. Easy to start, impossible to quit.

rows.name: Lamplight
rows.short_description: Lamplight is a 3D mind-bending puzzle platformer where you defy gravity and warp your perception. Navigate a labyrinth of rooms where walls become floors, ceilings become pathways, and time bends unexpectedly. Unravel the secrets hidden within this distorted world - are you ready to be challenged?
rows.description_html: Lamplight is a mind-bending 3D puzzle platformer that will challenge your sense of reality. Defy gravity and bend time as you navigate a labyrinthine world where walls become floors, ceilings transform into pathways, and the very fabric of space warps to your will. Master the Unstable: Physics Gone Wild: Think outside the box (or the room, rather) as you manipulate gravity and experiment with the environment to solve ingenious puzzles. Elusive Gameplay: Navigate a world where time itself becomes a tool. Unwind past actions, manipulate the present, and unlock the secrets hidden within this distorted reality. A World of Mystery: Unravel the Enigma: Lamplight's hauntingly beautiful environments hold hidden clues and secrets waiting to be discovered. Explore, experiment, and piece together the narrative woven throughout this surreal world. Embrace the Challenge: Can you master the warped physics and temporal paradoxes? Lamplight will test your wit, creativity, and ability to think laterally. Are you ready to step into a world where up is down, time is fluid, and the only limit is your imagination? Enter Lamplight and see the impossible become reality.

rows.description_html: BREAKER: INITIATING is a short 3D game featuring platforming and puzzle-solving elements. You step into the role of El , a robot equipped with electrical discharge abilities. Navigate through a desolate world, using El's unique powers to overcome obstacles and explore mysterious environments. In a post-apocalyptic world, humans entered cryogenic facilities to hibernate, and the abandoned machines gradually evolved a new mechanical ecosystem. A robot that was sealed in a facility, was accidentally released. It then began to explore the outside world…

rows.name: Leglakh: Prologue
rows.short_description: Leglakh Prologue is a single player tribute to Tom Proudfoots 1994 classic Nahlakh. Form your party of eight champions from knights, archers, mages, and clerics. Fight against hordes of various enemies to gather what is needed to defeat the prime demon Leglakh.
rows.description_html: Leglakh Prologue is a single player tribute to Tom Proudfoots 1994 classic Nahlakh. Form your party of eight champions from knights, archers, mages, and clerics. Fight against hordes of various enemies to gather what is needed to defeat the prime demon Leglakh. Leglakh has awoken, and with the awakening the previously timid animals have become hostile, and some of them have started to bleed green blood. Tribes of kobolds, orcs and hobgoblins are on the warpath, and even dragons have been spotted circling the skies. The combat happens in real time via a programmable autobattler, where you customise the ai of your champions for offensive and defensive. Leglakh Prologue only contains one island and a simplified ai setup, but the full game will include more classes, an inventory system, character development and huge continents to discover and dungeons to raid.

rows.name: East Wood Carnival
rows.short_description: A PSX retro horror game made by a sixth grader. Your car runs out of gas on your way to an abandoned carnival now infested with danger at every corner.
rows.description_html: EPISODE 1: EAST WOOD CARNIVAL (Remake Coming Soon)   A PlayStation One styled horror game made by a sixth grader. Your car runs out of gas on your way to an abandoned carnival now infested with danger at every corner. You have no friends, no hope, and are all alone in your endeavor for escape. This is a linear horror experience in which you will solve basic puzzles to escape the carnival, but don't forget that you are not alone. Keep a keen eye out for danger, it just might save your life. As you desperately try to escape you might just wonder why you wanted to come here in the first place. So are you up for the challenge? WATCH YOUR BACK At every corner there is danger, so be careful. SOLVE PUZZLES Flip levers to open doors and power up objects to progress.

rows.name: Project: ICARUS
rows.short_description: Travel with Curias to the ancient greek future and go on a research mission about black holes. Explore the edge of space and time in this rogue-lite management game!
rows.description_html: The player controls scientist “Curias” aboard the ICARUS - a black hole research facility - who tries to balance the ship’s distance to the black hole while gathering data. They must fulfill research tasks, upload them to the DÆDALUS mothership and further their understanding of the strange events, developing new technology through their funding. All the while fixing and navigating the occurring problems that come with… existing at the edge of space and time. The goal of this game is to gather as much data about the black hole as you can. To do that you have to accept research missions and fulfill them by interacting with strange anomalies or with research stations on your ship. While doing your missions you have to keep the ship running by repairing broken stations and always remember to keep your space ship at a safe distance from the black hole. From completing missions you unlock abilities that allow you to manage your time more efficiently to do even more research missions, like quantum tunneling or Ariadne's String which give you time and space bending powers. When you eventually fall into the black hole your collected research data is converted into funding for further missions which can be spent on upgrades that will help you survive longer on your next mission.

rows.name: Romanizer
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in Roman history with this management game! Gain acceptance of the goddess Cybele into the pantheon of Roman gods, influence public opinion, and go through many historical events. Will you be able to get Cybele adopted by the Romans?
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in Roman history with this captivating management game where your mission is to make the Phrygian goddess Cybele accepted into the Roman pantheon. Influence public opinion, meet charismatic poets, and navigate through tumultuous historical events. But beware, a bad decision could easily condemn the goddess to be rejected by the Roman population! Can you convince the Romans to worship Cybele? Meet famous Roman poets Meet Martial, Juvenal, Lucretius, Virgil or Ovid, and try to convince them to sing the praises of the goddess Cybele. Other famous Romans will also cross your path, and you can even ask for help from the gods! Make strategic choices In Romanizer, each of your actions has consequences - positive for some poets, and negative for others. It's up to you to find the balance that will best satisfy all the parties and access the Pantheon of Roman gods! Live historical events Conflicts, revolts, assassinations... Many historical events, different from game to game, will disrupt your strategy and challenge your ability to adapt. Discover - or help discover - Roman history If Romanizer is first and foremost a video game, it is suitable for use in the classroom, under the supervision of a teacher, to introduce many concepts of Roman society: religion, acculturation, romanization, beliefs, poetry and poets, theater, etc. Credits Game Designer: Thibaut Sowa Programmers: Erwan Castioni, Antonin Lesoudier Graphic designer: maevb Sound Designer: Akarius Pedagogical consultant: William Brou / Les Clionautes Historical consultant: Elodie Bouhier Help: Thomas Brasdefer, Waël Hadj Mouldi This game was created at the Scientific Game Jam in Lyon in March 2021, where it won the Jury prize. Association Les Clionautes supported the post-game jam development. Association La Science Entre En Jeu helped to make release the game on Steam

rows.name: Hunter's Arena: Revolution
rows.short_description: “Hunter’s Arena Revolution” merges survival and escape elements of the extraction genre with thrilling combat action, offering an accessible yet immersive gaming experience.
rows.description_html: Escape, Survive, and Extort Hunter’s Arena: Revolution is an exhilarating and adventurous action set in the Ancient East. Combine various skills, equipment, and tactics to survive and escape a world full of enemies. If you don’t, you may lose all your precious belongings. In In Ancient Asia Hunter’s Arena’s expansive map is filled with exquisite oriental beauty. At the same time, the solemness of the ruins of war exists. This is a place where all the resources are rare. Explore hidden locations to obtain these various resources. However, you must be careful at all times to ensure survival. Between the buildings and the forest, there are many others like yourself looking for resources. A a Strategic Battle with Various Weapons & Skills Fortunately, your character is a natural fighter and can fight with any weapon. Survive using weapons and skills that are appropriate for each situation. The Last Survivor Takes All Survivors have everything to gain. All loot and treasures acquired during battle are yours to keep. Now you can strengthen yourself in the safety of the lobby. Upgrade your Shop and combine your weapons and skills to make yourself stronger. However, remember this. The easiest way to become stronger is to skill and loot others.

rows.name: The Day Of Survival
rows.short_description: The Day Of Survival Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where every decision is crucial. 'The Day Of Survival' is a thrilling survival game that challenges players to explore a harsh, unforgiving landscape filled with zombies and enemy soldiers.
rows.description_html: 'The Day Of Survival' is an exciting action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. In this devastated scenario, players take on the role of survivors who fight to ensure their survival in the midst of a devastated environment full of dangers. The plot unfolds in a vast territory, where resources are scarce and threats are always present, from zombies to other survivors. The game combines elements of exploration, construction and combat, providing an immersive experience. Players must explore the environment in search of supplies, build shelters to protect themselves from dangers for their survival. The realistic graphics and immersive soundtrack help create a dark and intense atmosphere that keeps players constantly on their toes. Challenging gameplay requires careful strategy and quick decisions, making each day a continuous fight for survival. Whether facing hordes of enemies, exploring unexplored territories or building a secure base, 'The Day Of Survival' offers an exciting and challenging experience for fans of survival and action games. Get ready to test your skills and resilience in a world where every day could be your last.

rows.description_html: Would You Call Him a Bad Man? is a playable music video filled with fast-paced TIN¥ GAMES , each lasting less than five seconds. Can you beat enough TIN¥ GAMES to unlock Ava's Happy Ending ? Play as Ava, a waitress at Big Pittie's Bar & Grill. After losing her job unfairly, she must navigate the dark underbelly of an uncaring world... Play fast-paced TIN¥ GAMES that will rely on your wits and reaction time Anime visual novel-style art punctuated with pixel graphics Clear enough TIN¥ GAMES to unlock Ava's Happy Ending and hear an extended guitar solo Ten (and no more) hidden secrets to discover Rhythm-based chorus boss battles TIN¥ GAMES last just a few seconds. Complete the task before the countdown reaches zero! Collect! Select! Drive! Aim! Text on each TIN¥ GAME will guide you in your task! This game is free because it is a short experimental music video by Ian Hinden. There are no microtransactions, and this game does not collect any data.

rows.name: Into the Wild
rows.short_description: Into the Wild is a tense yet tranquil survival game where nature holds nothing back. Inspired by the Norwegian hinterlands, the haunting valley of Jegersdal offers a faithful survival experience. Witness the magnificent aurora and search for answers amid the ruins of yesterday.
rows.description_html: Lost and alone in a snow-smothered valley, surrounded by beauty yet mired in terrible danger; your story may be your own, but it will end like all the others. Into the Wild is a tense yet tranquil survival game where nature holds nothing back. Inspired by the Norwegian hinterlands, the haunting valley of Jegersdal offers a faithful survival experience. Witness the magnificent aurora, scavenge from the remains of those who came before and find whatever means you can to prolong the inevitable end. Learn to Survive Unprepared and unready, you must equip and arm yourself as fast as you can if you hope to endure the perils of Jegersdal. Find shelter and clothes to ward off the cold, food to sate ever-present hunger and tools to orient yourself in an unfamiliar environment. Reactive Music Immersion reaches new heights in the survival genre with music that listens to the player as much as the player listens to it. Certain actions will cause the music to react as it measures the player’s intention , not only the consequences of their choice. Furthermore, when the weather changes, so too does the symphony of the valley - and you would be wise to listen. Uncover Lost Mysteries Littered throughout the valley are messages, notes, journals and other documents, left by those who came before you. Sequestered away in ragged shelters, derelict shacks and dismal caves, the secret history of Jegersdal is just waiting to be discovered. But be warned - piecing together the harrowing tales of the valley’s inhabitants is no easy task, and you must employ every tool at your disposal if you wish to do so before your own story comes to its inexorable end. Surrendering to the Wild Death comes; it is only a matter of time. Starvation and freezing are reflected by real-world thresholds for an intuitive experience. Much like in real life, however, there are many ways to miscalculate your odds of survival, and every mistake could prove fatal. Survive for as long as you can to discover the full breadth of Jegersdal - and all of its grim tales from the survivors before you. On higher difficulties, death is permanent, and the consequences of your actions become even more extreme. Unwanted Visitor Jegersdal does not permit trespassers. Weather and temperature effects fluctuate frequently, and must be accounted for when setting out on your endeavors. Through understanding Mother Nature’s fickle whims and forfeiting yourself to them, you might just prolong your inevitable fate.

rows.name: Creepy Waves FM: Bugs Fixer
rows.short_description: A young and promising boy applies for a job at a AAA game development company. As he starts working night shifts on probation, he experiences a series of events that could lead to no good. As the story unfolds, you will be able to choose what you would do in his place.
rows.description_html: PLOT A young and promising boy goes for an interview at a major AAA game development company. He is offered a position with a probationary period on night shifts. While performing his tasks in the office, he becomes the subject of a series of events that could lead to no good. What would you do if you were in his place? Will your actions lead you to salvation, or will you become a tragic victim of someone hiding in the dark? GAMEPLAY This is a short, atmospheric psychological horror where you play as a 16-year-old boy applying for his first job at a big game development company. You can interact with different people, fix bugs in prototype games as part of your work routine, and follow some daily routines as the plot unfolds.

rows.name: GameOver
rows.short_description: GameOver is a text based rpg focused mainly on m/m content with character driven plot. In it, you explore and run into inhabitants of the world. Some friendly, some foe. Inspired by other text based games and some videos.
rows.description_html: GameOver is a character plot driven narrative visual novel/interactive that revolves around you meeting characters and getting into game-overs with them to progress time. Focuses on M/M interactions, romance, friendship, and relationships.                  ----------------------------------------------------------------- You've just woken up after entering a small little town during your travels, but what's this about the rumors about you and the way you came from being... Blocked by... Something? Are the rumors really about you? Or someone else? Yet when you go out to find out and end up getting too familiar with the locals, why do you wake up in your room? No one seems to remember anything ever happening, while you on the otherhand... All this seems to be playing out like in your dreams? But... Is it really a dream? Or something else? Explore the town and get familiar with the locals. But be mindful of your condition, you wouldn't want to wear yourself out or anything of the sort. Someone might take advantage of it. And you can't shake the feeling that something wrong is with this town... But what is it? ABit About How The Game Works Your Heath is drained whenever you have to do some form of work, or have to get in an altercation of some kind. Your Stamina is drained as you walk around the town and physically exhaust yourself. Your Lust increases as you find yourself in physical contact with others.[br][br]Be wary of your stats as people might or might not notice these things. Changing what they'd like you to do for them, or do with you. And when one reaches too low or high... It might just be A

rows.name: Last Heist
rows.short_description: Last Heist is a multiplayer horror-heist game. Looters must steal valuables and escape, but one player is secretly the Killer, sabotaging and eliminating the others to keep the loot for themselves.
rows.description_html: Core Gameplay Multiplayer Heists Every match, one player is the Killer. The others are Looters, working together to steal valuable items scattered across the map. The Looter Objective Explore the map to find valuable items on shelves or behind objects such as locked doors. These objectives may require cooperation to complete. Extraction & Teamwork Transport stolen goods to the escape trucks to reach your collective money goal and win. Use in-game voice chat to coordinate routes, call out danger. The Killer’s Arsenal The Killer isn’t just another monster; they’re one of you. Disguise yourself and strike when no one is looking. Set C4 traps on items, plant landmines , or take them down with a weapon. Features Dynamic Objectives Objectives change each match, with varying room layouts, item spawns, and events that force players to adapt, no two heists are the same. Stealth and Chaos Both Looters and the Killer must weigh stealth vs. speed. Make too much noise and risk giving away your position or bait others into a trap. Voice Chat with Proximity Audio Strategize or sabotage with your mic. Sound travels, and someone’s always listening.

rows.name: Brainwave Trials
rows.short_description: Brainwave Trials presents itself as a first-person puzzle-platformer experience where the player takes the role of a volunteer within the Garnet Research And Development Sector. By utilizing parkour mechanics and dimensional manipulation, the player will be able to overcome the trials of science.
rows.description_html: Brainwave Trials is a single player game set in the 22nd century. The player takes control of a volunteer for the Garnet Research And Development Sector in their technological development trials. The research facility imbibes the volunteer with enhanced physical abilities and dimensional manipulation abilities in order to progress through the test chambers of the facility. The player will need to think 'outside of the box' to overcome the challenges and trials that await them, gaining access to all new abilities within each chamber. By using a combination of their innate physical ability, enhanced parkour traversal, and dimensional manipulation, players will be able to solve the puzzles that await them. As the player progresses, reality destabilizes around them, causing them to wonder what harm the advance of science might incur on reality.

rows.name: Kando Realm
rows.short_description: Journey into the world of Kando. Take on creatures, craft awesome weapons, help villagers and cut down tree's. Will you slay your way to the top? Or become a master craftsman. It's all down to you.
rows.description_html: WELCOME =============== Journey into the world of Kando. Take on creatures, craft awesome weapons, help villagers and cut down tree's. Will you slay your way to the top? Or become a master craftsman. It's all down to you. SKILLS =============== Kando Realm focuses not only on the combat side of the game but has a separate skill levelling system inspired by that of Old School Runescape for it's crafting and gathering. Currently we have 4 crafting and 4 gathering skills unlocked but will be adding much more as the game develops. CLASS SYSTEM =============== In Kando Realm you start out as a villager and you learn the ropes about helping the people of the world of Kando. In return you level up and get stronger until level 10. At level 10 you can choose to study under a specific craft such as : -Warrior -Mage -Druid -Thief Each of these classes have special abilities and class specific pros and cons including class specific quest lines. WANT TO GET IN? =============== Simply join the discord:  to get information! CROSS PLATFORM ================ Play on mobile or PC and join in on a shared world and play with people from different platforms and regions! CUSTOMIZATION ============== Create and customize your characters with hundreds of items and equipment from sticks to snake heads. Themed areas and equipment allow you to be what you want. Want to be that plate armour wearing Warrior or the onesie lollipop Druid? It's up to you! OLD SCHOOL FEEL =============== 2D oldschool MMORPG mechanics allow you to put your stat points into what you want and build your class the way you want! COMMUNITY =========== Join the community today in game and on Discord to see the latest news and updates going into Kando Realm (2D mmorpg). LOOT AND DUNGEONS =================== With dungeons to do and lots of loot to collect for your class and character you won't be bored anytime soon! PROFESSIONS ============ Not interested in combat? Simply want to be a fisher, woodcutter or miner then grab your tools and come join us! CRAFTING ========= Do you have a mind for the creative? Then lets see how well you fair at crafting!

rows.description_html: This is the free Prologue of Crack it Up! In this version, you will be able to complete your first collection and experience the main mechanics of the game. Open one pack after another in this relaxing card collection game. Buy packs from different collections. Premium booster packs with high chance of exclusive rare variants. Booster boxes with a lot of packs for less money. Relaxing pack opening gameplay. As an avid card collector, you will end up with a big collection of cards, sell your duplicates and your rarest cards for profit in a webpage. Manage your economy and get the best deals in a changing trading card market. Use your retro computer to sell cards in an online store. A dynamic card market, the price of the cards change over time, sell at the right time to maximize your profit. Manage your economy, ¿Will you sell that rare card for a lot of money or will you keep it for your collection? As a card collecting enthusiast you will have different collections to complete, each one with hundreds of cards and rare variants with high value. Complete up to 5 different card collections. Hundreds of cards with rare variants. Scroll through your collection albums and inspect your precious trading cards.

rows.description_html: Wishlist Campaign Rewards from the Wishlist Registration Campaign! About the Game “METRIA” is an action RPG where you traverse the stage of the story, the “Continent of Ronatis”, which is composed of 9 countries, with unique characters. As you overcome formidable enemies that stand in your way, you aim for the truth of the world. Immerse yourself in the world of 'METRIA', brimming with diverse elements of adventure. Experience a fantasy RPG brought to life with stunning 3D graphics, a battle system that comes alive with dazzling actions and dramatic cut-in performances. Get lost in exploration elements that tempt you to stray off the beaten path, and enjoy multiplayer content online with friends. All these and more await you in 'METRIA'. - An Epic Fantasy Journey Across 9 Countries with Unique Characters - You will be controlling unique characters including the apprentice knight 'Rio Calquinos', the demi-human girl 'Aru', the Astra knight 'Lucas Nizam', and etc. to explore 'Ronatis', the continent where the story takes place. You will have to defeat formidable enemies that get in your way and aim to discover the truth about the world. - Fun Battle with a Team of 3! It Gets More Exciting with Flashy Effects and Animatios! - The occasional battles during the story are real-time action battles fought with a team of 3. Experience speedy combats while using various actions such as dodge, jump, and skills. Each character possesses powerful unique skills (special moves) with flashy animations that add more excitement to the battle! - Felling trees, mining ores, and many more things to explore and craft to make your journey colorful! - There are many activities you can do such as felling trees, mining ores, fishing, picking plants, and many more things that make you wanna stop by and explore! You can create various items and gear by taking the materials you have collected to the base. ――You woke up to find yourself standing on an unknown land. Through various meetings and farewells, you will find the hidden truth of this world.

rows.name: Dirty League 🔞
rows.short_description: Assemble a team of 5 daring girls and compete against other heroes in captivating match-3 team battles. Discover the best combination among hundreds of abilities and effects that will help you rise to the top of the Pleasure Tower and claim the throne of the universe’s greatest champion!
rows.description_html: Hundreds of beautiful girls are captured by horrible monsters, who exploit them to extract magical energy. You'll embark on adventures in dungeons, aboard pirate ships, and through forgotten temples to rescue these hostages from their vile captors. Defeat the guards and decide the fate of the prisoners. Remember, each girl’s release grants you new magical powers and skills, which you can use to compete in the Pleasure Tower, where the best heroes vie for the Stud Throne! Immerse yourself in captivating match-3 battle gameplay where you align elemental gems to unleash magical techniques and triumph in combat. Craft ingenious strategies by combining hundreds of abilities and effects, tailoring your approach to each unique opponent. Dynamic Role System: Each girl you collect enhances your team's capabilities, making every acquisition meaningful and impactful. Vast Character Roster: Amass a diverse collection of hundreds of characters, each brought to life with stunning high-resolution animations and compelling backstories. Strategic Progression: Utilize special items to amplify your team's abilities and fuel your adventures. Engaging Weekly Events: Dive into riveting storylines that offer opportunities to recruit new characters, acquire valuable items, and gather resources to bolster your team's strength.

rows.name: Slice Of Ages
rows.short_description: A top down action rpg with rougelike elements. You'll encounter plenty of opposition trying to make your way to the Slice of Ages. Slice your way through hordes of enemies with unique relics in order to stop Dastardly Duck.
rows.description_html: Slice and dice your way through enemies in this top-down action roguelike. Take advantage of special relics to reach the magical macguffin: the Slice of Ages. The Slice of Ages is heavily guarded by the evil forces of Dastardly Duck deep within his dungeon. While descending his dungeon, the hero, Duck Knight, will encounter a lot of opposition; even others trying to retrieve the Slice of Ages. Relics will help you on your descent. Some greatly increase your attack speed while others will cause you to explode at random. And just try not to lose Duck Knight's head while trying to get the Slice of Ages.

rows.name: Catacombs
rows.short_description: In Catacombs, you control Tabby, a street cat on his way to visit a friend in the afterlife. Unfortunately, Osiris himself forbade your entry and ordered his minions to stop you. Venture deep into the catacombs, pouncing to assume control over his minions, all to foil the will of the gods!
rows.description_html: Seize control of ancient Egyptian enemies while on a journey to the afterlife in Catacombs, a purr -ific action-strategy game! Orange Cat Energy! In  Catacombs , you play as Tabby, an orange street cat on his way to visit a recently-passed friend in the afterlife. Unfortunately, Osiris himself forbade your entry to the underworld and ordered his minions to patrol its entrance. Don’t let that stop you; venture deep into the catacombs, pouncing on and assuming control over supernatural minions, all while foiling the will of the gods with pure orange cat energy! Plan... Scout out your unsuspecting enemies before attacking and concoct a perfectly chaotic plan for annihilation. Dodge... Weave in and out of enemy sightlines and dodge projectiles. Careful-- one hit and Tabby is knocked out! Pounce! Pounce on enemies' heads to take control over them , and use their own abilities to defeat your other foes and conquer the underworld! The keen, precise jackal throws bones at staggering speeds! The divine, spiritual falcon summons pillars of light to vaporize anything in its path! The bulky, menacing mummy tanks multiple hits to pummel its enemies with nothing but its fists ! All of these powers are under your control with nothing but orange cat energy. How will you enact chaos on the Egyptian underworld?

rows.name: Terra Inferno
rows.short_description: Humans are ruining the lush world of Terra Inferno! Embody nature's wrath in this Turn-Based Tactics meets Resource Management Game, evoke natural calamities to devastate the human onslaught!
rows.description_html: Disclaimer This game was a student project worked on by 10 seniors at Drexel University. Those who worked on it, and their roles, can be found in the credits page in the game. Gameplay In Terra Inferno, play as Florians as you defend your planet from invading humans who want to take over the planet for it's valuable resources. The player has the power of the planet to fight back. Use Terramancy, or natural calamaties, to defend with abilities such as: Toranado Volcanic Debris Tsunami Rain and more! But the Humans will not go down easy! You will fight three distinct characters: Lil Human, Mega Mech, and the Tank! Use the Florians such as the Kraken and Lava worm to fight against their invasion!

rows.name: Fishing Grind
rows.short_description: Fishing Grind is a first person 1-6 player co-op fishing game with a twist. The place you are fishing may not always be safe...
rows.description_html: Fishing is not a hobby, it's a mindset. It is only reserved for the most dedicated among us. The extensive knowledge and experience required to be a full-time fisherman weeds out the weak and discourages even the strong. This job is not an easy one, but if you think you are up to it then... Who is stopping you? Hop on the Fishing Grind. Fishing Grind is a Coop/Singleplayer experience where you and up to five friends can fish in the various environments of the North American wilderness. Most of the locations you visit are relatively safe, but some places have threats. Bears, sharks, and even other humans that will test the limits of your strength. How far will you go to get just one more catch? GAMEPLAY Partake in riveting and innovative fishing gameplay. Start your journey with almost nothing and steadily build up your collection of rods, lures, and hooks! Realism can be fun in some games, but when working on Fishing Grind our team found that a less 'realistic' approach turned out to be more fun. This creative choice also allowed for us to simplify some mechanics; these decisions will hopefully make the game easier to pick up for new players while still keeping veteran players invested! CO-OP Fishing by yourself can get pretty lonely, so Fishing Grind supports six player lobbies! What are you waiting for? Download Fishing Grind and start playing! DISCORD Join our Discord server to get involved with the community, report bugs, and request features!

rows.name: Eden Survivors
rows.short_description: Fight. Flirt. Save the galaxy. Eden Survivors combines rogue-like action, mech-building, and steamy Visual Novel storytelling. Recruit gorgeous heroines, battle through 30 epic levels and explore a universe where love and danger collide. Your adventure, your story, your desires.
rows.description_html: Ever wanted to save the galaxy and fall in love? Now’s your chance. A wild mix of rogue-like action, Visual Novel storytelling, and unapologetic adult content. Step into the boots of ACE – engineer by day, vigilante by night. Lead a team of badass heroines, build a killer mech, and fight to save the galaxy from total destruction. Flirt, seduce, and get tangled up in unforgettable romances with the galaxy’s hottest babes. Whether you’re facing off against deadly enemies or navigating the thrill of forbidden love, Eden Survivors delivers an adventure that’s as intense as it is seductive. 80,000 Words of Narrative Feast : Romance, mystery, and intergalactic chaos—it’s like your favorite space opera but with more steamy moments. Romance and Relationships : Every heroine brings her own unique skills and story to the table. Flirt, chat, and gift your way into their hearts. (or at least their good side) When you're not fighting monsters, you’re managing the galaxy’s coolest hangout. The Eden Bar : Your home base for adventure, intrigue, and some seriously questionable decisions. Strategize Like a Pro : Attract patrons, rake in profits, and unlock more heroines. Every choice matters—no pressure. Make It Personal : Flirt with your squad, uncover their secrets, and unlock special events. Suit up, Commander. Things are about to get hot! Mech Customization : Assign your heroines, stack over 500+ upgrades in different builds, and create combos so OP they’ll make the devs blush. 140 Monsters, 30 Levels, 40 Bosses : From space bugs to galaxy-crushing titans, every chapter is a new challenge. Clash Mode : Take on epic bosses in ranked multiplayer. Start in Iron and grind your way to the Master division. Dynamic Game Modes : Got stuck on the main story? Plenty more action to be had: trial mode, skill trees, unique daily and weekly events. So, what kind of player are you? The tactician , meticulously crafting the perfect mech? The storyteller , unraveling romances and galactic intrigue? Or maybe the stud , here to conquer hearts as well as the galaxy? Or maybe all three? Whatever your style, Eden Survivors has you covered. Suit up, Commander!

rows.name: Toilet Zone
rows.short_description: Pilot a flying toilet and avoid hitting the walls and enemies. Can you make it to the end?
rows.description_html: Can you escape the void and make it back home? You were just sitting on your toilet, minding your own business, when a portal opened in front of you. Not only that, but your toilet just suddenly blasted off on its own, with you on it! Now you'll have to use the water-powered flight of your toilet to navigate different worlds and return home. But be careful around the walls; your toilet is a bit fragile. Controls Fly with W, Rotate with A and D Gameplay Fly through the level without touching walls or enemies. Extra Features Supports Xbox Controllers Speedrun Timer

You can easily see the time spent in the game. You can keep challenging yourself to get better results. You can also compete with your friends to beat the level faster. If you're bored and tired of playing some complex games, try this simple simple simple mini-game. In a word It's fun, it's not complicated. How to play: Move metal ring from start to finish Don‘t touch anything Pay attention to the time it takes About control commands： There are instructions in the lower left corner of the game scene.

rows.name: Night Of The Abattoir Man
rows.short_description: The story of Michael D'Amato, a young 23-year-old man who flies to New York with the intention of starring in his uncle's new horror movie. However, he finds himself in a real-life horror scenario as he becomes the target of a 10-foot-tall maniac known as the Abattoir Man.
rows.description_html: STORY: The story of Michael D'Amato, a young 23-year-old man who flies to New York with the intention of starring in his uncle's new horror movie. However, he finds himself in a real-life horror scenario as he becomes the target of a 10-foot-tall maniac known as the Abattoir Man. Gameplay: In the game, players can choose to play either as Michael D'Amato, the victim, or as Trevor Hartman, the Abattoir Man himself. If playing as Michael, the goal is to run, hide, set traps, solve puzzles, and collect four keys needed to escape. The game is designed to be tense and scary while also incorporating humor, creating a unique experience that doesn't take itself too seriously but still aims to instill a sense of dread and terror. Features: - The game allows you to play as two characters: Michael D'Amato, the victim, or Trevor Hartman, the Abattoir Man. - The graphics are inspired by anime and the look of old 80s MS-DOS and Commodore 64 games, giving it a nice retro style charm. - The game features multiple endings, encouraging replayability.

rows.name: GastroRun
rows.short_description: Gastro Run is a fast-paced educational adventure game full of obstacles, boss fights, races, withlessons placed throughout the game. You play as Gastro, a witty nano-bot whose goal is to help patients with enzyme deficiency break down food as it travels through the digestive system.
rows.description_html: Gastro Run is a fast-paced educational adventure game full of obstacles, boss fights, races, with lessons placed throughout the game. You play as Gastro, a witty nano-bot whose goal is to help patients with enzyme deficiency break down food as it travels through the digestive system. Enter the human’s GI tract and shoot enzymes as you observe how food breaks down in different organs. Race Nutrient stealing “leechers” in the winding twists and turns of the small intestine. Defend the stomach walls from attacking germs to finally cure the patient. This game will test your flying and shooting accuracy while teaching you about the human digestive system. FEATURES: ● Shoot enzymes to break down food and defeat germs ● Collect booster bubbles and fly past nutrient stealing leechers! ● Collect stars at the end of each level and unlock rewards and upgrades! ● Avoid obstacles like incoming food and fly through intestinal blockages! ● Watch out for clues and hints during popup videos! ● A Unique combination of fun & learning.

rows.name: Starborne: Frontiers
rows.short_description: Starborne: Frontiers is a free-to-play tactical autobattler with hundreds of unique ships. Form your fleet, customize it with a variety of equipment, and use strategy to create the perfect battlefield formation. Take on bounties, engage in the PvP arena, and bring order to the Frontier.
rows.description_html: 400 years from now, Earth has perished, and humanity has made its home among the stars. The struggle for a place in space has left a lasting legacy of internal conflicts and brutal faction wars. The galaxy is divided among 10 warring factions, each with its own agenda. Factions like the Children of the Everliving seek eternal life at any cost, while MPL aims for profit, and Tianchao combats corruption with vast spy networks. The Abyss The Abyss appeared without warning, causing chaos in the Frontier. As a commander, your ultimate goal is to discover the secrets of the Abyss and prevent it from consuming everything in its path. This exploration-rich game mode lets you choose your path and make crucial command decisions that determine your rewards. Game Modes and Challenges PvE Content: Enjoy a story-rich campaign and tackle challenging bounties. PvP Arena: Test your skills against other players in strategic space battles. The Vault: Join an alliance and raid the vault for valuable resources. The Abyss: Uncover secrets and make pivotal decisions in this exploration-focused mode. Recruit Unique Pilots Collect over 100 ships, each with unique abilities and backstories. Upgrade your fleet and pilots with powerful enhancements to dominate space. Deep Customization Customize your ships with a variety of weapons, shields, and software. Utilize up to 6 gear slots and collect powerful implants for limitless possibilities. Tailor your fleet to your strategic needs and battle preferences. Master Your Tactics Use strategic tactics to defeat powerful enemies and progress towards becoming a legendary commander. Plan your moves carefully to create the perfect fleet combination, and choose formations based on your ships’ unique targeting patterns to maximize your battle effectiveness. Limited-Time Events Engage in exciting events and themed holiday bounties. Participate in community-wide challenges and step into the commander's arcade with mini-games like Gelecek Survivor. Explore the Galaxy In Starborne: Frontiers, the vast galaxy is your battleground. Use strategy and tactics to navigate through the sci-fi universe, conquering challenges and building your legacy among the stars. Experience the thrill of strategic space battles as you command your fleet in this sci-fi adventure. Master the art of strategy and immerse yourself in a sci-fi epic where your choices shape the fate of the galaxy. Engage in strategic planning and sci-fi battles to become the ultimate commander in Starborne: Frontiers. Strategy is essential in every aspect of this sci-fi universe, and your tactical decisions will determine your success.

rows.name: G.E.A.R: Great Engineers Are Rats
rows.short_description: A first person game with 2D, realistically simulated, physics-based puzzles.
rows.description_html: DISCLAIMER G.E.A.R is a Free to Play demo version that is missing many features like progress saving, optimizations and QoL improvements. The game will not be updated or receive any bug fixes. About the game Save the resort! After receiving a distress call from a wildlife resort, you and you rat companion Gustavo embark on a mission to fix the surrounding wind turbines. For years, the park had been inhabited by a family of rats who have now mysteriously disappeared. Unfortunately, their presence has left the park inoperable. Destroyed by rats, saved by another. There's something poetic there, no? Without the turbines functioning, the resort's filtration system could malfunction, so a lot is at stake! Can you save the animals? Challenge yourself with a series of unique physics-based puzzles. Arrive at the park, help Gustavo solve innovative puzzles using realistically simulated physics in order to fix all wind turbines. See the environment change as you make progress in your maintenance! Explore the wind park, take in the beautiful scenery and relax. Each level more challenging than the last, use the supplied objects to clear a path to the exit! Bombs, fans, gears and more are at your disposal. How will you solve each puzzle? The fate of the wildlife resort lies within your paws!

rows.name: Loud Run
rows.short_description: 'Loud Run' is a 2-12 player fun multiplayer game. The Chaser tries to catch all the Runners within the range of their voice. When the Chaser runs out of breath, it's the Runners' turn to take down the Chaser. Prepare your breath; a looooong adventure awaits you!
rows.description_html: ' Loud Run ' is an exciting multiplayer online adventure! Set across various maps, this competitive game pits players as either Runners or Chasers. The main objective is for the Chaser to catch the Runners, or for the Runners to take down the Chaser. Invite your friends or join a server to embark on this thrilling adventure! Key Features: 2-12 Player Multiplayer Experience: Engage in fun and competitive matches with friends or players from around the world. Each match revolves around the Runners developing strategies to evade the Chaser, while the Chaser strives to catch the Runners. Surprise Chaser Selection: At the start of the game, one player is randomly chosen as the Chaser and begins in a safe zone. The other players must implement strategic plans to stop the Chaser and survive. Strategic Mechanics: When the Chaser attacks, they must shout. While shouting, their breath gradually depletes. Once their breath is completely exhausted or they stop shouting, the Runners can damage the Chaser. However, while the Chaser is shouting, the only option for the Runners is to run! This dynamic requires players to constantly adjust their strategies and work as a team. Scoring System: If the Runners catch the Chaser off guard and manage to defeat them, each surviving Runner earns 1 star. If you are the Chaser and successfully catch all the Runners, you win the game and earn 1 star. As rounds progress, the first player to reach the predetermined number of stars achieves individual victory. ' Loud Run ' offers a fun and exciting experience filled with strategic thinking and surprises. Prepare yourself for this thrilling school adventure and enjoy the game!

rows.name: A Better Tomorrow
rows.short_description: Join the green revolution! 🌱 Relax and learn about clean energy in this cozy, minimalist 2D city-building clicker game. Build windmills, solar panels, and more to provide energy to villages and cities while protecting the environment. Let's work together to make 'A Better Tomorrow'!
rows.description_html: A Better Tomorrow is a minimalist 2D city-building environmental clicker game that focuses on green energy. Your goal is to supply clean energy to your citizens while preserving the environment for an in-game week. Build green energy generators and plant trees to achieve this. Immerse yourself in this cozy and relaxing experience and learn about green energy. In A Better Tomorrow, you must manage three resources: energy, the environment's health, and the limited space available. The game's primary resource is energy, which is used to build new generators and satisfy the energy demands of villages and cities. When you construct new generators, the environment suffers. Heal the environment by planting saplings and seeing them grow into beautiful trees! The game presents a strategic challenge with its five types of energy generators: windmills, solar panels, dams, gas plants, and nuclear plants (on July 6, 2022, the UE Parliament labeled gas and nuclear power as green, equating them with renewables). Each generator has unique attributes, and weather conditions can influence their production. As the game progresses, new villages and cities will appear, increasing the energy demand. Adapt your strategy to optimize production and maintain a balance! What A Better Tomorrow Offers: Relaxing, calming, and atmospheric gameplay. Four unique unlockable themes. A set of challenges that spice up the gameplay with new weather conditions. A mix of resource management and strategy mechanics. 18 trophies. What A Better Tomorrow Does Not Offer: Any combat or violence. Multiplayer. Narrative elements, storyline. Turn-based strategy.

rows.description_html: Please add to wishlist! About the Game Follow us Official Discord： Official QQ group：479393298 Official BillBill： KDream 'Dice Player One' gives dice more possibilities. Here, you will strategize and control dice with different attributes to ultimately achieve victory. Ingenious Combinations, Ever-changing Dice Sets In this game, you combine dice skills to break through one score limit after another, depending on different situations. Each skill has its place, where you can meticulously plan and make the most of all the dice. Or you can carefully select and hone, making your favored dice unbeatable. Resonate with Your Heart, Surprises Await In numerous random challenges, besides the dice themselves, various resonances are waiting for your discovery. Attach suitable resonances to the dice to unleash their stronger powers! Later in each game, you will also unlock the forging workshop, relying on abilities like 'copy' and 'delete' to further strengthen your control over dice sets. Destiny is unpredictable, whether it's selecting dice, matching resonances, or using the workshop, every step you take could change the course of the entire game. Simple Yet Infinite Fun Step 1: Roll the dice. Step 2: Fill in the scores. Step 3: Embrace victory in the game! As long as you use dice skills well, you can create unimaginable high scores under simple rules! Move towards higher scores! Packed with Content, Challenge Yourself 300 dice with different skills, each appearance bringing you new inspiration. 50 selectable resonances and 7 processing skills allow you to customize your strongest dice as you wish. 20 starter dice sets, each offering a different game experience. 50 rhythm dice, customize difficulty, and strive for all rhythm rewards! 10 challenge levels, defeat enemies under special rules, and enjoy different fun! Daily refreshed random challenges, compete with players worldwide, and continually climb the leaderboard! More will be updated on the way! rows.name: None Shall Intrude: Descent
rows.short_description: None Shall Intrude: Descent is a free Prologue version of None Shall Intrude. A roguelite deck-builder with tile-based combat where you become a powerful Raid Boss. Epic battles, intricate strategies, and the ever-present threat of heroic challengers seeking to vanquish your reign.
rows.description_html: WELCOME TO PROLOGUE OF NONE SHALL INTRUDE!In this free version, you are able to conquer the first Act of Herelon. Will you be able to defeat the Dragon Slayer and secure the first part of the map? None Shall Intrude invites you to embrace the unparalleled power of a Raid Boss in a unique and immersive gaming experience. Prepare to traverse vibrant realms, engage in intense battles, and conquer all who dare to challenge your dominance. As the embodiment of chaos, your reign will be defined by strategic prowess, unique tile interactions with elemental flavor, boss mechanics you learn as you play. CHAOS INCARNATE As the unkillable embodiment of chaos, death means nothing to you as your soul is permanently tied to this land of mortals! With each new life, you gain more power, and each cycle opens up new possibilities to grow stronger. CONQUER THE WORLD  Forge your journey by selecting different routes from nodes on the map, ultimately conquering full regions .Along the way, you'll explore a variety of vibrant and imaginative landscapes , each filled with unique obstacles and creatures. Whether it's dense woodlands , majestic snowy mountains , or boundless desert sands . The world of Herelon is full of diverse location for you to explore and conquer! ELEMENTAL COMBOS Navigate the battlefield using a tile-based system, employing various primordial elements and combine them into potent interactions. Discover all 18 possible tile interactions and tailor your build to your preferred style of play, destroying your enemies with style! TALENTS  Level up your boss to unlock many new cards and relics . Accumulate talent points to invest in a talent tree , which can be customized before each run, enabling you to adapt your boss's play style to suit your preferences. BOSS MECHANICS  As the Chaos Incarnate , you possess 3 Phases . The road to power means unlocking your latent 'Boss Mechanics' . These mechanics work across distinct phases, with 24 unique powers attainable through in-game achievements . Combine up to 4 'Boss Mechanics' to craft your personalized Raid Boss . RELICS As you conquer regions or defeat powerful foes , you'll acquire special relics to enhance your elemental tile interactions even more. WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE FULL VERSION OF THE GAME: Access to the entire map, with many new unique Heroes to beat. Many new cards, talents and boss mechanics for the Dragon Boss. 5 new Difficulties (heroes play 2 cards, random affixes, etc..). Weather effects during combat (sand storm, blizzard,..). New dynamic combat backgrounds with unique combat objectives. Cosmetic Customizable Cave for the Dragon Boss. Mini-game Nodes, Locked special Nodes. Random Merchant events.

rows.name: Get off Work
rows.short_description: After coming home from work, the usual atmosphere is different. Suddenly, someone appears and starts giving you terrifying and strange tasks.
rows.description_html: It's not the same as usual Here is a man who has grown tired of the same monotonous days. His dream is to become wealthy and leave behind his life as a regular office worker. But one day, an unexpected opportunity comes his way after he gets off work. Is it truly an opportunity, or something else? Escape your endlessly looping room by passing through the mirror. Feature After work, face the seven obstacles that stand in your way. Lure specific monsters by whistling 'H' and burping 'R' keys Escape so the monsters can't catch you. Remove all obstacles to achieve your dream The picture frame in the room will show the number of obstacles you have overcome.

rows.name: swingmania
rows.short_description: swingmania is a note slicing VR rhythm game focused at competitive ranked play, customizability, ultra high performance and cats!
rows.description_html: Early access warning Please note: We are making this game available early in a raw work in progress state. If you are not interested in testing an extremely unfinished game you should wait until the full release. During Early Access you should expect to see the following: Placeholder UI elements that reserve space for planned features but do not work yet. These are part of the game development process and will be made functional over time. Some features may be in a broken or unfinished state or temporarily disabled while the underlying features are being worked on. Placeholder models, textures and low quality graphics. These are part of the game development process and we plan to create higher quality assets over time. Placeholder maps. None of the songs in game include the full intended range of beatmaps and difficulties, and some songs may only have one difficulty available that might be too difficult to most players. A lot of maps are temporary and we plan to make higher quality maps over time. Random game server outages General bugs A lot of planned features are not implemented yet. You can scroll down to the Early Access Roadmap section to get a rough idea of what's planned. Description swingmania is a note slicing VR rhythm game focused at competitive ranked play, customizability, ultra high performance and cats! Earn Delicious PP and climb the ranks The game includes a built in ranked system that lets you see where you stand in the world. Compete to become the #1 swingmania player, or see how far you can make it on the ranked ladder. Playing ranked maps, such as the built in maps, will award you Performance Points (PP) based on the maps difficulty and your score. The bigger your total PP is, the higher your global rank will be! Multiple note types The game features multiple types of notes, including Colored notes which have to be hit using a specific hand Rainbow notes that can be hit with either hand Any direction notes that can be hit in any direction Directional notes that have to be hit in a specific direction Mines that must be avoided Walls that you must avoid with your head Wide range of built in maps The base game includes a bunch of songs with maps ranging from very easy accuracy maps all the way to random angle challenge, squat challenge and 688 bpm vibro. Please keep in mind that during Early Access the selection of songs and maps is limited, and we plan to add more songs and maps for every type of player over time. Custom songs support Map your own song collection with full freedom in note placement using swingmapper, our advanced map editor which is included with the game. Designed for Pros Packed with features catering to high skill play Advanced HUD showing detailed score composition and statistics Replay system allows you to analyze every swing in extreme frame-by-frame detail Minimal distractions. You can disable the environment and any effects that could distract you and hinder gaming performance Fine tune controller offsets for individual hands Fine tune map parameters such as reaction time, judgement line distance Please note: the game is in Early Access and a bunch of these features are still work in progress. Full customizability The game supports loading custom models for environments, notes, Cat Sticks(tm), etc for unlimited personalization. Designed for streaming The desktop view is optimized to be perfect for streaming or recording plays out of the box. You get a smooth wide-FOV view so that noone has to deal with jank looking gameplay. Twitch Integration is built in. You can read chat directly in-game. Future updates We are planning to add many features and improvements to the game during Early Access, such as: Graphical improvements Better controller offset system Proper tutorial Rhythm scoring mode Challenge level system Better menus and leaderboards Fitness tracking and heart rate monitor support Full body tracked in-game avatars More customization options More counters and stats Song specific environments and effects Improvements to streaming features, camera controls and overlays More built-in songs and maps Cat improvements Replay system improvements Practice system Ranked system improvements And more! Optimization at the Core We are building this game on a brand new game engine with one goal: To be the most optimized VR game ever made. We are going to extreme lengths no-one else has to ensure the game never drops a single frame during hours of gameplay. The code path for every single frame and situation has been meticulously designed to avoid frame time spikes, and multiple CPU cores are utilized in a smart way. Please note that the game is in Early Access and not fully optimized yet. Did we mention the game has a cat in it? Honestly this is the real main selling point. Please note though that the game is in Early Access and the cat is work in progress.

rows.name: Riftcast
rows.short_description: A cyber companion for your desktop inspired by LCD virtual pets of old. Collect, train and fight all sorts of Reverians as you take on daring ventures, fun mini-games and fierce battles.
rows.description_html: Discover the realm of Reveria, a wild world a cast of curious creatures call home. Take the role as one of these monsters as you encounter all kinds of Reverians, and embark on all sorts of adventures and quests! ⭐ PLAY YOUR WAY Customise your experience with two versions in Red and Blue, with exclusive and more easily accessible areas, homelands, species and shells, real time progression toggles and two distinct gameplay modes... ⭐ GO EASY, GO HARD In Revery Mode, you're free to tame and nurture your currently active Reverian in one of 10 distinct homelands, while Gazing Mode presents a more challenging experience with requiring regular check-ins to maintain your whole team's well-being all at once - all while playing as the very weakest Reverians. ⭐ MEET THE REVERIANS Play as one of over 50 fully-evolved Reverians in Revery Mode (or 5 special Reverians in Gazing Mode), and encounter over 100 species and discover their unique traits and needs, from dietary needs and instinctual habits to elemental skills and special abilities. Recruit and raise up to 20 party members through adoption, dropped eggs and defeating invaders! ⭐RAISE YOUR REVERIANS Keep your party in top form by feeding, training and tending to their needs. Spend quality time with your party members by playing minigames and fighting alongside them, and watch bonds form as they hang out amongst each other... but watch out for infighting, truancy and sabotage! ⭐ COMPETE IN BATTLES Fight with your party members or enter the fray with your own player character in classic turn-based bouts. Test your skills in Training Battles, participate in Tourneys, and undertake daring Nightward Raids against waves of adversaries! ⭐ EXPLORE THE WORLD Visit your homeland for items, amenities and quests, and send off party members to search for materials and work for money and experience. Discover new areas to explore in as you increase your Player Rank with quests and raids! ⭐ COLLECT, CULTIVATE AND CRAFT Manage your inventory wisely and stock up on essential supplies from your homeland's shops and the elusive Alterworks Depot. Harvest plants, go on a voyage for materials, craft your own items and cook new foods with the help of your party members! ✨ FEATURING 135 species currently available 83 zones of differing continents and biomes to explore 50 tourneys to take on 12 minigames for training and bonding 11 homelands with exclusive items 6 quest types involving battles and item/egg deliveries Over 300 obtainable items, materials and foods Forever free! 💫 PLEASE NOTE This game's still in active development, and certain features, items and the like that are already visible or available don't do anything as of yet. There are also some differences between Red and Blue versions, such as how often certain species appear and what areas are readily available or temporary, but exclusive content isn't totally inaccessible on one or the other.

rows.name: Shadow of Pharos
rows.short_description: Shadow of Pharos is a short first-person horror game.
rows.description_html: Shadow of Pharos is a short first-person horror game. The game aims to be a fully immersive experience and has no UI by default. To enable accessibility options and general settings, input the following command using the keyboard arrow keys or the controller D-Pad: left, right, left, right, down, down The menu will then be accessible by pressing ESC on the keyboard or Back/Share on a controller. Default Controls: Movement: WASD on keyboard | Left Analog on controller Look Around: Mouse | Right Analog on controller Interact: E on keyboard | Cross/A on controller Flashlight: F on keyboard | Square/X on controller Notes: Tab on keyboard | Options/Start on controller Disclaimer: The game's soundtrack was made specifically for the game, and is safe to play on videos/stream. It's also available for free on TeamGaivot's YouTube channel. If you enjoyed the game, consider supporting the team by purchasing the soundtrack here on Steam and wishlisting our next game Pharos.

rows.name: Birdcage: A Tale of Sorrow
rows.short_description: After a robbery, you find yourself trapped in a stranger's apartment and must escape without being seen by the police. To do this, you will need to gain the help of its strange resident and unravel the mysteries surrounding her.
rows.description_html: Birdcage is a first-person graphic adventure inspired by the classics of this genre . You have just committed a robbery and, fleeing from the police, you hide in the apartment of a mysterious woman. Through exploration, solving puzzles, and unravelling riddles, you must earn her trust to help you escape. As you uncover her past, you will see that not everything is as it seemed at first. Being aware of her situation, you will have to make decisions that will affect both your future and hers. Will you manage to escape the house? Which path will you follow? rows.name: End The World
rows.short_description: Traverse the kingdom looking for a way to End The World for all that it's cost you.
rows.description_html: Bring the End of the World in this story-driven retro title about love and hate, light and dark, and all the ways everything could end in a snap. Play as multiple characters as you traverse the Kingdom of Ionis trying to put an end to tyranny by any means possible. Keep Your Promise You are a priest of the Kingdom of Ionis – the beacon of light in the world – and you have been pushed over the edge. The end of the world is at your fingertips, but there is one who must pay by your hands before the world blinks out of existence. Be consumed by this retro adventure game about romance, heartbreak, and death. Burn In Oblivion Engage with this dark, layered story using a two-button interface just like with the first handheld games of the 1990s. With pitch-perfect music that captures the darkest games of the era, End the World will bring you to the edge of oblivion in the search for a reason to keep holding on for every single moment! Lose yourself in the pain, the romance, and the thirst for revenge, all in the name of ending the world! Don't forget to check out another unforgettable gaming experience from SimpleShutIn Productions !

rows.name: Nexus Rumble: The Ultimate Showdown
rows.short_description: Welcome to Nexus Rumble, the ultimate showdown where champions clash in a fierce competition for survival! Prepare to embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through diverse landscapes and exhilarating challenges in this heart-pounding multiplayer extravaganza.
rows.description_html: Survive, Conquer, and Dominate in Nexus Rumble – The Ultimate Multiplayer Battle Royale Experience! Dive into fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled battles where 30 players clash in dynamic, ever-changing arenas. Whether you're a fan of strategic survival, chaotic party games, or skill-based combat, Nexus Rumble delivers non-stop action across diverse maps and unique game modes. Will you outsmart, outrun, and outlast your rivals to claim victory? Be the last one standing Gather your friends or face off against worthy adversaries as you fight tooth and nail to be the last one standing. With multiple rounds of intense action, strategic gameplay, and unexpected twists, Nexus Rumble keeps you on the edge of your seat until the very end. Do you have what it takes to outwit, outmaneuver, and outlast your opponents? Step into the Nexus Rumble arena and prove your mettle as the ultimate champion! Victory awaits those who dare to seize it in this electrifying test of skill, speed, and survival. Are you ready to rumble? Key Features to Fuel Your Competitive Spirit: 30-Player Mayhem : Compete in large-scale, heart-pounding battles where only the strongest survive. Endless Variety : Master tons of   unique game modes – from explosive Bomb Tag to sword-clashing duels – each with strategic twists. Custom Lobbies : Play with friends or rivals in private matches or join public showdowns for global glory.  Dynamic Maps : Navigate treacherous terrain, dodge crumbling tiles, and sprint through high-stakes racecourses. Cross-Platform Play : Battle players worldwide on any device (PC / Mobile). Customizable Character: Stand out in the arena by customizing your avatar with hats, glasses, mustaches, and a variety of color options for hair, eyes, skin, and outfits. Game Modes Designed for Maximum Thrills: Experience an array of electrifying game modes in this battle royale, each with its own unique challenges: Bomb Tag : Pass the ticking bomb in this chaotic party game – one wrong move and BOOM! Stick Tag: Dodge the tag stick—tag others and pass it on before time's up! Sword Fight : Prove your melee mastery in free-for-all clashes. Race : Speed through obstacle-packed courses in a fast-paced dash for survival. Tile Puzzle : Find the hidden path before the clock – and the tiles – crack under pressure! Stepping Stone : Test your nerve on rigged stones – one misstep means elimination! Mingle: Quickly form groups of the required size in a room or face elimination. Red Light Green Light: Freeze on red, move on green—beat the clock to survive! Football: Smash the giant football with your stick, team up, and dominate to score! Jump Rush: Leap over the rotating cylinder—nail your timing or tumble off Are you ready to rumble? Prove your mettle in Nexus Rumble —the ultimate multiplayer battle royale experience!
