rows.name: Qazaq: Son of the Sun
rows.short_description: Qazaq: Son of the Sun - a single-player first-person open-world game with puzzles set in Kazakhstan, where you are the last surviving Qazaq saved by the Sun God.
rows.description_html: Adventure through the Ancient Lands of Kazakhstan As the last Qazaq, saved by the Sun God, you must restore light and warmth to your homeland by defeating the evil spirit Shaitan. Explore the open world of Kazakhstan in the twilight and ignite the totems of all the tribes. Shaitan himself will mock you, lead you astray, and summon dark spirits. The power of the Sun will help you find the path to your ancestors and stand against Shaitan. Game Features: Stylized open world. Pleasant nighttime atmosphere. Interactive storytelling about Qazaq tribes. Minimal interface for maximum immersion. Simple totem puzzles. Immortal player, enemies only deal debuffs. Note: This game is perfect for people with limited time for gaming, seeking a simple and relaxing gameplay experience, as well as for newcomers to gaming due to its accessibility.

rows.name: One Paradox
rows.short_description: A first-person narrative adventure set in a dystopian future. Advance through the futuristic OF-1 factory, solve puzzles, evade other androids, and uncover its hidden secrets.
rows.description_html: Year 2080. Humanity managed to achieve the SDGs of the 2030 Agenda, thanks to the artificial intelligence created by UN computer scientists! Now androids are in charge of ecological production systems and taking care of the planet. Or are they? A first person narrative adventure set in a distopic future. Advance trough the futuristic factory OF-1, solve puzzles, evade the other androids and uncover its hidden secrets. Your role as an android of the R06-ER series, on your first day as a worker at The Factory, is to preserve the well-being and prosperity of planet Earth. You are programmed to follow the protocol and instructions of the supervising AI and will go from room to room, completing assigned tasks. If you see strange messages or signs, ignore them; the new update is causing issues and some androids may malfunction. Just follow the protocol, complete your shift, and a comforting oil bath awaits you! A good Roger follows orders! Features: Explore a futuristic environment with synthwave aesthetics: Immerse yourself in a vibrant, retro-futuristic world that combines visual elements of synthwave. Dubbed in Catalan, with a retrowave soundtrack: Enjoy a fully immersive experience with Catalan voiceovers and a soundtrack that evokes the retrowave style. First-person narrative experience: Live the story from your character’s perspective, feeling like a part of the game world. Learn about sustainability and ethics in ecological production: Through the narrative, discover the importance of sustainable and ethical practices in production. Complete tasks assigned by the factory’s AI: Solve puzzles and explore different areas of the factory while following the instructions of the supervising AI.

rows.name: Forgotten Fears
rows.short_description: Forgotten Fears is a collection of five small horror games, ranging from rainy forest to deep underwater.
rows.description_html: Experience five different levels: Forest: You are a forest keeper. Your task is to bring light to the forest while avoiding danger lurking in the dark. You have your trusty flashlight and a map that will guide your way, but be careful, as the flashlight battery is limited . Light all the lamps marked on the map to provide safety for yourself and the forest. Underwater: After an accident, you wake up underwater in a small cage and quickly realize, that you are not alone . You must find several items that will help you. Explore the cage quietly, so you don't disturb the danger , and find the items before you run out of oxygen. Cottage: After a long drive, you have finally arrived at an abandoned cottage with paranormal activity. Find the way to open the basement door . Explore the house, find hidden objects, solve puzzles, unlock blocked areas , and take what belongs to you. But be careful, as you are not alone . You have your flashlight to help you out. UNKNOWN: You are in the UNKNOWN place, there is no light, no day, no night, no exit. Find and pull 10 levers to open the escape from this place . Avoid the traps and the danger lurking in the dark . You can find different monitors in the labyrinth, some of them will show you how much time is left, how many levers you have to pull, and also the minimap to orient yourself. Basement: You've got your first job as an 'Anomaly Huntsman'. You arrived at the place and quickly got to work. You have a computer to monitor and report anomalies. The first few hours were quite silent, but as the night progressed anomalies started appearing faster and faster, sometimes even appearing in your room. Use your computer to fix anomalies and environment to stay safe from anomalies that occur in your room.

rows.name: Battlefield™ REDSEC
rows.short_description: Now entering REDSEC, the ultimate free-to-play FPS destination built on Battlefield’s iconic DNA. Featuring Battle Royale, Gauntlet, & the power of Portal.
rows.description_html: Season 1 hits Southern California. Play now. All-Out Warfare descends on Southern California. Season 1 rolls out in 3 phases: first with Rogue Ops, then California Resistance, and Winter Offensive, each packed with thematic classified military hardware, cutting-edge gadgets, new maps, and weapons of unprecedented power. Every month new content is added, and is immediately available for near-limitless customization in Portal. About the Game Now entering REDSEC, a free-to-play destination built on Battlefield’s iconic DNA. Drop into Fort Lyndon for a Battle Royale only Battlefield can deliver, featuring massive-scale destruction, fast-paced squad play, and the deadliest ring in BR. Survive and advance in Gauntlet: an all-new cutthroat, knockout-style elimination mode where squads race to complete missions. Then redraw the lines of battle with Portal. Play free now. A fight for secrets is raging in Fort Lyndon. This massive, redacted military facility hidden in plain sight between pristine beaches and a sleepy residential community is home to some of the most advanced military projects in the world. Rogue operators are racing against time and hostiles to keep each other out and the secrets in. Drop into a Battle Royale only Battlefield can deliver, featuring massive-scale destruction, fast-paced squad play, and the deadliest ring in BR. The power of Tactical Destruction brings an explosive new layer of depth to Battle Royale. Blast open pathways and demolish enemy positions for a strategic advantage. Survive and advance in Gauntlet: an all-new cutthroat, knockout-style elimination mode where squads race to complete missions. REDSEC gives unprecedented access to Portal’s massive sandbox. Every player has the ability to create unique and unforgettable experiences, for free. This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items.

rows.short_description: Jump, slide and shoot! Kill a player or wipe the entire enemy team with your one-shot-no-scope-super-laser-aiming skills and use gadgets to your advantage, in a 4v4 arena shooter with dynamic game modes and fast paced movement mechanics. May the better team win!
rows.description_html: Neon Fever is a 4v4 action arena shooter, with a single weapon: the laser rifle. Use modules to enhance your shots, gadgets to gain new abilities and fight to the death for your team's honor! Two teams - the Beam Boys and the Laser Lads - compete to be the first to reach 3000 points. Gain points by killing enemy players or by participating in dynamic game modes like King Of The Hill - where your team has to stand its ground in an exposed location - or Chicken Run - where players must catch and hold onto the chicken for a looong time while avoiding enemy shots. Games last for 10 to 15 minutes and don't leave any time to breath, with a high octane rhythm and high stakes all the way through to the end. The game keeps track of your match history and stats just so you can flex your KD to your friends! Neon Fever is the first, best, greatest and only game of the Beam Boys team, created as our final group project for the DDJV program at the University of Sherbrooke (2023-2024). The Beam Boys are (by order of last name): Albin Calais Narvin Chana Martin Dufour Alexandre Lemarbre-Barrett Merlin Roudier Joshua Van Hollebeke And thanks to Vincent Lévêque for the awesome soundtrack! All asset licenses can be found in the game files, but most were created by us during development.

rows.name: Gunship Battle Total Warfare
rows.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world submerged by the sea, the wake of the enemy is apparent at every turn. From turning the tides of naval warfare to dominating the skies in break-neck aerial combat, every decision you make will change the outcome of the battle.
rows.description_html: Gunship Battle: Total Warfare, a hit modern military strategy game with over 10 million downloads, offers the perfect blend of strategy, intense combat, and an immersive, unique environment. Reclaim and fortify your base, build and upgrade iconic modern military units—ships, jets, and tanks—each designed with real-world precision and power. Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative set in a drowned world where the last survivors fight for dominance and survival. Key Features: -  Legendary Military Units:   Strengthen, upgrade, and deploy real-world inspired ships, jets, and tanks, to enhance their unique abilities, firepower, and capabilities in combat. -  PvE Features: Battle powerful enemy fleets and squadrons to conquer new territories. -  PvP Features: Enjoy competitive and casual PvP battles, offering challenges for both casual players and hardcore military enthusiasts. -  Alliance Power: Form powerful alliances with other Admirals, coordinating strikes, defending territory, and pushing back against the tide of invasion. -  Mini-Games for Extra Action : Enjoy action-packed mini-games that offer a change of pace:    - Fortress: Test your strategic mind and tactical skills in this tower defense mini-game.    - Sky Ace: Strap into the cockpit and take to the skies in this arcade-inspired jet mini-game.

rows.name: Last Command: Prologue
rows.short_description: Last Command is a fast-paced Snake x Bullet Hell action game. Maneuver through enemies’ barrage of attacks, collect Data Points to deal damage! Mix and match skill chips as you progress, overcome intense Boss battles, and uncover the secrets of their program world...
rows.description_html: Play the full game In "Last Command: Prologue" , you can experience the special prologue chapter of the Last Command About the Game In 'Last Command: Prologue' , you can experience the special prologue chapter of the Last Command, an bullet-hell, boss-rush adventure RPG that inspired from the classic Snake game! Embark on a Journey in an digital world, the final phase of the mankind's evolution, where the sentients program who used to served human live, laugh, and... Snake x Bullet Hell = A New Take on the Classic Experience! Grease up your arrow keys and stretch your fingers! Maneuver the Crawler through the enemies’ barrage of attacks and collect Data Points to deal damage! Gain special chips to enhance the Crawler as you progress, overcome intense Boss battles, and uncover the secrets of their program world... ▉ 'Last Command' takes inspiration from the classic game 'Snake,' but adds two additional actions, 'Dash' and 'Analyze.' Make good use of these new actions to dodge attacks and collect 'Data' generated in the levels to inflict damage. ▉There are numerous, non-repetitive battles, each with their own unique style and attack pattern ranging from dazzling screen filling barrages to obstacles that wish to overwhelm you. Each one will be a test to your ability to respond to various difficulties. ▉Modules can be found throughout the game and grant a variety of special abilities. Combined together, they can create a 'Resonance Effect,' granting unique and stronger bonuses. Find the best combination for your playstyle! ▉Overcome dangers and challenges while uncovering long-forgotten secrets left after the disappearance of humans as you explore the vast world of programs.

rows.name: Halmaverse
rows.short_description: A relaxing board game where the goal is to move your pieces to the opposite corner.
rows.description_html: Halmaverse is a board game for 2 or 4 players where the goal is to move your pieces to the opposite corner of the board. The player who moves their pieces to the corner first wins the game. The classic Halma game mode allows pieces to move one step in any direction per turn, or to jump over one or multiple pieces in a row. In Battle Halma, players can also pick up randomly generated power-ups that allows additional movements and actions. Choose between 2 types of boards and 5 types of pieces with different materials.

Use the recoil from your sword swings to get from place to place and figure out the complexities of these deceivingly simple controls. Features: A simple 2 button + Joystick control scheme Controller rebinding No walking! A short and sweet 20-40 minute experience

rows.name: Number Fields
rows.short_description: Number Fields is a logic game where players uncover tiles indicating the proximity of hidden bombs and treasures. Choose your difficulty, customize grid sizes, and enjoy. Provides a way to stay fully engaged while calming nervous energy discreetly.
rows.description_html: Overview: Number Fields is a strategic puzzle game where your goal is to uncover all tiles on the grid without triggering hidden bombs. Use logical deduction and visual cues to navigate the fields, uncover treasures, and mark suspected bomb locations with flags. Perfect for fans of classic puzzle games who enjoy a mix of strategy and luck, this game was designed to keep you fully engaged during long meetings or customer interactions while discreetly calming nervous energy. It avoids sudden sounds and flashy colors to ensure it doesn't draw attention. There is nothing 'extra' or flashy about this game. It doesn't aim to be dramatic or the center of attention. It's simply a tool to help you stay sane during those moments when you feel like you're living an episode of 'The Office' but need to keep your job. Key Features: - Zoom Meeting Friendly: No sudden sounds, no surprise flashing colors, and no forced full-screen mode. This game is perfect for playing during long meetings without drawing attention. - Insomnia Friendly: Low blue-light, no eye-burning colors, or ear-splitting sounds. A perfect mix of distraction and calm logic, pairing well with the music you need to sleep. - Challenging Gameplay: Uncover tiles to reveal numbers and colors indicating the proximity of hidden bombs and treasures. - Visual Cues: Numbers indicate the proximity of bombs, while colors indicate the proximity to treasures, adding a visual layer of strategy. - Flagging System: Right-click to mark suspected bomb locations, helping you keep track of dangerous spots. - Dynamic Scoring: Earn points by uncovering treasures and correctly flagging bombs. - Adjustable Difficulty: Choose between easy, medium, and hard modes to match your skill level. - Grid Customization: Adjust the grid size using the slider, ranging from small grids for quick games to large grids for a more challenging experience. - Satisfying Endgame: Enjoy dynamic endgame animations that highlight your flagged points with smooth scaling effects. - Intuitive Controls: Simple left-click to reveal tiles and right-click to place or remove flags. Gameplay Mechanics: 1. Revealing Tiles: - Left-click on a tile to reveal it. - Numbers indicate the presence of adjacent bombs and treasures. - If a tile contains a bomb, the game ends. - If a tile contains a treasure, you earn points. 2. Flagging Tiles: - Right-click to place a flag on suspected bomb locations. - Right-click again to remove the flag. - Flags help you keep track of potential bomb spots. 3. Winning the Game: - Win by revealing all non-bomb tiles. - The game ends when all non-bomb tiles are revealed or if a bomb tile is uncovered. Design: Number Fields features a clean, intuitive design that enhances the puzzle-solving experience. The game uses muted colors for visual cues, making it easy to distinguish between different elements. The scaling effects and animations during gameplay provide a satisfying and engaging experience. Get ready to test your logic and deduction skills in Number Fields – a puzzle game that combines strategy, excitement, and a touch of luck. Will you uncover all the tiles and find the treasures, or will you trigger a bomb and end the game? Play now and find out!

rows.name: Short Adventure
rows.short_description: An RPG that uses the ATB battle system seen in early Final Fantasy games, Short Adventure follows a diseased young woman who goes from every day college student to criminal to outcast as she tries to cope with her life changing quickly. Note: The game is incomplete and will gradually be updated.
rows.description_html: This is a game made with RPG Maker MZ that follows a young woman that is trying to cope with her life being turned around as the disease she suffers from now forces her to live a different life. This is game is a work in progress that will receive updates until its completion. The current game takes players between 20 - 30 hours depending on expertise and familiarity with classic style RPGs. ...As well as a bit of RNG. The game is a ATB battle RPG with an art style that will remind you of earlier Final Fantasy games like IV, VI, and IX. There are multiple characters to play as that will come and go in your party. Several different locations to discover across five continents once the full game is complete.

rows.name: Burning Sky
rows.short_description: Fight and survive a desolate half-destroyed planet cracker, teeming with mutated wildlife and robotic enemies. Will you make it out alive?
rows.description_html: In the desolate aftermath of a pitched battle between the nature-loving Bloodwarders and the Industrial Terrans, you step into the worn boots of a Panther Commando, Edward—a last-ditch operative sent to complete the unthinkable. Your mission: infiltrate the heart of a damaged planet cracker, a colossal machine once used to tear celestial bodies apart for their resources, now left derelict to float over the vast expanse of space. Dash across chasms, swing across damaged conduits, and scale the remnants of the planet cracker, a maze of twisted corridors, rusted catwalks, and malfunctioning machinery. Fight with brutal hand-to-hand attacks and deliver combos beat-em-up style! Your enemies won't know what him them. Explore a broken world, fight dangerous wildlife and synthetic contraptions. All of them out to kill you!

rows.name: WraithRun
rows.short_description: WraithRun is a cyberpunk-themed classic arcade-style game in first person. Escape the maze by collecting all the orbs, but avoid the deadly wraiths.
rows.description_html: WraithRun is a dark cyberpunk first-person action game with classic arcade gameplay. Enter a high-tech labyrinthine prison constructed by machines for the purpose of tormenting you. Navigate these dystopian cyberpunk mazes, collecting orbs and power-ups while avoiding deadly drones known as wraiths. Collect all of the orbs in the level to advance. The game features 10 levels of increasing difficulty with fast-paced, challenging gameplay. Can you escape the mazes? Or will you be fodder for the machines? Features: Classic arcade gameplay with modern graphics. Fast-paced thrilling gameplay. 10 cyberpunk-themed mazes of increasing difficulty. Intense electronic music soundtrack. 4 types of enemies with different attributes. Horror elements.

rows.name: Sound Horizons
rows.short_description: Score unique melodies in this minimalist rhythm game. Experience a dynamic music that reacts to your actions, and try to survive until the end.
rows.description_html: Sound Horizons is a minimalist yet challenging rhythm game where you make one with music. Its generative soundtrack changes along your progression and reshape the world as you play. The melodies are always random, your only option to adapt is by getting in the rhythm. Succeeds enough, and you might see the end of your journey. Intuitive controls with four buttons, offering a quick learning curve so that you can test your rhythm skills Interactive music : every button press adds new notes to the melody A Procedural landscape that moves to the beat, for a true synesthetic experience An Adaptive difficulty ensures that the challenge is always aligned to your skill, so that you can progress at your own pace Additional modes for more challenges and immersive musical experiences Sound Horizons contains 2 levels  as of today. I might work on new ones in the future, if there is demand for it.

rows.short_description: These sweet animals are ready to fight. The funniest chaos is coming!
rows.description_html: Fiesta Animal is a party multiplayer game 5v5 online. Play with friends and your family! cooperation and friendship are your best tools to victory. Run, jump, swimming and laugh as much as you want! SATISFACTORY AND FUN RAG DOLL SYSTEM All players can fall into the water with fun poses, take the lift, cross the map over mobile platforms and much more! - You can diving into an orange juice or into a milk bowl. rows.name: Mushiverse - Online Boardgame
rows.short_description: Mushiverse is an Online Board Game that can be played with 4-6 friends. It offers a unique experience with its diverse mechanics. Each player starts the game with unique characters and aims to reach the targeted number of flags by navigating various risks and luck factors.
rows.description_html: Mushiverse is an online board game that can be played with 4 to 6 players. With its unique characters, villages, and mechanics, it offers you a one-of-a-kind experience. You can easily defeat your opponents with customized characters. You can either pay less rent to get ahead, or you can throw your opponents in jail and sabotage them to reach the peak of fun. You can annoy your opponents by being a character that goes against the rules of the game. When you select an opponent during the game, you steal their village and character. In the Mushiverse universe, each village has its own unique features. By choosing a village, you select your teammates and determine your strategy. Earthquake Mechanics A randomly selected city is declared as the earthquake city. The rent multiplier of the earthquake city increases! Attention! You might want to invest in this city, but an earthquake could happen at any moment! Lover Cities Two randomly selected cities fall in love with each other. Any action you take in one love-struck city will automatically be reflected in the other! Farm System If you have at least one house on every property you purchase, you will start earning passive income from that property.

rows.name: Project Unknown Designation
rows.short_description: Meet your friends at their cabin in the woods. What lies ahead?
rows.description_html: Welcome to the prototype Project Unknown Designation, the first game of its kind by Diggidy. If a full version is made, expect a thrilling adventure filled with puzzles, multiple storylines, and a deeply immersive plot. Plot Overview: You and your friends planned a fun getaway at a secluded cabin in the woods. But as you arrive late, you sense something is amiss. Your friends are nowhere to be found, and an eerie silence fills the air. Gameplay: Navigate the Woods: Traverse through the dense forest to reach the cabin. Beware of hidden dangers lurking in the shadows. Investigate the Campsite: Explore the campsite and surrounding areas to uncover clues about what happened to your friends. Make Critical Choices: Decide whether to stay and search for your friends or find the keys to the truck and make a quick escape. Features: Multiple endings based on your choices. An immersive plot that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Thank you for playing. Your feedback is invaluable as we work towards creating the full version of the game.

rows.name: Hotel Tome ws
rows.short_description: Hotel Tome ws is a short Point-and-Click adventure set in a pop-up book. Puzzle your way out of the hotel room you’re trapped in by combining items cleverly and don’t mind the amnesiac protagonist breaking the 4th wall!
rows.description_html: A woman wakes up in a hotel room without any recollection of how she got here. Quickly she notices that she is stuck in there. Can you help her escape the room? And more importantly, find out what happened? Follow the mysterious amnesiac protagonist along her journey through the neat paper cut-out world that is a pop-up book! You need to find and combine the proper items to advance. The hotel staff isn’t really helpful, but luckily our main character is breaking the 4th wall every now and then to consult with you. Discover a crime, expose the true criminal and reveal the protagonist’s real identity while you browse through the pages of Hotel Tome! This point-and-click adventure provides: classic point-and-click puzzles a neat 2.5D environment in paper aesthetic fully voiced dialogues an engaging jazzy soundtrack stupid and funny interactions! and a plot twist you surely didn’t see coming …

rows.description_html: Welcome to My Sudoku! Whether you're a complete beginner, a casual player or a hardcore Sudoku fan, My Sudoku offers a variety of engaging game modes. Try the simpler 4x4 and 6x6 puzzles if you're just starting out, or go straight to the 9x9 puzzles for a classic Sudoku challenge. Solve Sudoku puzzles to earn achievements and unlock even more puzzles. Save and load your games to continue playing Sudoku at your leisure. Enjoy a relaxed lo-fi soundtrack, which provides the perfect soundscape for a chilled-out puzzling experience. Start your Sudoku adventure with a selection of free puzzles, expanding the game with DLC when you're ready for more. Are you ready to start solving? Let's play My Sudoku!

rows.name: Dark Chronicles:Reawakening of Evil
rows.short_description: is a survivor-like game that features no complex equipment combinations, intricate maps, or complicated items. It allows you to jump right in and play anytime. Through agile controls, you can engage in intense combat and truly enjoy the game.
rows.description_html: 'Dark Chronicles:Reawakening of Evil' is a survivor-like game that features no complex equipment combinations, intricate maps, or complicated items. It allows you to jump right in and play anytime. Through agile controls, you can engage in intense combat and truly enjoy the game. Each chapter consists of multiple mini-maps, where you must face hordes of demons swarming from all directions. Your goal is to unleash relentless attacks and eliminate all demons. Survive for 60 seconds to obtain temporary cards that boost defense or attack, then continue exploring other mini-maps until you locate the one with the BOSS. Defeat the BOSS to earn a treasure chest, which contains powerful weapons and equipment when opened. This intense battle royale game lets you encounter countless fierce demon warriors and demon mages. Slaughter these demons and claim victory! Game Features: Wield a staff to unleash deadly magic attacks in ice, fire, and poison elements. Freely combine various skills to boost damage and add unique effects. Each skill can be upgraded to max level, advancing into an even more powerful form! Ice spells slow enemy movement, fire spells inflict massive damage, and poison spells weaken enemy defense, making them take extra damage. Craft your own art of slaughter and create a unique screen-clearing rhythm. Successfully defeat the BOSS or escape its assaults to obtain powerful equipment. Each equipment piece can be upgraded, with every level enhancing defense or attack for a leap in combat power. But stay vigilant! To secure treasure chests, you must spare no effort to dodge dense demon attacks and emerge victorious! You can set the game language to English by following these steps: Click the 'Settings' icon in the upper-right corner of the game interface, then change the 'Language' option from 'Chinese (Simplified)' to 'English' in the settings window.

rows.name: Split Spirit
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in a vibrant world overflowing with color and charm as you traverse mountainous woodlands to rejoin with your other half. Seek the aid of the forest as flowers and deer pick you up and carry you along on your journey.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in a vibrant world overflowing with color and charm as you traverse mountainous woodlands to rejoin with your other half. Seek the aid of the forest as flowers and deer pick you up and carry you along on your journey. Beautiful natural environments As you traverse the world, you’ll experience the likes of windy savannas, waterfall caves, primordial jungles, and more! Every environment comes with its own hand-crafted artwork, each as breathtaking as the last. Relaxing, easy-to-pick-up gameplay Trot, jump, and throw as you make your way through the forest. Whether you’re looking for a more casual experience or are new to games, Split Spirit offers gameplay where you can enjoy the world without having to worry about losing or complicated controls. Simple physics-based throwing mechanics Toss yourself from the deer and flowers that aid your journey. Aiming is assisted with a visible throw arc to help you make trickier shots and there is no penalty for missing - the flower or deer you last threw from will happily pick you back up again so you can try again! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.description_html: Build, Manage, and Race in the World of GTR - Garage Town Racing Take the wheel and control your own garage in GTR - Garage Town Racing , where you’re more than just a driver! This management and racing game lets you customize and enhance every detail of your workshop and cars. Collect exclusive vehicles, build models from scratch, and challenge friends in thrilling PvP races! GTR - Garage Town Racing combines the adrenaline of racing with management strategy, offering players the chance to transform a small garage into the biggest hub in a city full of automotive enthusiasts. Game Features Expand and upgrade your workspace, attract more clients, and increase profits while transforming your garage into a powerhouse. Compete against friends in real-time challenges and prove that your garage produces the city’s best cars.  From engines to paint, customize every detail of your cars. Decorate your garage to stand out and attract new clients.  Find exclusive parts, manufacture original vehicles, and create a one-of-a-kind collection of cars. Visit friends' garages, challenge them to races, and trade rare parts to upgrade your inventory. A Personalized Racing & Management Experience In GTR - Garage Town Racing , the passion for cars goes far beyond the track. Customize every detail of your car, prepare for exciting races, and build connections with other players as you transform your garage into a workshop that stands out. If you’re a fan of racing and strategy, GTR - Garage Town Racing offers the best of both worlds, in a setting where your workshop is the city’s core, and the open road is your stage.

rows.name: MarbleGP
rows.short_description: Welcome to the World of Marbles. The marbles are a peacful species. They know no greed, envy or anger. All they care about is to put fun in their lifes, some like to unveil the secrets of the universe, some prefer to discuss about the meaning of liff, some others like to race.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the World of Marbles. The marbles are a peaceful species. They know no greed, envy or anger. All they care about is to put fun in their lifes. As anywhere else in the universe fun is in the eye of the beholder - some like to unveil the secrets of the universe, some prefer to discuss about the meaning of liff, some others like to race. Marbles as such roll. Long time ago they discovered that this can be used to race against each other. The long history of marble racing has seen many changes. There were marblathons and cross country rolls over short and long distance, they even did the Iron Marble. Short time ago someone started to put together weird tracks with ramps and such and started to roll. It didn't take long until the fun spread all over the World of Marbles. Dustbin::Games MarbleGP is a 3d Marble Racing game. Up to 16 marbles race on a variety of tracks, some including jumps, loops and moving obstacles. This game gives you the most realistic and stunning marble racing experience you have ever experienced. In principle the game is simple, it comes with just four simple rules: Rule 1: the Fastest Marble Wins Rule 2: Stay On the Track Rule 3: Expect No Mercy Rule 4: Show No Mercy Even though there are only five controls for your marble (Forward, Backward, Left, Right and Brake, plus Rearview and Manual Respawn) and controlling the marble is quite simple you will soon realize that getting the most out of the marbles and competing against the best AI marbles requires a lot of practice.

rows.name: Escape from HAON ISLAND
rows.short_description: 'Escape from HAON ISLAND' is a first-person 3D platformer with unique controls - where you find yourself on an island with happy inhabitants and try to escape.
rows.description_html: ABOUT 'Escape from HAON ISLAND' is a first-person 3D platformer with unique controls - where you find yourself on an island with happy inhabitants and try to escape. STORY A strange voice is telling you, to escape. Afterward, you land in a crater of a mysterious Island. You soon encounter its happy inhabitants who are very friendly and positive. On your journey, you eliminate weird creatures by jumping onto them, while some others should better be avoided. By exploring you solve problems, master your jumping skill and get to know more about the island. Eventually you figure out what this whole place is about, why you are there and how you can escape. GAMEPLAY 'Escape from HAON ISLAND' is a small, simple, story driven 3D indie platformer for the PC. You play in the first-person perspective and move around by jumping and running. The key gameplay feature is to master the controls to get skilled enough to solve the jumping passages. Simple, but not easy. You can play with a keyboard & mouse or a game pad. Furthermore, you can adjust the sensitivity of the camera's movement speed to your liking. There are seven different levels. You can find a lot of collectibles in most of them. You only have one life point; if you get hit, the level will restart. There is no option to save, only checkpoints after each level. Thus, after you successfully finish a level, you might be able to find a shortcut. The game has no violence or rough, inappropriate language.

rows.name: Turtle Champs
rows.short_description: Play as a Turtle and duke it out in a game of Football. Use your gun to fly around the field or even shoot the ball.
rows.description_html: Take control of a Turtle in a game of Football in this First Person Shooter. Use your gun for movement and to shoot the ball around. Turtle Champs is an online multiplayer game where you and your friends can duke it out in the Football field to see who is the true Turtle Champion. Your weapon is your best friend. Use the pistol to either shoot the ball, launch your opponents or fly around the field at great speeds. You get 5 minutes on the clock to score more goals than your opponents. Gameplay: Play for 5 minutes to see which team can score the most goals. This game is intended to appeal to the casual audience who just want a free game to play with their online friends. Please do not take this game too seriously... it's literally Turtle Football with guns Your Weapon: For the default game mode, you are given 9 bullets for your pistol. You can shoot either 1 or 3 bullets at a time depending on what you need. Your gun only reloads while on the ground but aerial movement will let you hit the ball before your opponents. This can allow more skilled players to have an advantage over new players. The Field: There are 3 maps: Forest, Beach and Space. These maps are purely aesthetic have no difference in gameplay. The field is large as players have more range with their weapons and can move quickly. Because players have long range, there is a small goal located above the large one. This goal is a 3 pointer whereas the bottom large goal is only 1 point. While it might be difficult to hit, it can separate good players from great players. The Experience: Turtle Champs puts the players first. Though the game is recommended to be played on the Default settings, we give players the freedom of playing how they want to play. (up to 8 players is supported but we recommend no more than 4 for ping reasons) The F2P Model: Turtle Champs includes NO pay to win features. The entire game is free except for the Cosmetic Pass which is available to purchase. The Cosmetic Pass is a DLC content that can be purchased that allows players to add a topper onto their shell or change the skin of your weapon. Other players will be able to see these changes.

rows.name: Sound of Slash
rows.short_description: A rhythm action game in sync with the music, experiencing a variety of cool actions. A ranking system that allows users to compete globally while playing their favorite tunes. A free store system where players can share and play their own created music and notes with others.
rows.description_html: Overview: A world divided into eight terrains, each with a rune that maintains and manages the terrain and guardian spirits that protect it. The terrains are destroyed by the contamination of the runes, and the spirits and creatures that inhabit them, including the guardians, are turned evil by the runes. G, a wanderer who protects the runes of this world, senses that the world is becoming strange and realizes that the runes are becoming corrupted, so he sets out on a journey to each terrain to purify the corrupted runes and guardians! Design: Design inspiration from the art style of classic arcade games from the 90s, Ussistant aim to encapsulate a stylized and cartoony aesthetic that evokes a sense of retro nostalgia. With vibrant action and effects, our goal is to emphasize the impact and thrill of rhythm gaming. Localization: Currently, we only service English, but in the future, we also plan to service languages ​​from various Asian and European countries, and add not only languages ​​but also music genres from each country so that more people can enjoy it.

rows.short_description: Manage your own pawn shop in the weird galaxy. Purchase and sell different items, attend auctions, stop thieves and keep the shop going!
rows.description_html: Dive into your own pawn shop in this free shop management game! Though it may not feel like home yet, it soon will as you tidy up and launch your business. In this unique shop, you'll meet customers from all corners of the galaxy. Master the trade of alien artifacts, earthling relics, and more, as you aim to buy low and sell high for the greatest profits. Your adventure isn't just about buying and selling. You'll also need to source parts to repair and restore the broken treasures that arrive in your shop, adding value and earning you even more Galactic Credits . Your path to becoming a legendary interstellar entrepreneur begins here. Welcome to the galaxy's hustle, where every transaction can either catapult you to wealth or leave you floating in space. FEATURES Do business with a diverse array of customers from across the galaxy. Source repair parts, fix broken items, and increase your earnings. Protect your shop against thieves. Take part in storage auctions. Risk your credits to possibly find treasures or end up with junk! Upgrade your shop, unlock new crafting recipes, and explore different planets to find rare items. Perform daring heists.

rows.name: Mercenaries of War
rows.short_description: Welcome to Mercenaries of War, an online hardcore crime based PvP MMO with permanent death and Legacy System.Keep yourself protected by buying weapons and stocking up on bullets. If you die, your character is permanently dead and you will have to start over fresh.
rows.description_html: Mercenaries of War is a modern hardcore crime based PvP MMO with permanent death and legacy system. Mercenaries of War was originally created with one thing in mind; create a positive hardcore PvP game environment with full development transparency and be actively involved in the player community to create the ultimate hardcore experience together. Start off doing small crimes and illegal activities and earn your rep. Stock up on bullets and grab a gun to protect yourself. Participate in many activities such as group heists, hit the casinos, buy a property and make money off other players. Make some allies and form a crew. If the Boss and Underboss of a crew dies, the crew is taken out and all remaining members dropped. Getting ready for a crew war? Crew management can distribute bullets to all members to ready for war. Permanent death is ruthless and Mercenaries are always hunting. Be careful out there. Will you come out on top or will you be left 6 feet under? Decide your legacy.
rows.about_html: Mercenaries of War is a modern hardcore crime based PvP MMO with permanent death and legacy system. Mercenaries of War was originally created with one thing in mind; create a positive hardcore PvP game environment with full development transparency and be actively involved in the player community to create the ultimate hardcore experience together. Start off doing small crimes and illegal activities and earn your rep. Stock up on bullets and grab a gun to protect yourself. Participate in many activities such as group heists, hit the casinos, buy a property and make money off other players. Make some allies and form a crew. If the Boss and Underboss of a crew dies, the crew is taken out and all remaining members dropped. Getting ready for a crew war? Crew management can distribute bullets to all members to ready for war. Permanent death is ruthless and Mercenaries are always hunting. Be careful out there. Will you come out on top or will you be left 6 feet under? Decide your legacy.

People used to clone mummies from pyramids and believe in them again. After rebuilding the pyramids all around the world, the new Faraons left the earth's citizens and a big social catastrophe happened. Nobody survived it. rows.name: Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery
rows.short_description: Dive into the most fun idle fishing arcade game! Manage your Fish Kingdoms with automated fishing, upgrade your boat and gear, invest in passive income, and outsmart the market. Become the ultimate fish tycoon!
rows.description_html: Crush in your rainboots and hop into your boat! We are going fishing in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery, a unique idle fishing arcade featuring smooth graphics and intuitive mechanics. We have no time to swing a fishing rod, so let’s streamline the process! SIMPLE AND EASY FISHING Let’s start with the basics. It’s all about automation: fish start biting as soon as you approach them, and resource indicators keep you informed while you focus on managing your Fish Kingdom effectively. The game offers advantageous upgrades to enhance your idle fishing abilities, helping you become a true fish tycoon. You’ll still need to steer your boat to chase fish schools and avoid obstacles, so don’t get too distracted by your economic prowess! UPGRADE YOUR FISH KINGDOM Once your hull is full, it’s time to get upgraded! Improvements in fishing speed let you catch more and rarer species, while increased storage capacity allows you to hold more catches in your boat. Boost your boat’s speed and defense for impact protection, and enhance your fishing rods to cast multiple lines at once. It’s all about maximizing your gains in the most efficient way, so you’ll have to use your head to figure out the best way to success! MAKE IT BIG Just like in real life, becoming a fish tycoon involves various ways to profit from your catches. The Idle Fish Farm allows you to invest and get passive income, while the Black Market lets you upgrade your Fish Kingdoms beyond OSHA standards. The Bots Shop enables you to hire hunter, fisher, and cargo ships to fish and deliver catch for you, boosting your income. If day trading is your thing, there is a Currency Exchange that has some special benefits. Tax fraud is not a crime, it’s an obligation if you want to make it big. NOW GO FISH Get ready to dive into the Fish Kingdoms and become the ultimate fish tycoon in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery!

rows.name: The Nightmare Chronicles - Horror In Da Hood
rows.short_description: Mason is assigned a new job from the big boss when strange things start happening and he discovers the true meaning of fear... Horror in Da Hood is a gripping first-person horror game set in the hood, where the supernatural lurks around every corner. Are you brave enough to face the real terror?
rows.description_html: JOIN DISCORD About the Game In these streets, gangsters ain't the only thing haunting yo step. Yo punk-ass too afraid to enter da hood? 'Horror in Da Hood' is the first episodic psychological horror game in The Nightmare Chronicles franchise. This debut episode is free to play. In The Nightmare Chronicles: Horror in Da Hood, you step into the shoes of Mason Ramirez, who is on his way to hear about a new job from the Big Boss. Unbeknownst to him, he's being watched as he makes his way through the hood. But who’s watching him... Or what, and why? Based on true stories or sightings, The Nightmare Chronicles delves into paranormal encounters and experiences of real people, woven into a gripping fictional narrative. Prepare yourself for a chilling journey where the streets hide more than just gangsters. Experience the intense thrill of survival in a first-person walking and running (and screaming) simulator. Explore the gritty streets of the hood while uncovering its hidden secrets. Engage in dynamic conversations with a diverse cast of characters and navigate through eerie, atmospheric environments. Use your wits to solve puzzles, avoid deadly encounters and confront the supernatural horrors that lurk around every corner. Will you survive the night and discover the truth? Atmospheric environments Photo-realistic graphics Conversations with NPC's Thrilling storyline Spine-chilling audio design

rows.name: Doug The Digger
rows.short_description: Doug The Digger is a casual, single-player mining and crafting game where you aim to escape a crash landing by crafting a rocket. The gameplay is simple but addictive—play at your own risk!
rows.description_html: Doug must dig down to find resources. The resources can be sold for upgrades and used for crafting. Running out of oxygen or fuel is always a possibility.

rows.name: ScrapDown
rows.short_description: Scrap Down is action shooter arena in the style of a 2D shooter set in a space theme. It offers casual and fast-paced shooting mechanics that are easy to understand. It enhances the fun by allowing players to prank each other with in-game items.
rows.description_html: Scrap Down is an action-packed 2D shooter arena game, set in an exciting space theme. The game features casual and fast-paced shooting mechanics that are easy to understand to players of all ages and skill levels. The heart of Scrap Down lies in its dynamic and chaotic gameplay, where players pilot their own spaceship and dive into intense battles with friends or other players, using a variety of futuristic weapons and gadgets, keeping each match fresh and unpredictable. The arenas are filled with obstacles and interactive elements that add to the strategic depth. Whether it's setting traps, leveling up your gears or using gadgets to take down your enemies, these features ensures that no two matches are ever the same. Scrap Down offers vibrant graphics, engaging gameplay, and a perfect blend of competition and humor, Scrap Down is the go-to casual shooter game for those looking to enjoy fast-paced action and fun moments.

rows.name: Dreamline 404
rows.short_description: Thank you for calling the Dreamline Service Center. We are dedicated to providing you with the highest quality dream services. How may I assist you today?
rows.description_html: Dear Valued Customer, Thank you for calling the Dreamline Service Center. We are committed to providing every wanderer user with the highest quality dream services. How may I help you today? 'Dreamline 404' is a short-form experimental game centered around phone calls. In the middle of the night, you're woken up by a text message from the 'Dreamline Service Center.' 'Congratulations, you're a winner!' Probably just a scam, you think. But the message's glitchy text and overall strangeness spark your curiosity. Your phone, a mysterious message, and a weird number you can't resist calling. Are you ready to dial into the unknown? Immerse yourself in a diverse collection of dreams from Wanderer users. Let our original soundtrack wash over you as you find your inner peace within vibrant dreamscapes. Please remember that Dreamline Corporation is your one and only trusted friend on this dream journey. At Dreamline, we're all about following your dreams. So let's make your life one where... ...Where all your dreams are not just your dreams. :) Controls Contact us · Game Design / Art / Narrative By @Blu  Daydreaminblu_studio@outlook.com · Programming By @VoidCatt   voidcattdev@gmail.com · Music By @Yellow   yunhaohwang@gmail.com Special Thanks English Localization by Max Ponoroff

rows.name: Arcane Rush
rows.short_description: ARCANE RUSH: Epic Card Battles. Clash, strategize, dominate!
rows.description_html: Step into the mesmerizing realm of 'ARCANE RUSH: Auto Battler' an enthralling card game that immerses you in a captivating adventure featuring mystical heroes and epic battles. Construct your deck, summon formidable allies, and partake in strategic clashes against adversaries hailing from every corner of the realm! Key Features: Unleash Your Tactical Mastery: Engage in intense card-based battles, strategically deploying your deck and unleashing devastating abilities. Craft cunning tactics, make calculated decisions, and claim victory against fierce opponents! Legendary Heroes: Choose from a roster of legendary heroes, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Unlock new heroes as you progress, uncover their gripping backstories, and master their signature moves. Deck Building Mastery: Collect a vast array of cards, from mythical creatures and mighty spells to enchanted artifacts. Construct your decks with precision, combining synergistic cards that harmonize with your hero's strengths. Thrilling battles: Engage in exhilarating battles against formidable opponents. Rise through the ranks, earn renown, and become the ultimate Arena champion! Strategic Depth: Develop your tactical prowess as you carefully manage resources, plan your moves, and counter your opponent's strategies. Adapt to changing circumstances, seize opportunities, and turn the tide of battle in your favor. Expansive Content: Embark on a journey filled with endless possibilities. Experience regular updates and expansions, introducing new cards, heroes, and exciting game modes to keep your adventures fresh and ever-engaging. Are you ready to join the battles and prove your mettle? Gather your cards, hone your skills, and prepare for an unforgettable card battle experience like no other!

rows.name: Infernal Bloodrush
rows.short_description: As demons threaten to spill into the world, it's up to you to protect the Realm by burning every demon to ash.
rows.description_html: Infernal Bloodrush is a 2.5d first-person doomlike where instead of shooting bullets, you burn through a horde of demons with fire magic. A few days ago, you were dragged from the darkness of the dungeon and made an offer. You would be released, on the condition that you lend the Realm your strength for a short period. Your charge: to stem the flow of demons and protect the Realm. Destroy enemies by unleashing your Fire magic, by utilising an arsenal of powerful abilities. Spread fire by liting dead enemies' blood on fire. Explore sunken map while you defend a gate to the overworld.

rows.description_html: Throughout history racing tournaments have had the goal of determining the best racer alive. However, the Chrono Club initiative has aimed to go even higher! They intend to find the best kart racer of all time, front and back! It is going to be a race against time. Be the fastest in circuits full of danger! Beat your friends in local mode Chose among different racers and environments This game was developed as a 4th-year student project at DigiPen Europe-Bilbao for educational purposes. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Pineapple Panic!
rows.short_description: Have your games become bland and fruitless? Help Pina, the terrified pineapple, to dodge and leap over obstacles so that he can outwit the dastardly Chef Joe Colada in this rear-facing endless runner. Can you outpace his culinary madness, or will you end up in a fruity predicament?
rows.description_html: Are you a fan of sarcasm, the 90s, and pineapples? Then Pineapple Panic! is the game for you! In Pineapple Panic! , you play as Piña, a sarcastic pineapple on the run from the temperamental chef, Joe Colada, who is determined to turn you into a delicious beverage. In this endless runner the main goal is simple, survive as long as you can without getting caught by Joe Colada. He'll say anything to get you to slow down, so stay sharp! Maintain your distance from Joe by jumping over and dodging obstacles. Collect pineapple chunks to earn a unique ability that you can use to slow Joe down. Challenge yourself with the Leaderboard system, which allows you to see the top scores. Meet Piña: Life as a pineapple isn't easy, according to Piña. Between beach lounging and long naps, Piña never imagined he'd be sprinting for his life. Everything changed when Joe Colada started chasing him, turning his peaceful life into an endless escape. Meet Joe Colada: With a flair for dramatic presentations and a relentless pursuit of culinary perfection, Joe Colada is always looking for the finest ingredients. And he believes Piña is the pièce de resistance he needs. Why will you love Pineapple Panic? Humor and Sarcasm: Piña's witty commentary and the game's humorous take on the endless runner genre will keep you entertained. Retro Aesthetic: Relive the 90s with vibrant visuals and a catchy, nostalgic soundtrack. Challenging Yet Fun: The game is easy to pick up but hard to master, providing endless fun and replayability. Note: No pineapples were harmed in the making of this game.

rows.name: Slap That
rows.short_description: Slap almost anything blocking your way in order to go deeper and deeper and discover what is going on in this world!
rows.description_html: Experience the only first-person 'Slapper' game where you take control of an enraged being navigating through a skyscraper by slapping everything and everyone in sight. Run, jump, and clear your path to the next level by slapping anything in your way. Discover secret snails in each level and slap them too. Confront multiple enemies and slap them into submission. You can even use any object as a weapon by slapping it! In this game, everything is designed for you to slap. Play 'Slap That!' and unleash your slapping fury! Slap obstacles! Slap enemies! Find your way to the next level by... slapping! This game was developed as a 4th-year student project at DigiPen Europe-Bilbao for educational purposes. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Cassiculus
rows.short_description: This terrifying first-person horror experience immerses the player into a world of isolation, fear, paranoia and claustrophobia as you make your way through the Oberon Cave. Throughout the game, you will experience atmospheric environments, disturbing audio and horrifying visuals.
rows.description_html: This terrifying first-person horror experience immerses the player into a world of isolation, fear, paranoia and claustrophobia as you make your way through the Oberon Cave. Throughout the game, you will experience atmospheric environments, disturbing audio and horrifying visuals. Delve deep into the Oberon Cave In a remote cave deep in the wilderness a team of amateur spelunkers set out to explore its mysterious depths. It's not long until their excitement turns into terror as they delve deeper into the darkness, they soon stumble upon a terrifying discovery. Gameplay Equipped with a trusty headtorch, you must explore the regions of the cave in search of your brother and his friends. Cassiculus features no combat. This experience focuses primarily on atmosphere and dread. There are multiple cutscenes to encounter, items to discover and other secrets along the way.

rows.name: D.N.A: Do Not Answer
rows.short_description: 'D.N.A is a short first-person, story-driven horror game developed by a small idipendent studio. Players navigate an eerie, abandoned hospital, uncover clues, manage limited light sources, and face a dark presence. Featuring multiple endings, realistic graphics, and immersive sound design.'
rows.description_html: D.N.A: Do Not Answer About this Game: D.N.A is our debut PC game, a story-driven (or interactive drama) horror experience. Mainly developed by a small team of three passionate creators at Well of Tales, this short and intense game is offered for free as an introduction to our walk in the game industry. Plot Summary: You play as Alice, a young nurse who wakes up in an apparently abandoned hospital. As you navigate this eerie setting, you find your phone, charged to just 7%, which becomes your only source of light in the increasingly dark and twisted corridors. As Alice explores the hospital, she uncovers clues to piece together her fragmented memories while striving to escape. Beware, the longer you stay in the dark, the greater the chance the lurking presence will catch you. Gameplay: D.N.A is a first-person horror game where each decision can lead to a different ending. As Alice, your mission is to escape the hospital, recover your memories, and avoid succumbing to the darkness. The game alternates between intense gameplay and cinematic scenes, ensuring a deeply engaging experience. Game Features: Immersive Storytelling: A gripping narrative that pulls you into Alice's mysterious and terrifying predicament. Atmospheric Exploration: Traverse a hospital that transforms from seemingly clean and abandoned to a decaying, metaphysical nightmare. Strategic Gameplay: Conserve your phone’s battery by finding charging stations to survive the encroaching darkness. Multiple Endings: Your choices shape Alice's fate, leading to different outcomes based on your gameplay. High-Quality Production: Enjoy a photorealistic and immersive environment created with Unity 3D, featuring professional voice acting by Elisabeth Yorke Bolognini and original soundtrack. Will you help Alice find the way out, or will the darkness claim her?

rows.name: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware
rows.short_description: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware is a free prequel to the original game. In a medieval fantasy world, you are to build settlements, raise huge armies, and defend against massive hordes of enemies. Learn how Ironbrow clan shaped the world's map the first time - if you survive, that is.
rows.description_html: The prequel invites you to participate in the events preceding the story told in the campaign of the main game. You are the famous filibuster Duncan Ironbrow, who was unexpectedly dragged into 'big politics'. You are destined to become a hero of the Battle for Independence of Samreignia. Two story missions, plus one Endless Mode exclusive map layout await you. Like in the original RTS-game, in Diplomacy is Not an Option: Shareware, you need to develop your economy and hire armies, to stand against overwhelming enemy forces. Build fortifications, raise your armies, and experience warfare on an entirely new scale. Over 25 THOUSAND enemies will assault your castle walls. Every arrow, catapult stone and enemy launched skywards is physically modeled, making for a tactile and coherent battlefield. Just make sure your troops have towers to shoot from and clear lines of sight, or you might find your best-laid plans embarrassingly blunted by your own fortifications. Create kill-zones and fall-back positions. You will need to take an active role in combat to get the best from your men. A functional army requires a functional economy to support and feed it. Food, Wood, Stone, Iron, and Gold are the foundations of your city’s economy, and you will need to watch your supplies carefully if you are to meet the advancing foe in a timely manner. Gather resources, choose your storage locations, plan your expansions and upgrades with care. The enemy will not cede their lands willingly, and unprotected civilian expansions will have consequences of falling prey to the hostile incursion. Trade, via the impressive merchant dirigible, bringing emergency supplies of food to feed the men, or stone to rebuild the walls. Of course, sturdy castle walls will protect you from most ordinary threats, but why use only might whereas magic exists as well? Learn it yourself and trap the souls of your fallen enemies. There are few spells in the game, but using any of them can change the course of the battle. Build magical monuments, harvest soul crystals and give a try to a maniacal laugh as searing magical beams tear through your foes and summoned Dark Knights to chase down the stragglers. Oh, and don't forget about the ability to freeze time. After all, pausing the game is a kind of 'magic' that is available to you at any moment.

rows.name: Farm Debt Repay Life:Prologue
rows.short_description: this is the prologue version of 'Farm Debt Repay Life', challenge you with randomized resources and buffs. Cultivate farmland, mine minerals, craft tools, and repay a huge debt with wisdom and hard work. Along the way, uncover the secrets of three enigmatic cat girls and forge friendships with them.
rows.description_html: Add Wishlist About the Game Game description : 'Farm Debt Repay Life: Prelogue' is the prologue version of 'Farm Debt Repay Life' ,allowing players to experience the first 15 days of gameplay, including the storyline. It features the same fully randomized resource generation and diverse random buffs as the full version. Players can enjoy cultivating farmland, planting crops, mining minerals, smelting ores, upgrading, and crafting various tools. Game Features : Rich resources, free to explore. You can freely explore here, collecting abundant resources and various minerals in the wild (refreshed once a week) to develop and operate the farm. farming, to increase wealth. You can grow more than 20+ species of crops on your farm, fish more than 30+ species of fish on the river or sea, and further process these outputs for higher value returns. Reasonable expansion and control of finances. Although you are carrying a large amount of debt, and the interest will continue to increase (as in reality :)), you can borrow to expand properly, use the borrowed funds to grow rapidly, quickly accumulate wealth, reduce your debt, avoid heavy interest, and eventually become a financial management master. Extract Buff, improve ability. You can spend a certain amount of money to obtain over 90+ buffs that will increase your ability to pay off debt to an incredible degree, such as reducing the growing time of crops, doubling the value of processed items, getting more fish when fishing, etc...... Start your own farm and pay off your debts!

rows.name: PandaBomber
rows.short_description: PandaBomber is a fast-paced, competitive Bomberman-inspired game where strategy meets adrenaline. Outwit your opponents, plant bombs, and claim victory in intense multiplayer battles. Master your moves, explode your enemies, and reign supreme in the ultimate explosive showdown!
rows.description_html: Step into the explosive world of PandaBomber, a modern reimagining of the classic Bomberman experience! Engage in fast-paced, strategic gameplay that challenges you to think on your feet while delivering heart-pounding action. Whether you're outwitting opponents with crafty bomb placements or dodging explosions in high-stakes battles, every moment in PandaBomber is filled with excitement. Competitive Multiplayer Go head-to-head with friends or foes in thrilling, fast-paced matches. Dynamic Arenas Explore a variety of unique, destructible arenas that keep the gameplay fresh and engaging. Skill-based Strategy Plant bombs, trap enemies, and use your environment to your advantage to claim victory. High-energy Combat With quick rounds and increasing intensity, every match pushes you to refine your skills and react faster than ever before. Are you ready to blast your way to victory? Join the chaos, perfect your strategy, and dominate the leaderboards in PandaBomber!

rows.name: StreamerBeater
rows.short_description: It's free, try it ;) Third person souls-like featuring a solid combat mechanic, 5 explorable levels, 3 big boss fights, mobs, cutscenes, unlockables, and a main story.
rows.description_html: It's Free, Try It ;) Gameplay Third person souls-like featuring a solid combat mechanic, 5 explorable levels, 3 big boss fights, mobs, cutscenes, unlockables, and a main story. Lore The main character of the game is addicted to watching live streams. But whenever he does so, he starts zoning out and daydreaming. In this state, he becomes trapped in his imaginary world fed by the screen before his eyes. To free himself, he needs to explore this world and defeat the entity that's actively triggering his dream. Playtime Main story: Should take around 1-3h based on your skill ;) Unlocking all items: 2-5h Feel free to speedrun the game! In fact, I heavily encourage you to do so! Have Fun Fellow Gamer ;)

rows.name: Pixel Flip
rows.short_description: Embark on endless stages of card matching fun. Dive into a vibrant world, collect all the 'Pixels', strategize your moves and level up your character. Can you become the ultimate Pixel Collector?
rows.description_html: Pixel Flip is an engaging puzzle game that challenges players to match and collect cards across endless stages of Pixel Flipping amusement. Immerse yourself in a vibrant pixelated world where every flip could bring you closer to completing your collection. Featuring a charming pixel art style that brings nostalgic vibes to the forefront, dive into a colorful world filled with adorable characters and vibrant environments. Each card flip is accompanied by satisfying sound effects and beautiful background music, enhancing the overall gameplay experience. Embark on a journey through the endless stages, each presenting a new set of challenges and surprises. Match identical cards to uncover their hidden pixels and add them to your collection. Strategize your moves wisely to rank up your character faster! Can you flip your way to victory and become the ultimate Pixel Collector?

rows.name: Gears Of Time
rows.short_description: It is an Isometric Dungeon Crawler with a few RPG elements in which the character must escape from a great tower after stealing the hourglass.
rows.description_html: Game created In Creanavarra. Dungeon Crawler with Platforming, Action, and Bullet Hell elements with a Gear-Like Hability System. The player must escape from a large tower after having stolen the hourglass. You must go down the different floors that make up the tower, avoiding its traps, fighting with its guardians and solving the necessary puzzles to escape alive. The character will acquire new objects and skills that will help him in all these situations and which he can combine to obtain powerful synergies. You will manage your life, your dash and the power to slow down time with gears. This game is a university project so it is not completely polished, we still want to hear your opinion of the game, whether good or bad.

rows.name: Wicked Arcana
rows.short_description: Step into the mystical world of 'Wicked Arcana,' where ancient runes unlock powerful magic and hidden truths in this early access demo.
rows.description_html: Please Note: Announced on September 6th, 'Wicked Arcana' will temporarily not be updated or worked on at this time. We've decided to take a break to start something new! We plan to revisit 'Wicked Arcana' in the future, so make sure to follow us to stay up-to-date. ~Novus Studio Step into the mystical world of Wicked Arcana, where ancient runes unlock powerful magic and hidden truths. In this stylized action RPG, blend the art of melee combat with the mystique of rune-based spells to unravel a story inspired by mythological lore. Embrace the challenge of mastering diverse combat techniques, explore enchanting environments brimming with secrets, and embark on a quest that transcends the boundaries of traditional mythology. With every rune collected, uncover a narrative woven with the threads of legends, reimagined in a world where magic is not just a tool, but a gateway to discovering your true potential. Wicked Arcana is not just a game—it's a journey into a realm where your actions shape the legacy of myths. Integrative Rune-based Magic System Central to 'Wicked Arcana' is its innovative rune magic system, where runes are not only used for combat but also serve as keys for exploration and puzzle-solving. This system interweaves gameplay with lore, enriching both combat and environmental interaction. Deep and Engaging Combat The game melds melee combat with strategic magic use, providing a dynamic combat experience. It rewards skill and strategic planning, requiring players to balance physical attacks and magical abilities. Rich Narrative 'Wicked Arcana' presents a unique story that’s universal yet distinctive in its storytelling. This narrative depth encourages exploration and discovery, immersing players in a world where their actions resonate with mythological grandeur.

rows.name: Hamster
rows.short_description: Hamster is an idle clicker Game in which you click a Hamster to make him shiver. Each click has a random chance to make him shake a little more, or a little less. Can you make him go crazy?
rows.description_html: Hamster is an idle clicker Game in which you click a Hamster to make him shiver. Each click has a random chance to make him shake a little more, or a little less. You can collect heaps of different kinds of hamsters for your Steam Inventory by just playing the game! How It works Click on the Hamster to increase the counter. Each click has a random chance to increase or decrease the hamsters shiver level from 0 to infinity. Drop different Hamsters for your Steam Inventory every 90 minutes. Use your collected Hamsters in-game as Skins! Planned Features Giving every Hamster Skin their own unique set of VFX. Utilize duplicate Hamster Skins in-game. The game cannot be played using a controller. ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー ABOUT THE GAME 'ORDER9' is an 'auto-battle card game' where players choose a character, and help lead them to victory over other opponents. CHARACTER SELECTION Choose 1 from 9 available characters. From the remaining, 3 opponents will be randomly chosen to fight you in battle. CHARACTER ABILITIES Every character has 3 abilities, 'skill', 'buff' and 'punch'. An ability will be chosen at random each turn. FLOW OF COMBAT Combat plays out in 3 phases: The 'Target Phase', 'Choice Phase', and 'Battle Phase'. - Target Phase: The 4 participants will automatically determine their target(s) for the turn, influenced by their abilities. - Choice Phase: By using 'mana', the player can choose cards to change the conditions of battle. Aim to give your character the upper hand! e.g. Increasing everyone's defense when your character is being targeted the most.. - Battle Phase: All characters will perform their actions for the turn automatically, influenced by their abilities in the Target Phase, and the player's actions in the Choice Phase. Turns continue in this way until an ultimate victor is determined. Control the game! Control the battle! Lead your chosen one to victory!!

rows.name: KiLLPaKu!
rows.short_description: A 3D action game where you control Bebe, a gluttonous monster. Aim at the weak points of the fighting 'onis' and deal the final blow! Literally, enjoy picking the best parts!
rows.description_html: ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー This work is a game created at Byking Co., Ltd.'s training for new employees. It may not work properly depending on your PC environment. Also, unintended problems may occur in the game. please note that. ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー ■What is 'Killpaku!'? A 3D action game where you control Bebe, a gluttonous monster. Aim at the weak points of the fighting 'onis' and deal the final blow! Literally, enjoy picking the best parts! ■Three types of “copying”, “predation”, “stealing”, and “imitation” Make full use of the 3 actions to earn more scores within the 3 minute time limit! Eat as much as you can to avoid being defeated and aim for S rank! ■The first “rip-off” and “predation” It can extend its tongue to eat weakened prey. There are two ways to eat, one is to eat quickly in a straight line, and the other is to eat in batches while rotating. ■Second “rip-off” and “stealing” It is the act of finding a weakened enemy and taking the final blow from the prey. If the timing is right, you can 'predate'. Move around so as not to be defeated, and aim for the enemies whose health bar is yellow and prey on them! ■Third “copying” and “imitation” You can change the color by passing through puddles scattered throughout the game. Let's blend in with the herd of oni and prey safely! ■Worldview ``Bebe'' is a gluttonous monster, but he doesn't have the strength to fight his prey on his own. Therefore, they ``mimic'' their prey, mix with the herd, and ``predate'' the moment the prey is weakened. The prey of this game is 'Oni'. 'Oni' has strong power that can defeat other creatures with a single blow, and has lived by eating a lot of food. As a result, Bebe has a plump body and is well-nourished. They have low intelligence and are easily angered, and ``Red Oni'' and ``Blue Oni'' often fight each other just because of their color difference.

rows.description_html: ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー This work is a game created at Byking Co., Ltd. training for new employees. It may not function properly depending on your PC environment. Also, unintended problems may occur in the game. Please take note of this. ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー About this game The main character, Wrench, uses her 'Double Lariat' to defeat many enemies and make the show more exciting! The audience can enjoy the game by defeating many enemies at the same time or by defeating them in a row. The audience will get excited by defeating many enemies at the same time or by defeating enemies one by one. You can also defeat the audience, but be aware that your score will be deducted. Story I'm Wrench-chan! I love mechanics and I work as an engineer! I wanted to test the durability of the machine. I wanted to test the durability of the hand armor I had developed. One day, I was invited to participate in a certain show! It's a show where the more double lariat you do, the more the audience grows! So cute! Appearing on the show If I can gather a large audience, it will be a great chance for everyone to know about my technical skills! I'm still practicing the double lariat. Sometimes I get dizzy when I spin around too much... but I'm sure it will be fine! It will blow away all the other performers and make it the best show ever! -SUPER LARIAT SHOW TIME! ! Performer You're at the show just like me! There are some unique performers that aren't easy to blow away, so be careful! . Audience SYSTEM Let's blow up the performers and get the audience excited! If the conditions are met, they will flip a coin! Double Lariat Action Surprise the performer with my Double Lariat Drift on the ground, spin action in the air Fever Gauge If you keep spinning or get coins... My deadly Fever Lariat will explode Let's blow the performers away together Results SYSTEM How much excitement was there at the venue? A rank will be displayed based on the excitement of the audience! Aim for rank S!

rows.name: First Person Stapler
rows.short_description: Clear targets in your office call center and race to the exit in this ridiculous, stapler-centric target shooter.
rows.description_html: Update Notes Additions: -New Level: Renovation I knew early on that I wanted to include a construction stapler as a weapon option. So, I felt like I needed to include a construction area in the game. The new level of the game let's you explore a half-built floor of the office building, hunting targets around exposed beams, piles of bricks, and gapped scaffolding. -Collectibles: Flair This game is very, very heavily inspired by Office Space and old stories from ANMA. I needed to do something with flair because that scene is too good to leave out, but too out of context to build into any gameplay. So, there are now 13(?) pieces of flair scattered throughout the game. If you see something, shoot something. -Mini Games: Shooting Gallery I revamped the Warehouse for another mini-game, this time a shooting range. There are barriers set up with boxes, targets that flip up and down, all the good stuff. Test your speed and accuracy at the shooting range. Fixes: -Doors are now more responsive, you can read about their history here. -Music is a hell of a lot lower. I watched some people stream my game and realized not everyone wants an office-based rave. Thanks for playing. About the Game Kill time at your call center night shift by shooting targets with a stapler, kicking doors, breaking photocopiers, popping balloons, guzzling coffee, stealing moon shoes, kicking your coworker's computers off a desk, and generally wrecking up the place. The game is simple, get to the exit and shoot as many targets as possible on your way. Shooting clocks will give you more time, coffee speeds you up, headshots give a higher score, and, different kinds of staplers can be found around the map. Clear levels with a high score to unlock the next level and a few ridiculous mini-games
