rows.name: Containment Breach
rows.short_description: Containment Breach is a wave-based zombie survival game where you can blow the limbs off of enemies. Earn points to unlock doors, buy and upgrade weapons, perks, and equipment. See how fast you can escape the facility or choose to stay and go for the highest round possible.
rows.description_html: Aim For The Head The only way to kill zombies is by shooting them in the head. However, each of their arms can absorb bullets unless you shoot them.. or explode them off. Shooting limbs wastes ammo but rewards you with more points. Upgrade Each run starts the same, just you and your pistol. Kill enemies to get points to buy up to five different perks and ten different weapons. Each weapon can be upgraded up to two times to obtain elemental modifiers. Escape Or Survive Follow the objectives to make your way out of the facility as fast as possible, but you will have to override the vault door, and that can attract a lot of attention... Or you can choose to stay and survive as many rounds as possible. Feedback Appreciated This is my first game I have put out there so feel free to leave any feedback and I will work on updating the game to address any balance issues, game breaking bugs, and unclear mechanics. I have already gathered a list of player feedback to implement soon. About The Developer Hello. I am a solo developer making games after my 9-5 job. This is my first game I have actually managed to released and I did most of the art myself (I am mostly a programmer). I plan to push updates to address player feedback as it comes in, and i really appreciate it. In the meantime ill be working on an expanded idea of this game that will include a base-building and tower defense mechanic, as well as multiplayer.

rows.name: Utility for the Soul
rows.short_description: A miniature meditative puzzle experience based on the Lithuanian-American environment artist Aleksandra Kasuba’s concept of the Retreat House - a unique, utopian facility used by large corporations to rejuvenate their overworked employees.
rows.description_html: A proposal for enlightened corporations with a concern for the social implications resulting from prolonged neglect of human needs in our mechanized society. - Lithuanian-American environment artist Aleksandra Kasuba, 1970 A corporation is to build and maintain a Retreat House to provide its people with relief from everyday demands and pressures of the office. The Retreat house is to be used by all corporation employees on a rotational basis, on the corporation’s time and at its expense. The visitor will spend most of his time in the Galleries, where the elemental displays take place. The Galleries are designed to feel enormous, seemingly without walls, and to sound like echo chambers. Here the visitor will encounter the Elements: Earth, Air, Fire, Water. Given time unregimented, confronted with Elemental occurances, and free from a constant rush of information which stifles natural reactions, the visitor would be able to experience the self in an environment not by the dictates of a particular society, but be forced to respond to himself alone. The experience could reveal one’s true self, and hopefully stir it enough to pursue its substance. Aleksandra Kasuba (1923 – 2019) - a Lithuanian-American environment artist. In 1970 she authored Utility for the Soul , a competition entry in a short book format for Projects Outside Art launched by Experiments in Art and Technology (E.A.T.) , an organization developing collaborations between artists and engineers. Utility for the Soul would eventually become Kasuba’s manifesto, implementing the utopian goal at the core of her research, the search for a harmonious world and a peaceful dialogue between humankind, nature and technology. FEATURES Original utopian narrative - based upon a short story by artist Aleksandra Kasuba Puzzle infused gameplay - 11 rooms to explore, each with a unique elemental puzzle Ambient soundscape - meditative, soothing atmosphere Minimalist graphics - hand animated black and white visuals Multiple languages - Playable in English, French and Lithuanian Miniature experience - 15 to 30 min. of gameplay REVIEWS A space in which we can ponder the dual nature of what it means to encounter a critique of a data-driven busy society on a device which facilitates exactly what the art piece sets out to critique in the first place. - IndieCade 2021 Jury ABOUT THE DEVELOPER Weekend Warriors is a small and young independent games collective from Vilnius, Lithuania. Game design - Povilas Vincentas Jankūnas Programming - Daumantas Šimkus, Mykolas Krupauskas, Aleksandras Trakas Sounds & Music - Ignas Čeponis

In 1970 she authored Utility for the Soul , a competition entry in a short book format for Projects Outside Art launched by Experiments in Art and Technology (E.A.T.) , an organization developing collaborations between artists and engineers. Utility for the Soul would eventually become Kasuba’s manifesto, implementing the utopian goal at the core of her research, the search for a harmonious world and a peaceful dialogue between humankind, nature and technology. FEATURES Original utopian narrative - based upon a short story by artist Aleksandra Kasuba Puzzle infused gameplay - 11 rooms to explore, each with a unique elemental puzzle Ambient soundscape - meditative, soothing atmosphere Minimalist graphics - hand animated black and white visuals Multiple languages - Playable in English, French and Lithuanian Miniature experience - 15 to 30 min. of gameplay REVIEWS A space in which we can ponder the dual nature of what it means to encounter a critique of a data-driven busy society on a device which facilitates exactly what the art piece sets out to critique in the first place. - IndieCade 2021 Jury ABOUT THE DEVELOPER Weekend Warriors is a small and young independent games collective from Vilnius, Lithuania. rows.name: Farmer's Shop Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Start restoring your old family farm and managing your new shop in this free prologue. Grow your crops, sell your goods, and get the taste of what's to come in the full version. Did we already mention it's free?
rows.description_html: ADD THE FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST About the Game Imagine inheriting a farm AND a shop. What would you do with it? Yes, it's a mess. Yes, it needs work. But it's yours—and it’s free. In this economy?! Restore Your Farm Transform this abandoned land into the thriving farm it deserves to be. Grow your own crops, take care of animals (coming soon), and upgrade your surroundings. It'll take effort, but soon you'll be able to acquire new tools, improve your buildings, and customize the farm of your dreams. Open Your Own Shop Why sell your crops and produce to someone else when you can do it yourself? Ever heard of a farmer's market? Well, this shop has the 'farmer' part sorted. Organize your shop, manage the goods on your shelves, and handle all the finances! Sell directly to customers, or hire some help—you’re only human, after all. Master the Art of Multitasking Running a farm and a shop at the same time isn’t easy. But you’ve got this! Balance your time between tending to crops, serving customers, and managing the chaos. Do it all yourself, or hire help and order goods that you don't produce (at least, not yet). Will you focus on strict business? Go personal and sustainable? Maybe a bit of both? Only you can decide.

rows.name: Raspberry
rows.short_description: Raspberry is a simple and fun way to collect and trade raspberries with others. Most importantly to declare war on the evil banana's!
rows.description_html: Join us on Discord, check out our database of raspberries on the website and join the army in the defeat against the banana's. WHAT IS THIS GAME Simply, it's a clicker game with item drops that you can manage in your Steam inventory and even trade on the market place! WHY DID WE MAKE IT To declare war on the banana's and enforce the will of the almighty Raspberry! Or you know who ever else I guess.. FEATURES THAT SET US APART FROM THE NORMAL CLICKERS Ability to set the skin of the in-game raspberry to drops you have collected Clicking the backpack icon in-game will show you all the items you have collected in a drop. You can view a full list of available items at Drop notifications After each drop cycle, as scheduled. You will be show a message if 'You got a new drop!', or 'You did not get a drop this time..'. This was designed to help users better understand drops. New achievements 2 hidden achievements, and 4 achievements related to click goals Saving click progress Clicks save and persist even after the game has closed Saving time in game in relation to drops This now means that you can pickup where you left off after closing the game. For example, if you play the game for 1 hour 30 minutes, close the game and reopen later, you only have to wait 30 minutes to the hit the 2 hour scheduled drop. Time until next drop counter The counter in the top center of your screen is the time until the next drop. We added this so players know when the next drop coming. Login drops Players now receive login drops. Note after receiving your first login drop there is a cooldown period before the next login drop. Chance of item drops is located in the drop schedule. Easter eggs We have scattered Easter eggs throughout the game. FAIRNESS We enforce strict rules to ensure a fair experience for everyone. Developers and affiliates cannot trade or collect raspberries, and they must have public Steam profiles for transparency. Check the public list of affiliated users to verify compliance in our discord. DROP SCHEDULE

rows.name: Rat Raze / Road to Riches - Tilt Five
rows.short_description: Discover 2 brand new SmartGames for Tilt Five™! Outsmart your opponent and race across the finish line first in Rat Raze or work together to reach the treasure in Road to Riches
rows.description_html: * Tilt Five AR system required * Discover 2 brand new digital SmartGames demo’s for the amazing Tilt Five AR system! These demo games are for 2 players, there is one head-to-head and one co-op game for you to enjoy. If you like these demo’s, show us your support and we will turn them into full games! 1. Rat Raze In this crazy sliding race game 2 players compete to cross the finish line first. Each player slides the puzzle pieces in the right sequence, the arrows dictate the direction the car will go. Use your Tilt Five wand's joystick to slide the pieces on the gameboard. Then pull the joystick’s trigger to start your car and race to the finish. This game is all about speed. Be fast and race your car over the finish line first to win! This free demo version of Rat Raze comes with 8 different courses. 2. Road to Riches In this co-op game 2 players work together to build islands and roads so the pirate can find all the treasures. Players take turns to place a piece and build a path. Not all treasures are visible to both players! Communication between players is key as you try to find & build roads between all treasure chests. Guide the pirate to every treasure chest you can find! Cooperate with your partner to find the location of every chest. To place a road, point your Tilt Five wand and pull the trigger. The pirate is smart and will automatically walk when roads are built. No time to waste to get these chests! But beware, you have a limited number of pieces! Players must also avoid disturbing the kraken, it will steal every tile placed on top of it. This demo version of Road to Riches comes with 6 levels. If you like our games, show us your support!

rows.name: The Tunnels
rows.short_description: The Tunnels is a procedural maze environment, where everyone loses except grief What can only be the final truth is a mirror showing us what remains of our humanity. There is, however, an end to reach in this hallway.
rows.description_html: The Tunnels is a procedural maze environment, where everyone loses except grief This work reflects on the human cost of conflict. The information presented is based on real-time data, aiming to show how statistics can obscure the profound grief behind the numbers, and how we always see information through different lenses. This experience is not intended to entertain, but to provide a space for reflection on the human consequences of conflict, with profound respect for all victims and their families. There is, however, an end to reach in this hallway. In this immersive installation, the viewer evolves through a real and defining political space that most people have only seen through news, screens, and social media. A real non-space that can only be the projection of the viewer, and the developer, is constructed to try to make sense of the inhumane. After the overwhelming labyrinth of contradicting informations we are all constantly subjected to, what can only be the truth is a mirror showing us what remains of our humanity. The work is free but you can help the work of the UNWRA on their website.

rows.name: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty
rows.short_description: BE A CAT! SAVE YOUR HUMAN! You're a fluffy feline who must save their owner from the hordes of flesh eating greebles which dwell within the bathroom. Will she make it through her morning business alive? Only you can save her!
rows.description_html: BE A CAT and SAVE YOUR HUMAN from the GREEBLES! In Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty , you play as a cute feline on a mission to protect your beloved human from flesh-eating toilet monsters — the dreaded GREEBLES ! What to expect: A microgame — around 15 minutes of total playtime A very silly story Simple but fun gameplay A retro-style soundtrack My first solo dev project CAT! Note from the developer: I made this game after losing my job as a games writer. Originally, it was a paid game (99p) — after being unemployed for a year and a half, I couldn’t justify not charging something. Now that I’m back working as a games writer again, I’ve decided to make it free forever . It’s a very silly little game, but it brought me a lot of joy during a dark time, and I hope it brings a smile (and maybe a laugh) to anyone who gives it a try.

rows.name: Pug and Seek
rows.short_description: Pug and Seek is a hide-and-seek game: clever pugs run, hide, and cause chaos, while Jack, the unstoppable streamer, must find, catch, and return them to the pen. Challenge friends online and prove who is the master of hide-and-seek!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Pug and Seek: an exciting hide-and-seek game where the action never ends! Choose your side in this thrilling challenge: will you be the formidable MrJackx or one of the cunning pugs? Game Modes: MrJackx: Play as MrJackx, a tireless streamer who will stop at nothing to catch all the mischievous pugs. Use your wits and skills to explore the maze-like map, find the most unlikely hiding spots, and surprise the pugs. Only the fastest and most strategic will manage to catch them all! Pugs: In this mode, you are a pug trying to escape the relentless wrath of MrJackx. Run, hide, and use every corner of the map to avoid being caught. Your speed and adaptability will be your best weapons to survive until time runs out. Key Features: Online Multiplayer Game: Challenge your friends or MrJackx himself in multiplayer matches. Who will be the best at hiding or catching? Special Abilities: Use special abilities that will give you the decisive advantage, whether you are seeking or escaping. Choose your side, hone your skills, and dive into the adventure of Pug and Seek! Join the challenge and prove who the real master of hide-and-seek is!

rows.name: Haven & Hearth
rows.short_description: A free-to-play MMORPG with crafting, building, landscaping, foraging, hunting, fishing, a dash of poetry, and open PvP combat,
rows.description_html: Haven & Hearth is a MMORPG (Massive Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game) set in a fictional world loosely inspired by Slavic and Germanic myth and legend. The game sets itself apart from other games in the genre in its aim to provide players with an interactive, affectable and mutable game world, which can be permanently and fundamentally changed and affected through actions undertaken by the players. Our fundamental goal with Haven & Hearth is to create a game in which player choices have permanent and/or lasting effects and, thus, providing said players with a meaningful and fun gaming experience. Skills & Attributes Develop your character to unlock new Skills , Abilities , and Credos . Devour sumptuous feasts of food and drink to increase your Strength , Intelligence , Agility and other base Attributes . Study sundry Curiosities of nature and artifice to gain Learning Points to increase your Farming , Masonry , Exploration and other Abilities . Experience oddities and obscure situations to gain experience points and cast or incant the spells and charms of Hearth Magic . Discover materials previously unknown to you to unlock new recipes for Crafting & Building . Hunting & Gathering Slay vicious beasts of nature, flay their hides and tan for leather. Make sausages of Boar, and smoke Sea Gull Meat. Feasting and a varied diet is important to all Hearthlings . Forage rare flowers to Study , or bind them into bouquets for additional Learning Points . Traverse the vast- and wilderness of Haven & Hearth's procedurally generated world and gather rare Herbs, Mushrooms and Flowes. Pick wild seeds to grow into domestic crops for Farming , such as Grapes, Wheat, Carrots or Peas. Tame wild animals to raise Livestock like Cows, Pigs, Goats or Reindeer. Ride like the wind upon mighty Horses wild and tame, and breed your animals to ever rising qualities. Fish or cast nets in Rivers, Lakes, Oceans or Caves to catch a wide variety of aquatic life such as Cod, Perch, Bream, Halibut, Clams, Crabs, or Lobsters. Should true bravery inspire you; Venture into the depths of the cavernous underworlds of Dungeons such as Beaver Lodges, Bat Caves, or Ant Hills. Thraximundar's Vicious Hive of Tyranny awaits! Dig deep and greedily down multiple levels of caves, to extract minerals, ores, and precious gems from the inky fathoms below the plane of the Hearth. Mining and Forging are essential for progress, but rumors speak of Trolls in the deep! Crafting & Building Terraform the Hearth by digging, paving, plowing or planting. Hearthlings are the wolves of Hearthlings: Stake a Claim to your corner of the Hearth to protect it from roving bands of others. Construct mighty walls and palisades to keep your homestead safe. Erect homes and Houses of log and stone, from humble cabins to mighty towers. Smelt ores for metal, and refine further metallurgical advances in Finery Forges and Steel Crucibles . Cook as varied a diet as you can by building Ovens for Bread, Cauldrons for Stews, Sheds for Smoking or Meat Grinders for Sausages. Decorate with a wide variety of wall mountings, lanterns, shelves, tables, cupboards, and many other pieces of furniture. Construct Boats & Ships to carry you across the oceans blue, from humble Coracles to mighty Knarrs. Upload Custom Graphics to give that extra flair to banners, shields, flags, capes, and sails! Cycle and recycle your production line, acquire better materials and refine your production chains to increase the Quality of all produce. Things are what you make them; Watch the color and tenor of the Variable Materials you use reflected in the things you build and make. Should the Rocking Chair be made from Cherry, Maple, or Oak? Permanent Death & Open PvP Master the Dark Arts of Trespassing , Theft , Rage , Vandalism and Murder to impose upon others who roam the Hearth. Increase your Perception & Exploration to track down and bring to justice all breakers of peace and oaths, by tracking the vicious Stenches of Crime . Construct mighty Siege Machines and engines of war to bring the flames of war to foreign lands. Found Villages to claim large swathes of land and organize kith and kin into mighty bands. Found Realms and lay claim to entire Provinces by capturing the ancient Thingwalls dotting the Hearth. Bury the dead and fulfill the will of the ancestors to draw upon the strength of your previous lives. Experience the thrill of a world where all interactions with your fellow Hearthling carries the potentiality for grave consequence.

rows.description_html: Play as the little girl in the raincoat who is a master at jumping as you take on different themed levels. The choice is yours to embark on a climb up treacherous towers or engage in tactical battles. Explore misty maps and uncover the truth of the world.
rows.description_html: 'Morimens' is a roguelite card-battling game set in a world inspired by the Cthulhu mythos. Within the game, you will connect with a diverse array of awaker, each with distinct personalities, to construct a unique strategic deck tailored to your playstyle. Venture into the misty expanse of the game's map, confront unpredictable events, savor the tactical thrill of card-based combat, and progressively unravel the bizarre and maddening truths that lie at the heart of your investigation. 【Worldview】 The world is dying, yet its inhabitants remain blissfully unaware. Confronted with a covert, indescribable calamity, you shall take on the role of Keeper, awakening powers intertwined with the very doom threatening existence. You will link yourself with anthropomorphic weapons teetering on the precipice of madness, to withstand this monumental crisis. If all is destined to be forgotten, would you bear the burden of secrets as testament to the world's existence, forging ahead into the unknown? May tombstones stand as evidence, and may the Silver Key guide our way. Welcome to Mythag University, Keeper. 【Game Features】 ● A unique art style, accompanied by a diverse cast of characters, and a plethora of designs derived from the Cthulhu mythos, catering to your eclectic tastes and preferences! ● Four fundamental realms serve as the game's backdrop, complemented by an ever-expanding library of over 185 cards, with more being added continually. This extensive array fosters a wealth of playstyles, offering both breadth and depth in strategic options. It empowers you to construct decks freely, reveling in the strategic delight of overcoming great odds with clever tactics! ● Lightweight rogue-lite, low barrier to entry, yet highly replayable! Get started effortlessly and enjoy endless gameplay variety! Map events, loot drops, card buffs, shop refreshes... each round presents a uniquely shifting battlefield with fresh surprises and challenges awaiting at every turn! Character progression outside of battles, deck building strategies, in-game death resistance mechanics, and quick-witted adaptability ensure a more manageable, relaxed, and user-friendly experience for newcomers! ● Heart-rending storylines accompanied by evocative soundtracks lead players through episodic narratives that gradually descend into the mad truth and the abyss, portraying a gallery of human nature amidst despair and the flickering light of hope. ● Engage in solo tower-climbing challenges that push your strategic thinking to the limit; meanwhile, the PvP mode subverts solo mode with brand-new card effects and mechanics. There's no need for prolonged character development – jump right in and enjoy the thrill of fair and balanced combat! A Message from the Development Team Thank you for venturing into the world of 'Morimens'! Nothing brings us greater joy than having you experience our game. If you enjoy 'Morimens' or have any feedback about your experience, please do share it with us! Though this world may be fraught with peril, we are delighted to have crossed paths. May the Silver Key guide our way.

rows.name: Records of the Flycatcher
rows.short_description: The empire of Hadria has turned its war machine against the vulnerable eastern hinterlands of Altheim. With only your sniper rifle on your back, and a few strips of rabbit meat in your pocket, you must defend the motherland and wage a lone guriella war against the overwhelming tide of invaders.
rows.description_html: ... When you finally regain consciousness, you find yourself lying face down in the snow, with a long trail of footprints behind you. It seems you had collapsed from exhaustion.   You find yourself struggling to flip yourself over. When you eventually do, you find several newly acquired cuts and bruises all over yourself. You quickly administer some first aid, before spending a few minutes fiddling with your radio set. But as you expect, your frequencies remain silent.   On your back lies a small saving grace: a state-of-the-art imported bolt action sniper rifle, far superior to any domestically manufactured equivalent. You forgot exactly how it fell into your hands in the midst of the chaotic rout. And despite everything, part of you wished its previous owner was still alive.   Your chain of command has completely broken down. Hadrian soldiers are pouring across the eastern border in their tens of thousands, and you are one of the last few things standing between them and the defenseless villages across the vast Altheimian wilderness. In the absence of further orders, you have no choice but to conduct a fighting retreat by yourself. Quietly eliminiate Hadrian officers and agents. Set up ambushes, plan your attacks, and do everything in your power to slow down the enemy advance. Navigate through the vast Altheimian wilderness, trudging through terrain that may aid or hinder you. Encounter the occasional wildlife curious enough to approach your bonfire. Rendezvous with fellow soldiers. Exchange intel, or assist them if they are in trouble. Deal with any who had stepped out of line.  Encounter fellow Altheimians, resupply and rest in friendly villages, purchase their goods and services if needed. Help any remaining civilians flee the oncoming Hadrian onslaught, or ignore them to focus on your objectives.  Find abandoned items within the war-torn ruins that scatter the wilderness, and try not to get drunk from any leftover alcohol you find.  Try to balance your Sanity and personal well-being with the realities and necessities of war.

rows.name: Dusty's Sweeping Cleanup
rows.short_description: Clean your way around the house as a robot vacuum with this action and racing inspired experience!
rows.description_html: Dusty’s Sweeping Cleanup is an action and racing inspired experience about cleaning your way around the house. Take control of Dusty the Robot Vacuum and trace your own path in a variety of fast paced and open environments. This game was made in 15 weeks by a small group of students in Montréal, Canada. Features: Robot Movement: Boost, drift and jump with Dusty’s momentum-based movement. Robot Cleaning: Earn points by cleaning the floor and by sucking up a variety of objects in your environment. House-Based Levels: Clean your way through different rooms, each with their own unique layout and obstacles to overcome. Breaking objects: Break objects to create even more stuff to clean up! Collectibles: For the completionists, try to find all the special collectibles in each level. Secrets: Find hidden passages scattered around the house, with many secrets waiting to be revealed.

rows.name: Bushside Rangers: Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Bushside Rangers®: Chapter 1 is a first-person survival horror game that forces you to use your wits as you navigate through the dark, dreary depths of an abandoned nature park.
rows.description_html: SURVIVE THE HORRORS OF THE DESOLATE LAND. Bushside Rangers®: Chapter 1 is a first-person survival horror game that forces you to use your wits as you navigate through the dark, dreary depths of an abandoned nature park. ABOUT Play as the reluctant Vera, a young teen who breaks into the abandoned Bushside Rangers Nature Park to figure out what truly happened to cause it's closure five years prior. Since you last visited, nature has reclaimed it's territory, leaving only tainted memories of what once was. And yet after all of that, the parks' mascots are somehow still roaming around... and they are starving. Journey deep into the park as you desperately try to figure out what happened, scavenge for and manage your resources effectively, and stealth your way around the parks' many residents. It's a fight for survival, and you have to hope to god that you can truly escape. FEATURES: Explore the first part of a five chapter experience. The desolate park is your oyster, explore it to your hearts content but be cautious... Endure horrific encounters with the park's mascots, once spectacles to behold but now reduced to nothing but monsters that lurk around every corner, looking for you... starving... Plenty of collectables and achievements scattered throughout to quench the thirst of lore hunters or completionists. Be sure to keep a keen eye out on anything you may find!

rows.name: Gothic Clicker
rows.short_description: Gothic Clicker is a ARPG clicker with an emphasis on combat. Hunt and mine for ore, draw your sword and pray to the gods! Develop combat skills and crafts, upgrade weapons and gain gold. Perform harsh rites of rebirth to become stronger and fight ancient evil.
rows.description_html: Gothic Clicker is an ARPG clicker with great possibilities to customise your character and his combat style. You were snatched from the clutches of death by the necromancer Zotania in order to help her gather the bones of chaos and rid the world of the red fog. Character An unconventional approach to character development offers 5 combat and 5 crafting branches, in each of which a flexible perk system awaits you. Whether it's cold weapons or wizardry, hunting or herbalism, or maybe all of them at once - it's up to you! Inventory and Crafting Upgrade weapons with minerals, brew potions, wear rings, armour and amulets. You can wear 10 rings at a time, and you can combine them to become Rings of Power. Rebirth and Astral Your soul is in the astral plane. You are neither alive nor dead. By reincarnating, you strengthen your soul and become stronger. Alchemists' sigils and gifts from the awakened will help turn the tide of battle, and venturing into the ocean will attract the gaze of the gods, opening access to powerful soul threads. Weapons Thanks to the power of the Philosopher's Stone and gold, weapons, magic runes, etc. can be upgraded directly during combat. Each weapon has its own set of techniques, which can also be pumped and combined at will. Soundtrack Melancholy shamanic music composed by Stanislav Belyaev emphasises the decadence and depth of Gothic Clicker's bleak world.

rows.name: SHADOW PUPPET
rows.short_description: A short horror game about wandering through vaguely familiar memories while something endlessly follows you. It moves when you do, and you need to get out before it catches up.
rows.description_html: Welcome to SHADOW PUPPET! A short horror game made by one guy in his free time. What to Expect This is a short, atmospheric horror game where you're forced to wander through your own memories, now completely devoid of life. Something follows you in the shadows, moving only when you do. Light is your only friend here. You can interact with parts of the environment physically, such as pulling open doors and picking up objects. Getting out won't be simple, as you'll have to solve a few simple puzzles along the way. When you die, things don't always stay the same This game features semi-procedural generation, so expect to come across multiple variations of areas upon restarting! There are no checkpoints, and the game can be completed in under half an hour. There are two difficulties, each with their own ending Once you complete it the first time, feel free to try again in Paranoia Mode, where you'll uncover the truth about your situation and how to break free for good.

rows.short_description: I Have More Hours Than You is an Idle game with a loose abstract story about acceptance. But you'll probably just use it to brag about how many hours you have to your friends.
rows.description_html: I Have More Hours Than You: The Game The game was designed with a simple idea in mind: Hours. You are thrown into an abyss with nothing to keep you company, other than your thoughts and the occasional abnormal event. Events Legend has it that these abnormal events may be interacted with in some way. But it's up to you to find out. Achievements Follow NULL's achievement journey through the void. You will periodically be given excerpts that tell an abstract story about acceptance. Customization During your travels, you will acquire new mouse customisation options. Collect them all!

rows.short_description: A multiplayer kitchen-simulator game where you can compete with your friends to find how who is the better chef! Create 10+ different types of pastries including: Waffles, Croissants, Pancakes and more!
rows.description_html: Solar Sweets is a free-to-play online multiplayer kitchen-simulator game where you can compete with up to 4 friends to find how who is the better chef! Create 10+ different types of pastries including: Waffles, Croissants, Pancakes and more! Sweet Sweet Gameplay Come aboard the Solar Sweets airship and take customers' orders. In the kitchen, you'll utilize chopping boards, waffle irons, and ovens in various mini-games to craft the perfect sweet treat for the customer. Complete orders quickly to gain higher scores, however be careful to not ruin the food. If you do ruin the food, feel free to throw it... at other players to slow them down! All is fair in Solar Sweets. Simple but Chaotic Time Our game is simple to play for anyone to pick up and free to play so friends can play together without the need to pay any fee. Gather your friends or join public lobbies to prove your baking prowess.

rows.name: Carpe Noctem - Yuri Visual Novel
rows.short_description: A yuri visual novel about a vampiress and a monster hunter falling in love in Victorian England.
rows.description_html: Carpe Noctem is a Gothic lesbian romance inspired by Castlevania and Sheridan Le Fanu's Carmilla. This visual novel takes place in an alternate Victorian England plagued by creatures of the night. Adelaide Hadid, an orphan trained by The Church to slay monsters, is dispatched to a rural town to eliminate a powerful vampiress. After a fateful duel with the seductive Cordelia, Adelaide finds herself growing closer to the vampiress and her charming maid, Lily. With her life suddenly beginning to change, the monster hunter must grapple with her conflicted feelings about her target and The Church... ------------------------------------------ Made with Visual Novel Maker Illustration Art by Yutzu13, indracgunawans, Rizky, and MISOTO_MNW. Character Art by Warman, finnaubot, ardianzah, and LalaGalery. Background Art by syaviray, ExArthur, Elduator, and selavi. Additional Art by ntgn and Mia Rosado Music by Solas Composer

rows.name: God's Disdain
rows.short_description: Explore a vast, rich world in the fight to end a plague in this non-linear JRPG! Will you save Hajimari, or doom it to wither away?
rows.description_html: Embark on a quest to cure a plague that is bringing the land of Hajimari to its knees. Explore the land and uncover its many secrets while meeting the last of its inhabitants. Will you help Hajimari thrive, or doom it to wither away? STORY The four nations of Hajimari have been struck with a plague that has put the entire island in peril. All plant life has slowly started to die away, causing conflict between the Grizz, Faerials, Komurans, and Haji. Many people have lost their lives not only to the plague, but wars between the nations as well. The islanders tried praying to the gods they worship, but received no answer. Many have given up, and many say the gods are dead. All seemed hopeless, but sometimes hope can come from the most unsuspecting of spirits. Tamiko and her brother Kenshin reside in the village of Komura on the southwest side of Hajimari. They've witnessed their family and friends die from the plague and other islanders which has compelled them to find the source of the plague and destroy it. They will meet friends and enemies alike on their journey, including the highly intelligent Locke, the child prodigy thief Avadel, the banished maniac Drago, and the powerful grandma Zeniba. FEATURES Optional voice acting for the main story A unique EXP system that rewards actions rather than defeating enemies Hundreds of elemental armor and weapon combinations Open narrative design with a freely traversable world Unique and interesting side quests that build the world and setting A completely original soundtrack, sound effects included! Traditionally created paintings for story scenes Original art for all of the characters, enemies, and game icons A subtle karma system that affects the main character's personality and game endings Dynamic NPCs that follow their own schedule across four days in a day-night cycle ACCESSIBILITY Colorblind filters Dyslexic font Turn-based combat Keyboard/controller mapping White flash reduction

rows.short_description: Banana Monkeys: The Ultimate Monkey Collection.Dive into the enchanting world of Banana Monkeys, where you collect whimsical, quirky monkeys every 3 hours and share the fun with friends through trading and exciting events. Join a vibrant community of collectors!
rows.description_html: Banana Monkeys: The Ultimate Monkey Collection Welcome to the enchanting world of Banana Monkeys, where your adventure in collecting over 100 whimsical, quirky, and adorable monkeys begins! Every 3 hours, a new monkey eagerly waits to join your collection, each with its own unique personalities. The thrill of discovery never stops as you strive to gather all the charming monkeys. Just keep this game open in the background while gaming, working, learning or anything else and start collecting them all! See if you can gather the rarest and most extraordinary monkeys! Banana Monkeys is more than just a game; it's a community of collectors, friends, and adventurers united by their love for these delightful primates. Whether you're a casual player or a dedicated collector, the world of Banana Monkeys offers endless fun, camaraderie, and the ultimate monkey collection experience. Get ready to embark on a journey filled with laughter, friendship, and, of course, an abundance of bananas! About the Developers We are 'Monkey King', a game development studio based in Austria, dedicated to crafting a fun and engaging long-term environment for its players!

rows.name: The Legend of Thabor - Rise of the Mages
rows.short_description: It is a 2D action adventure in pixel graphics. Combines the Metroidvania, platformer and puzzle platformer genres. Experience great fantasy worlds, challenging boss fights and exciting puzzles. Gradually learn new skills and become a master of magic.
rows.description_html: Humanity is in a bitter conflict with the Four-Armed People and so Emperor Augulis the Second decides to ask the outcast magicians for help. But not all magicians trust the regime and a civil war also arises. The Legend of Thabor - Rise of the Mages tells the adventure of the young magician Anna Zalo, who gets caught up in a whirlpool of loss, war and revenge. Experience great fantasy worlds, challenging boss fights and exciting puzzles. Gradually learn new skills and become a master of magic. The legendary Pen & Paper Thabor by Florentin Will and the Rocket Beans has been adapted into a video game. The Legend of Thabor - Rise of the Mages is a retro 2D action-adventure and tells a prequel to the popular role-playing game series and takes place several years before Thabor - Arcane Awakening. The Legend of Thabor - Rise of the Mages is a 2D action adventure in pixel graphics. Inspired by the old Mega Man, The Legend of Zelda and Metroid Prime video games, it combines the action-adventure, platformer, Metroidvania and puzzle platformer genres.

rows.name: The Final Act
rows.short_description: The Final Act is a mix of visual novel and puzzle game where you assist writer Rebecca Carter in overcoming her writer's block by crafting the perfect murder plot for her novel. Solve intricate puzzles, adjust crime scenes, and navigate immersive storytelling to uncover the perfect crime.
rows.description_html: Overview The Final Act is a mix of visual novel and puzzle game where you step into the shoes of Rebecca Carter, a writer struggling with a severe case of writer's block. Desperate to complete her latest novel, Rebecca seeks help from her mentor, Jessica. Together, they delve into crafting the perfect murder for Rebecca's protagonist, Reina, who must eliminate a blackmailer to save her husband's reputation. As players guide Rebecca through this intricate narrative, they must solve puzzles and piece together the perfect crime, blurring the lines between fiction and reality. Key Features Immersive First-Person Perspective : Experience the narrative up close as you assist Rebecca in crafting her story and solving intricate puzzles. Engaging Puzzle Mechanics : Adjust items, find clues, and draft scenarios to construct the perfect murder plot within Rebecca's novel. Dynamic Narration : The story adapts to your choices, providing a unique and personalized narrative experience. Narrative Inserts : Watercolor-style inserts that drive the story and reveal Rebecca's internal thoughts and creative process. Female Protagonist : Follow the compelling journey of Rebecca Carter as she battles writer's block and navigates the complex narrative of her novel. Detailed Description In The Final Act , you are drawn into the creative mind of Rebecca Carter, an aspiring writer facing the daunting challenge of finishing her latest novel. Struggling with writer's block, Rebecca turns to her mentor, Jessica, for guidance. Together, they work on the final act, where Rebecca's protagonist, Reina, must devise the perfect plan to murder a blackmailer threatening her husband's reputation. As you guide Rebecca through this creative process, you will meticulously craft the crime scene, find hidden clues, and interact with various items to build the perfect murder plot. The game’s unique puzzle mechanics allow you to adjust the initial positions of items such as doors, guns, knives, and more, to set up different scenarios. Each decision you make influences the drafts and leads to different endings, keeping you engaged as you strive to construct the perfect narrative. The narrative unfolds through dynamic storytelling and watercolor-style inserts, revealing Rebecca’s internal thoughts and creative struggles. The cute anime visual style contrasts sharply with the dark themes, creating a unique and unsettling atmosphere. As you delve deeper into Rebecca's novel, you’ll find yourself blurring the lines between her fiction and reality. Prepare yourself for an emotional and psychological journey in The Final Act , where every clue, every item, and every choice matters. Will you help Rebecca overcome her writer's block and craft the perfect ending to her story?

rows.name: Pumpkin's Revenge
rows.short_description: Pumpkin's Revenge Embark on an epic adventure with the Pumpkin-Head Hero. Navigate through mysterious dungeons, collect powerful loots, and battle fearsome monsters. Can you survive and become a legend?
rows.description_html: Embark on an Epic Adventure with the Pumpkin-Head Hero . Step into the shoes of the Pumpkin-Head, a seasoned adventurer with a glowing gaze that pierces through the darkest dungeons. Armed with a trusty pumpkin mace, smash through skeletal warriors, outmaneuver goblins, and face off against a fire-breathing dragon. As you conquer each dungeon, collect valuable loot and become a legendary beacon of hope in a world overrun by monstrous creatures. Gameplay Choose Your Path Wisely . Navigate through treacherous dungeons by selecting hex grids to move forward. Every step matters as you clear paths, collect items, and prepare for battles. Encounter monsters and bosses that will test your skills and strategy. Each enemy you face has a unique attack value, challenging you to balance offense and defense. Dynamic Combat and Strategy Hexgrid Movement: Plan your moves on a hexagonal grid to outsmart enemies and uncover hidden treasures. Diverse Enemies: Face various foes that can poison, blind, or overpower you. Beware of powerful bosses that guard the deepest parts of the dungeons. Unique Items: Combine rare items, each offering distinctive powers to enhance your gameplay. Progression and Upgrades Unlock new cards, heroes, and spells to customize your playthroughs. rows.name: FireStarter 2
rows.short_description: FireStarter 2 is a simplified forest fire simulation game that offers a first approach to fire science for all.
rows.description_html: Did you know that 9 out 10 wildfires are caused by human activities? FireStarter 2 gives you the opportunity to start--virtually--one of them. The idea of FireStarter 2 is to make players aware of the impact of forest fires on their environment. While you can just watch the forest grow naturally through the years, you can also get involved in destructive or helpful ways. Start a fire and see how it spreads and destroys your forest, only to watch it slowly reborn from the ashes. Create clouds to decide where the rain should fall, but watch for thunderstorms when it's getting hot around. Control rain to fight fire, or just to turn your dry plants green again. Play with wind to control fire spread direction and clouds movement.

rows.name: Duel Legends
rows.short_description: Duel Legends - a revolutionary auto-battler card game where strategy meets dynamic combat. Step into a world where every card you play transforms your hero into an unstoppable force.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Duel Legends, a revolutionary auto-battler card game where strategic depth meets dynamic combat. Step into a world where every card played transforms your hero into an unstoppable force on the battlefield. In Duel Legends, every decision matters. Players will engage in strategic deck-building, choosing cards that not only strengthen their hero but also create powerful synergies. The game features dynamic auto-battle sequences where heroes autonomously fight using the configured powers, leading to thrilling and unpredictable battles. The objective is to outmaneuver your opponents by strategically combining cards and exploiting synergies to their fullest potential. Begin your journey by choosing a hero. Amplify your hero's power through strategic card acquisition, which boosts their inherent abilities fitting into various synergies such as: Healing Attack Evasion Poison Shields Rage Frost Arcane Crit Vulnerability Stamina Summoning These synergies are critical in defining your tactical approach and gameplay strategy. Experience the core of Duel Legends in our auto-battle sequences where heroes fight using their configured powers autonomously. Each battle unfolds in thrilling ways, keeping you on the edge of your seat as you watch your strategies come to life. Card Acquisition and Deck Building: Collect cards, build and refine your deck to strengthen your hero and create powerful synergies. Combat with Neutral Mobs: Encounter and fight neutral creatures like wolves and spiders, each offering unique challenges and rewards. Items and Artifacts: Choose items that enhance your hero’s abilities, tailoring your approach to combat and synergy. Economic Strategy: Manage resources wisely, deciding when to invest in new cards or save for future rounds. Challenge other players in intense PvP battles, test your strategies, and climb the ranks. Engage in a community of fellow strategists, share tactics, and compete for supremacy. Maximize your heroes' potential by mastering the art of synergy. The right combination of cards can trigger devastating effects, transforming straightforward encounters into showcases of tactical prowess. Dive into a competitive world where each decision shapes your journey to the top. With regular updates introducing new cards and challenges, Duel Legends is an ever-evolving battlefield that keeps the game fresh and engaging. Ready to claim your legend? Duel Legends awaits.

rows.name: Dogs
rows.short_description: Dogs is a relaxing and fun game where you click on adorable dogs to increase your score. Featuring a variety of cute dog breeds, simple gameplay, and charming visuals, it's perfect for dog lovers and players of all ages.
rows.description_html: I'm a solo developer who was bored and wanted to see if I could copy that viral clicker game, Banana, but improve upon it. After a few days of work the game was almost finished, and then after a break of several months, I finally got back to it and figured out how to do Steam drops, and thus Dogs was born! It's nothing serious and as you can tell from the achievements I'm having some fun with it. :) Dogs is the perfect game for anyone who loves our furry friends and enjoys casual, relaxing gameplay. Immerse yourself in a delightful world filled with adorable canines, where your main objective is simple: click on dogs to increase your score.  Features: Cute and Cuddly Canines: Enjoy a wide variety of dog breeds, each more adorable than the last. From fluffy Yorkies to majestic Great Danes and even Shiba Inus, there's a pup for every dog lover. Simple Gameplay: All you need to do is click! Tap on the dogs as they appear on the screen to increase your score. It's easy to learn and perfect for players of all ages. Relaxing Experience: With soothing background music and charming visuals, Dogs offers a stress-free environment where you can unwind and enjoy the simple pleasure of clicking on cute dogs. High Score Challenge: Aim for the highest score and compete with friends and other players. Can you become the ultimate dog-clicking champion? Cloud saves: Play Dogs anywhere on any computer and resume your progress with Steam Cloud Saves!

Visit the Frontier Capitol, the jewel of the Nova Stellaris Zone, where the stakes are as high, and navigate through the treacherous Trapsite-1, a perilous abandoned space station filled with industrial traps and hazards that test even the most skilled leaders. With an array of unique characters, and even more unique perks, every match promises to be a thrilling test of strategy and reflexes. Adapt to the dynamic environments, outsmart your opponents, and prove your dominance in the ultimate interstellar showdown. Whether you're a seasoned fighter or a casual player, Galactic-a-Tactic offers an exhilarating experience that combines tactical depth with fast-paced action. Are you ready to take on the galaxy and emerge victorious?

rows.name: Invention 5
rows.short_description: 3D first-person shooter with Scrollshooter elements. Complete levels, kill zombies and fight bosses to defeat the main villain - Casey.
rows.description_html: The game begins several years after the events of the last part. The mercenary Dorian Stealth was betrayed by a young hacker girl, Casey, and turned into a cyborg. His mind was immersed in sleep, and his body obediently followed orders. However, something made Dorian wake up and start fighting for his life. 3D first-person shooter with Scrollshooter elements. Complete levels, kill zombies and fight bosses to defeat the main villain - Casey. Dorian has access to several types of weapons: cyber blade, shotgun, grenade launcher, Kalashnikov assault rifle. Also use the Spacebar to quickly dash and dodge enemy attacks. First-person levels alternate with airplane levels, where you have to shoot enemies in the air. -3D First Person Shooter -Kill the zombies and bosses -Fun Heavy metal music

Are you taking the challenge, Manager?
rows.description_html: JOIN DISCORD About the Game BECOME A LEGEND iBasket Manager 3 is the ultimate multiplayer sports simulation game for basketball lovers. Not only do you manage a team, you become the real owner of a club that you can customize and grow like never before. Buy, trade, and upgrade your in-game assets, build your space in the iBasket Manager 3 universe, and lead your franchise to glory. BUILD AN EMPIRE Here, you don't just manage, you also create. Design and develop your exclusive plot within the game world, building everything from sports facilities to decorative elements that enhance the value of your club. Every decision counts, and your space evolves with you. CHALLENGE MANAGERS FROM AROUND THE WORLD Be part of a global competition with dynamic seasons, where promotion or relegation depends on your performance in each game. THINK LIKE A PROFESSIONAL COACH Define every tactical detail: from defensive intensity to offensive strategy, player rotation, and game pace management. Do you prefer an explosive, vertical style or a methodical, possession-based approach? Every decision impacts the game. Show off your coaching vision. LIVE EACH GAME IN REAL TIME Enjoy an advanced simulation engine that lets you follow the games as if you were on the bench. Feel the excitement of every three-pointer, every block, and every assist. Grow your fan base and turn your arena into a real fortress. iBASKET PASS Earn special rewards as you progress through each season. The iBasket Pass includes up to 25 levels per season that you can unlock by playing. Access exclusive rewards with the iBasket Pass Premium (by redeeming Ucoins) and make every minute of play bring you closer to new improvements for your club.

rows.name: Mob Trader
rows.short_description: Poke the dungeon and stick around to see what comes out! Every 60 minutes you will receive a tradeable mob in the form of a Steam Item. Grow an impressive collection of unique mobs to show off and trade with other players on the Steam Market!
rows.description_html: Poke the dungeon and stick around to see what comes out! Every 60 minutes you will receive a tradeable mob in the form of a Steam Item. Grow an impressive collection of unique mobs to show off and trade with other players on the Steam Market! Drop Rate Every 60 minutes the game will drop a mob at the following drop rates: Common Mobs = 95% Rare Mobs = 4.99% Mythical Mobs = 0.01% Rotating Drops Every Monday*, 12 Common Mobs, 6 Rare Mobs, and 3 Mythical Mobs will be randomly selected as the active drops for the week. Releases of new Common Mobs and Rare Mobs will be placed into the item shop, and will only leave the shop until they're randomly selected as an active drop. Once the shop falls below 5 mobs, inactive Rare Mobs will be randomly selected to be placed in the shop, where they will remain until they become active drops again. * For the first month of release, all mobs will be active drops to initialize and populate the market. This period may be reduced or extended depending on the amount of active traders. Feature in Development The ability to view your Steam Inventory in-game and exchange mobs for additional rolls: Exchange 3 common mobs for a rare roll ( 95% Common / 5% Rare) Exchange 3 rare mobs for a mythic roll ( 99% Rare / 1% Mythical) More information available on our Discord. Subject to change

rows.name: Persona5: The Phantom X
rows.short_description: “We’re the Phantom Thieves, and we’re here to steal your heart!” The beloved RPG series with over 27 million copies sold finally arrives on PC and mobile!
rows.description_html: “We’re the Phantom Thieves, and we’re here to steal your heart!” The beloved RPG series with over 27 million copies sold finally arrives on PC and mobile! Set in modern-day Tokyo! Normal high-school student by day, villain-fighting Phantom Thief after school! Explore the dungeons of the heart and defeat the distorted enemy Shadows! Dive into dungeons of the heart called Palaces with your fellow Phantom Thieves, who have awakened their Persona, the power of the heart. Steal the Treasure to restore the warped heart! Stylish, snappy, and satisfying turn-based combat! Experience the signature flair of the Persona series with striking visuals and addictive moves that can wipe out all your foes in one swoop! Level up your Persona, the power of your heart, and become the most powerful Persona-user! Obtain new Personas, infiltrate dungeons of the heart, and prevent a future of ruin! Enjoy your youth as a student! Savor student life in an urban metropolis as a high-school student! How you spend your days after school is up to you—deepen your friendships, devote your time to clubs, or even work part-time! Interact with a variety of fascinating characters! P5X features tons of original characters, all created under the supervision of Shigenori Soejima and the rest of the Persona team! Note: The interface and subtitles of this product downloaded outside of Japan are available only in English.

Master the art of speed, efficiency, and customer satisfaction as you turn a small roadside stand into the ultimate fast-food empire! 🍟 Main Features: Time for Online Shopping! Order everything you need to keep your restaurant running smoothly! Fresh ingredients, essential supplies, and kitchen upgrades—all delivered right to your doorstep. Fast Delivery, Fresh Ingredients! Restock & Organize!  Manage your storage efficiently by arranging ingredients properly. Keep your kitchen fully stocked to avoid running out of key items during rush hours! Place It Anywhere! Maintain a spotless kitchen and dining area to ensure top hygiene ratings. A clean restaurant means better reviews and more satisfied customers! rows.name: Proud Dad Simulator
rows.short_description: Have you ever wondered what it feels like to have a proud and supportive dad? Proud Dad Simulator gives you the loving father you wish you had growing up! Simply click dad to receive an affirmation, or delve deeper to explore all 10 minigames and collect all achievements.
rows.description_html: Have you ever wondered what it's like to have a loving Father? Well, wonder no more! Proud Dad Simulator gives you the loving father you wish you had growing up! Simply click Dad to receive an affirmation and then delve deeper into this clicker-style game to unlock microgames and collect all achievements. Can you discover all of dads wacky affirmations? It's finally your chance to feel loved! Whether you're working on that college entry essay, fighting that boss, or enjoying your hobby - Proud Dad Simulator is always there to provide you the positive affirmation you so desperately crave thanks to its world-famous 'Porta-Dad' window. Your new Proud Dad is just a click away. Dadware! - 10 Dadtastic Microgames To unlock new affirmations you must successfully help Dad clear through Dad-Themed microgames ! Show off your golfing skills, ninja-chop milk crates with perfect timing, try your hand at perfect parallel parking, and much more in this retro inspired microgame collection. 13 unique achievements Dad-tastic features: 10 Unique 'Fatherly Affirmations' (FA) to discover! Speedrun your way to parental approval with Speedrunner Mode! Beat the game in one go to submit your record time to the Proud Dad Simulator Speedrun leaderboard. Your very own father, now rendered in charming pixel art! Dad, Father, Papa Can YOU become dads favorite son?

rows.name: The Whittled Horse
rows.short_description: A boy named Thomas and his friend Evey are trusted to deliver a package. Little do they know there is a force stalking them, and what they carry will decide the future.
rows.description_html: In this exciting adventure... a boy named Thomas and his friend Evey are trusted to deliver a package. Little do they know there is a force stalking them, and what they carry will decide the future. Each town poses a... different challenge. You will need to talk to the locals, gather items, and do favours to make your way through. Biking sections will... test your skills. You need to dodge obstacles set up by an evil foe to make it to the next town. The Bike Shop Owner will teach you new abilities and give you new gadgets for your bike. Features: A wonderful mix of 2D and 3D graphics. Dramatic, hand drawn cutscenes. Multiple endings. Meaningful story, with a variety of characters. Created by a group of friends, bursting at the seams with personality. Uncover the mystery of the whittled horse...

rows.name: Hail Britannia
rows.short_description: Hail Britannia is a text-based game with lite RPG elements set in an alternate 1944 where the Central Powers won World War 1.
rows.description_html: Overview: Hail Britannia is a richly detailed text-based game set in an alternate history timeline where the Central Powers emerged victorious in the Great War, leading to significant geopolitical shifts worldwide. Players assume the role of a Canadian soldier who has to navigate through intricate storylines, engage in strategic combat, and interact with a diverse array of characters. The game features dynamic conversations and news events that shape the unfolding narrative, reflecting the political, social, and economic turmoil of this alternate 20th-century world. Gameplay Mechanics: Dynamic Dialogue Trees: Players can engage in branching conversations with NPCs, gaining information, and influencing relationships. Turn-Based Battles: Combat is strategic and turn-based, requiring players to make tactical decisions to defeat enemies. Class Choice: There are 3 combat classes: Foot Soldier, Combat Medic, and Tank Driver. World Events: The game's world unfolds through news events that reflect the changing political and social climates. Backstory: The timeline of Hail Britannia diverges from our own in 1917 when the Kaiser chose not to resume unrestricted submarine warfare or send the Zimmerman telegram. Without American intervention, the French military struggled to hold back the Germans and eventually collapsed under a German offensive, leading to their capitulation. With France surrendering, the Central Powers offered peace to the Entente, bringing an end to the Great War on November 11, 1919. Following a brutal war with no tangible gains, both France and the United Kingdom succumbed to communist rebellions. The French Commune and the Union of Britain were established, while the exiled governments fled to North Africa and Canada, respectively. As Britain fell, territories such as Gibraltar, Cyprus, and Malta were seized by other nations. New Zealand joined Australia, the British Raj split into the loyalist Raj and the independent Indian State, and South Africa voted to leave the Empire. The Caribbean colonies of Britain and France were annexed by Canada. In the unstable and violent decades since the Great War, the Soviet Union was proclaimed by Lenin in 1921 after defeating the White Army. However, former Russian territories like the Baltic Union, Lithuania, Belarus, Ukraine, and Poland fell under German occupation. China fractured into several regions, including the Republic of China, Soviet Mongolia, the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo, and Tibet. Italy's post-war economic collapse fueled political extremism, leading to Benito Mussolini's rise and the establishment of a fascist dictatorship. In the Americas, Calvin Coolidge's presidency saw the 1925 crash of the New York Stock Exchange and the onset of the Great Depression, which primarily affected the Americas as the global economy now centered around the Berlin Stock Exchange. With war debts unpaid, the US economy declined for 19 years. Economic uncertainty led to the rise of communist and fascist regimes in Central and South America, leaving Canada, Costa Rica, and the US as the last bastions of democracy in the region. However, even the US remains fragile, with the Steel Belt witnessing a significant shift towards communism and fascist southerners aiming to recreate the Confederacy.

rows.name: Once Upon a Galaxy
rows.short_description: ONCE UPON A GALAXY is an easy to learn Card Battler with incredible strategic depth and near infinite fun! Which of your favorite characters from myth and fairy tale will you choose?
rows.description_html: Once Upon a Galaxy is a fast-paced, free-to-play card battler of cosmic proportions. Captain a crew of characters from myth and fairytale lore into battle across a spectacular galaxy in search of allies, spells, and treasures to ensure your ultimate victory! Begin each game by selecting a Captain with its own unique effect. Will you choose Dorothy to help complete her friends’ quests? Or Dragonmother to discover what hatches from her Mysterious Egg? Play as Indiana Clones to 'clone' your best three treasures, or lead a troupe of toys as Geppetto! More captains are released each month, so there’s always something new to try! Galaxy features an eclectic cast to help you on your journey. Recruit characters and cast spells each round to prepare for your next challenge. Carefully position your cards while planning your turn—then enjoy their auto-battle against other captains and crews! Upgrade your crew throughout the game. Character-copies give bonuses and discover powerful treasures. Enhance your board directly to keep buffs as you replace characters. The most powerful cards appear later in the game—find a Legendary crew to help make you the last captain standing! You can capably lead any odd character, but your most powerful crews will come from smartly-selected synergies. Combine treasure effects with characters’ abilities for powerful outcomes. Leverage powerful character factions, each with their own focus, such as treasure-loving Dragons, spell-enhanced Mages, or Toys which summon additional characters during the fight! In addition to the common pool of cards you encounter each game, each captain commands its own list of collectible elite characters to customize your plans. Select 12 cards before the game—they’ll be mixed into your card pool to potentially draw! No timers, no pressure. Galaxy's matchmaking and async-multiplayer mean you can battle fun-but-challenging opponents whenever you want. Face real boards from other human players’ earlier games. Your finished run will join the opponent pool for others to challenge. It's fast, strategic, and endlessly fun! When you're ready to crank up the intensity, you can play with friends in 6-player live lobbies... warning: live lobbies are the ultimate competitive experience! While our Steam build is great for the desktop experience, Galaxy is also available on your phone or tablet! With a cross-platform account, you can sync your progress no matter which device you use and so can explore Galaxy on-the-go! Once Upon a Galaxy is created by Million Dreams Games, an indie studio boasting a talented team. Our leads have worked on iconic games like Magic: The Gathering , Hearthstone , and Runeterra . We’re diehard fans of the card and auto-battler genres. We believe in building a fully-functional free-to-play experience. We partner with wonderful artists to bring our vision to life (no AI artwork is used in Galaxy ). If you love our game too (we think you will!) and want to support us, you can boost your collection rewards or style your favorite cards with alternate-art skins. A monthly Galaxy Pass offers both! Give Galaxy a try and experience the thrill of this groundbreaking card battler.

rows.name: Coconut
rows.short_description: Idle clicker with periodic free skin rolls that can be used in-game and traded.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Coconut , every two hours get a free case and spin the mystical Coconut Wheel to receive a random coconut. Will you get a common coconut or will you be the lucky one to snag a super rare coconut, potentially worth a ton on the community market? The excitement of the spin will keep you coming back for more! But that's not all - each week some coconuts will be retired and will no longer be obtainable from the wheel. This means the coconuts you collect now will become even rarer over time, increasing their value and prestige. Don't miss your chance to build the most impressive coconut collection! Coconut is lightweight, taking up less than 0.1 GB of space on your computer, and using under 0.2% of your CPU . Plus, it can run in the background at all times, leaving your desktop free for any other activities! This is a community game, for the community! We welcome any and all suggestions through our Discord. Join the conversation and help shape the future of Coconut. By joining our Discord, you can gain access to exclusive Discord special coconuts and potential boosts to the game in the future for those who are part of our Discord community. Check out our Roadmap for future developments that the community can vote on! If you find and report a bug through Discord, you could receive a free Bug Finder skin, exclusively for those who help us improve the game. Additionally, anyone who submits a skin to be included in the game and has it accepted will receive 10% of the earnings from that coconut. Are you ready to collect them all and spin the rarest skins? Download Coconut and start collecting limited time skins!

rows.name: The Pyrite Talisman
rows.short_description: Two Souls, One Path. Not even time can keep them apart.Annelise is the Chosen One of an ancient Prophecy. Cross time and space with her to find and activate the epic Pyrite Talisman in a narrative adventure through two parallel realities.Prequel to Telluria: Forebodings.
rows.description_html: Annelise lives in the year 2100. In a burning flame, one morning like many others, she glimpses a female figure absolutely identical to her. From that moment her life will change. She'll have to know why she can see the other her but she can't speak to her. She'll have to search for informations on ancient tomes. She'll have to solve puzzles and pass trials. She'll have to learn how to harness ancient powers. And in the meantime she will learn about the existence of a prophecy, of an angry Supreme God, of the arrival of Four Plagues dooming the world. She will understand to be part of something totally unexpected and too big for her to manage. And that somewhere in time, she is not alone. Join Annelise in her quest to get and empower the epic Pyrite Talisman. Break the barrier of time separating Annelise from the other Her and share the knowledge to progress. The Pyrite Talisman is a 3D narrative adventure involving exploration in third person direct movement, puzzle solving and inventory use through a point & click interface and it's the prequel to Telluria: Forebodings. During gameplay you will play with both characters switching through time to collect informations to progress further into the story. Subtitles and interface in english and italian. Follow the Telluria project on our socials.

rows.name: Inn Tycoon: Prologue
rows.short_description: Welcome to Inn Tycoon: Prologue! Build, design, and manage your dream inn. Serve delightful meals, offer various services, and hire a stellar staff. Create a top-notch hospitality empire and become the ultimate Inn Tycoon!
rows.description_html: This game is a free version of Inn Tycoon. Embark on a soothing journey to the medieval ages with Inn Tycoon: Prologue – a chill and relaxing game where you shape the serenity of a bygone era. Delicious meals and ice-cold beverages await your service to customers. Increase reputation with various room options and customized furniture. Your dream inn awaits you to experience this magnificent atmosphere. RECRUIT STAFF FOR BEST SERVICE Recruit a team of skilled staff to ensure your inn runs like clockwork. From chefs and maids to entertainers, each employee plays a crucial role in creating a seamless and enjoyable stay for your guests. Your customers might be impatient, be careful not to upset them. Remember, Quality Service = Good Tips. UNEXPECTED SEASONAL CHANGES Sometimes a cold snowy day, sometimes scorching heat. The frequently changing weather will be felt inside the inn as well. You’ll need to adapt to unexpected situations and handle the varying demands of your customers. USE REPUTATION TO CREATE FESTIVALS You’ll be able to organize events and festivals with the fame you’ve gained. Experience chill and relaxing inn management while hearing the music and laughter echoing through the walls.

rows.name: Dark Hours: Prologue
rows.short_description: Dark Hours: Prologue is a free co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with a monster. Forget your plan, your mission: survive! Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and wish for daylight.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Dark Hours: Prologue is a free version of Dark Hours. Experience the core gameplay and get a taste of the experience that awaits in the full game. Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Just when you think you've pulled off the perfect heist, your break-in is suddenly interrupted by an unexpected supernatural event. You find yourself trapped in the auction house you came to rob and you realize with horror that you are no longer alone... A demonic creature has taken over the place and you have become its new prey. Will you manage to escape? Will you survive this apocalyptic night? PROLOGUE FEATURES: The Auction House: Explore the area in search of a way out, solve co-op minigames, deactivate lasers and security cameras, fill your bag with valuable loot, and take advantage of the building's secrets to get out of there. New monsters: Encounter up to 2 creatures, each with distinct behaviors and unique abilities. Unique items and co-op action to make your heist a success. KEY FEATURES Cooperate: Dark Hours is a 1-4 player cooperative experience where you must work together to escape the evil entity that is hunting you. You can't survive alone, stay close to your teammates and collaborate to find your way out of this nightmare. Manage your equipment: A lock-picking set, a hacking device, a flashlight or a crowbar? Pick your gear and find all sorts of items during your exploration. Use them wisely with your teammates and you may have a chance to get out alive. Or not… Escape or survive: There are only two ways out: find the exit or hide from the creature until morning. Will you make it through this dreadful night? GAMEPLAY FEATURES Steal: Remember, your first objective is to rob this place, so make sure to steal every valuable item you find. Score big! Best Thieves: Carrying all that illegally-acquired loot can be tiring for your friends, so don't hesitate to discreetly offer your help by emptying their bags to steal the most precious items. There is no honor among thieves! Be stealthy: Don’t make too much noise or the monster will find you. Be careful: the more you loot, the louder you get. In case of extreme urgency, you can (sneakily) fill your teammates' bags so they are noisier than you. Survive: Seek refuge wherever you can or push your teammate to the entity's clutches. Survival justifies any action. Between us, it's better him than you, right? Live a terrifying and fun co-op horror experience where you will discover more about the origin of the dark hours! …and who your friends really are! Warning This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

Pick your gear and find all sorts of items during your exploration. Use them wisely with your teammates and you may have a chance to get out alive. Or not… Escape or survive: There are only two ways out: find the exit or hide from the creature until morning. Will you make it through this dreadful night? GAMEPLAY FEATURES Steal: Remember, your first objective is to rob this place, so make sure to steal every valuable item you find. Score big! Best Thieves: Carrying all that illegally-acquired loot can be tiring for your friends, so don't hesitate to discreetly offer your help by emptying their bags to steal the most precious items. There is no honor among thieves! Be stealthy: Don’t make too much noise or the monster will find you. Be careful: the more you loot, the louder you get. In case of extreme urgency, you can (sneakily) fill your teammates' bags so they are noisier than you. Survive: Seek refuge wherever you can or push your teammate to the entity's clutches. Survival justifies any action. Between us, it's better him than you, right? Live a terrifying and fun co-op horror experience where you will discover more about the origin of the dark hours! …and who your friends really are! Warning This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

rows.name: Color Tower Defence
rows.short_description: All kinds of enemies entered the battlefield! Build your defenses against hordes of enemies!
rows.description_html: Highly challenging and difficult tower defense game, use your smart mind to complete it! Game play: 1. Enemies will walk into your house from the entrance along the road, build defensive towers to stop them! 2. Enemies with red, green and blue colors have resistance to the corresponding color, which greatly reduces the damage caused by the defense tower of the color when attacking them. 3. Enemies with yellow, purple and cyan colors each has two colors of resistance, very strong! 4. A powerful boss comes every 25 rounds, beat it with all your might! 4.8 different towers to choose from, find the most suitable defensive tower to defend the enemy! 5. After beating 100 rounds of the final boss, the game wins and enters endless mode, how many waves can you hold on to? Defense tower introduction: 1. Machine gun tower, blue, single damage 2. Lightning Tower, blue, attack 5 enemies at a time 3. Cannon, red, range damage 4. Rocket Tower, red, high single damage plus small area damage 5. Poison tower, green, extensive damage 6. Tower of Death, green, high single damage 7. Gold coin Tower, grey, producing gold coins 8. Flash Tower, gray, unlimited penetration range damage, dealing 100% damage to enemies of all colors! Introduction of the enemy: 1. Red: Resist Red Tower for 75% of damage 2. Blue: Resist Blue Tower for 75% of damage 3. Green: Resist Green Tower for 75% of damage 4. Yellow: Resist Red and Green towers for 75% of their damage 5. Purple: Resist Red and Blue towers for 75% of their damage 6. Cyan: Resist Green and Blue Towers for 75% of their damage

rows.name: Balloon Warfare
rows.short_description: Balloon Warfare is a first-person arena shooter with a twist: you become stronger by hunting down specific colored balloons to upgrade your weapon. Together with your team, you must take out the Boss Balloon that spawns on the map.
rows.description_html: Upgrade your weapon, get stronger, and beat the boss with your team to get an advantage on the enemy team! Start with a basic tier 1 weapon and upgrade it all the way to the max tier by either hunting balloons or killing players to get the required balloons for your weapon. Additionally every single weapon is upgradable and each upgrade changes the weapon slightly. There are also many characters to choose from each has their own unique ability. During the game, Boss Balloons will be spawned. That's when you and the enemy team will compete for the boss. The winning team will gain a Killer Balloon to fight alongside them. Features: Shooting Many characters with unique abilities Weapon upgrades PvPvE Arena Shooter Boss Fights & More!
