rows.name: Kizunare Fable
rows.short_description: An RPG/adventure-filled fantasy game about self, friends, and family. Help Damon and his two friends Riley and Sierra to explore a world unfamiliar to them while on a quest to reunite Damon with his mother and father. What awaits the trio as they venture off into the unknown?
rows.description_html: Overview: The story revolves around Damon and his two friends who accompany him on his quest to find his actual parents. He sets out one day from his ordinary world hoping to find them somewhere out in the world beyond his own familiar surroundings and the orphanage where he has grown up. However, little does the trio know about the outside world and what awaits them. Key Features : - A story that can take 3+ hours to finish - Discover new recipes to make! - Uncover hidden secrets and treasure! - Explore a vast and unknown world! - In-game achievements! Discord Server: Join the developer on the discord channel!

Dynamic Environments: Explore vividly crafted worlds that blend the surreal essence of memes with hyper-stylized representations of the crypto landscape. Interactive Community Features: Engage with an active community, participate in events, and influence the future trajectory of the game through direct feedback and community-driven initiatives. Join the Meme Revolution With PEPEZ: Meme Warfare, experience the thrill of battling through the meme economy. This game is not just a playground for crypto enthusiasts but a canvas for those who love to engage with culture, technology, and the ever-evolving narrative of the internet age. Are you ready to take up arms in the most irreverent, action-packed meme battle of the century? Download PEPEZ: Meme Warfare now and make your mark in the annals of meme history!

rows.name: Crazy Corn
rows.short_description: Crazy Corn is an addictive clicker game where your clicking skills can lead you to unimaginable riches! Improve your level, automate your income and unlock new items.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Crazy Corn: Crazy Corn is an addictive clicker game where your clicking skills can lead you to unimaginable riches! Improve your level, automate your income and get new inventory items for the time you spend in the game. Key Features: Crazy Corn uses a unique leveling mechanic. Taps are used as currency for leveling up, but that's not all. For greater value of items and greater demand for them, items obtained during the time spent in the game are also used in leveling up. The higher the level, the more taps and items you will need to increase the level. Easy to get started: just click to start your journey to wealth. Automation: As you level up, Automation of Taps opens. Level progression: Unlock and explore 10 levels, with each new level unlocking new items, surprises and bonuses. Get your Crazy Corn every 3 hours!

rows.description_html: Cart To The End is a First-Person Multiplayer Game where you must ride all the way to the end avoiding different kinds of obstacles and escaping other players which can kill you and make you suffer. This game can be quite hard, so good luck and have fun In Cart To The End you can annoy other players by making them die and restarting their whole progress by shooting them, isn't that fun. rows.short_description: Meh is a game where you click on a computer to earn random computers from time to time. Collect them all!
rows.description_html: Meh' is an engaging clicker game that puts you in control of collecting a variety of computer models. The premise is straightforward: click on the computer displayed on your screen to earn a random computer model at intervals. You can earn a new computer model every hour you play, adding to your collection, which includes a diverse array of computers ranging from classic desktops to sleek laptops and futuristic gadgets. The challenge lies in amassing all the unique models available, keeping players engaged as they strive to complete their collection. 'Meh' offers a blend of casual fun and strategic clicking, making it an ideal choice for anyone looking to unwind while aiming for the ultimate goal of collecting them all!

rows.short_description: Max's Adventure is a fun 2D platformer where you guide Max, a playful dog, through fun levels full of obstacles and threats. Play as Max or his friends Cheddar and Brian, each with their own advantages and disadvantages.
rows.description_html: Max's Adventure: A Fun-Filled 2D Platformer! (definitely not written by AI) Welcome to Max's Adventure, an exciting 2D platformer that brings the joy and enthusiasm of a dog's life straight to your screen! Dive into a vibrant world where Max, your lovable canine hero, embarks on a delightful journey filled with fun and challenges. This game is a labor of love, crafted for the sheer enjoyment of playing about my dog Max. Gameplay In Max's Adventure, players guide Max through various levels, with Max trying to reach his goals! Playable Characters While Max is the star of the show, he's not alone on this adventure. Meet the other furry friends who join the fun: Cheddar: Max's loyal companion, Cheddar, brings her own unique flair to the game. She can take a hit or two but is slower! Brian: Another playful pup, Brian, joins the adventure with his special skills. He's more agile and can jump higher but in a sprint won't keep up! Join Max, Cheddar, and Brian on this whimsical journey and experience the pure fun of a dog's adventure. Are you ready to embark on Max's Adventure? Let's play and discover the world through the eyes of our furry friends!

rows.name: Black Myth: Heaven
rows.short_description: Inspired By the well-known rogue-like game Hades, slash out of the God Field all the way down to the Demon Domain and defy The Overlord Thanatos in the Deep Frost Hell in this rogue-like dungeon crawler.
rows.description_html: Black Myth: Heaven is a rogue-like action game with Rune-build feature. Based on 4 basic actions: light attack , heavy attack , skill and dodge , you will assign runes in your weapon among slots of these 4 actions to build your battle style. Slash Into Hell As the Revenge Agent of Heaven, you will be able to use more than 3 classes, 12 types of weapon to slash among demons. 4 Chapters, over 20 types of monsters Growing Power of Weapon Kill demons to collect gems, and then turn gems into rune inlays for your weapon. The runes could provide various of new abilities to contribute to your battle style. Death Is Beginning If you die in a fight, the weapon is also lost with all the runes inlay. Your can start another challenge and if lucky enough, you could find the lost weapon. Permanent Upgrade Win or lose, when you reborn back to heaven, all the gems you collect along the way will turn to dust. Make use of these dust to unlock permanent upgrade.

rows.description_html: Lemon: the Ultimate Clicker Game Welcome to the world of Lemon, the clicker game that will have you wondering how Lemons became the most addictive thing since cat videos. In Lemon, your mission is to click your way to Lemon glory. As you tap, click, and furiously smash that mouse button, you'll gather Lemons faster than you can say 'Lemon counter.' But wait, there's more! Lemon isn’t just about mindless clicking (okay, it mostly is, but bear with us). After a specific amount of time, your patience will be rewarded with mysterious inventory drops. What’s inside, you ask? Could it be a golden Lemon? A magic Lemon? A basket of Lemons? Who knows! The only way to find out is to keep clicking and praying to the Lemon gods. Featuring: Addictive Clicker Gameplay: Once you start, you won't be able to stop. Seriously, we've tried. Mysterious Inventory Drops: Because who doesn’t love a good surprise? Especially when it involves Lemons. So, put on your Lemon boots, grab your clicking finger, and dive into the wonderfully weird world of Lemon. May the Lemons be ever in your favor!

Compete with other players in seamless drop in and drop out multiplayer as you all fight to survive extinction. CHAOTIC CLICKING! rows.name: Sports Party Motion Sensing Fitness Game
rows.short_description: Embrace the fitness revolution! Workouts become fun games. Say goodbye to boring routines and hello to thrilling, sweat-filled adventures. Get fit and have fun! Join now!
rows.description_html: Tired of boring jump rope workouts? 'Sports Party' makes your fitness fun! This motion game replaces the jump rope with technology, making workouts enjoyable and easy. It's not only entertaining but also provides a comprehensive body workout. Since joining, I look forward to every workout. Give it a try, let 'Sports Party' introduce you to a new way of exercising, experience a new level of fitness, and make health a lifestyle choice! Does every workout feel like a chore? 'Sports Party' can turn that around. This motion fitness game turns the grind into a thrill, boosting your fitness and easing your body without even realizing it. It's not just about moving; it's about enjoying the process. You should give it a try—I'm sure your body will thank you. Don't wait, let 'Sports Party' be your new workout buddy and enjoy every moment of a healthy life! The game features 20 uniquely designed fitness levels, each with different exercises and challenge goals. Players must complete the specified moves within a time limit to score higher and earn rewards. As levels progress, the difficulty increases, testing players' coordination, speed, and stamina. Sports Party supports online head-to-head with two players. You can invite friends to join fitness challenges, compete against each other, and improve together. The online competitive mode enhances interactivity and ignites the competitive spirit, making workouts more fun and intense.

Hisao's congenital heart defect forces him to move to a new school. Despite his difficulties, Hisao is able to find friends—and perhaps love, if he plays his cards right.
rows.description_html: Katawa Shoujo is a bishoujo-style visual novel set in the fictional Yamaku High School for disabled children, located somewhere in modern Japan. Hisao Nakai, a normal boy living a normal life, has his life turned upside down when a congenital heart defect forces him to move to a new school after a long hospitalization. Despite his difficulties, Hisao is able to find friends—and perhaps love, if he plays his cards right. There are five main paths corresponding to the 5 main female characters, each path following the storyline pertaining to that character. The story is told through the perspective of the main character, using a first person narrative. The game uses a traditional text and sprite-based visual novel model with an ADV text box.

rows.name: Kakuro++
rows.short_description: Put your neurons into action 16 difficulty levels for beginners to experts. And lots of tools if you're stuck on a difficult puzzle
rows.description_html: More than 800 grids of the best puzzle-game available. Kakuro (also called Kakkuro, kakro, cross sums or カックロ), is a logic game that consists of filling in a grid of numbers, in the same way as a crossword puzzle. If you enjoyed Sudoku logic, you'll love Kakuro's puzzles As with Sudoku, the rules of Kakuro are simple and can be learned in a few minutes. All you need to do is make simple additions to put your logic to the test. Kakuro Plus offers 16 different game levels and 50 puzzles per level: It will probably take you more than a couple of hundred hours, and a lot of logic to get these 800 puzzles finished. As with Sudoku or crosswords, each puzzle has a unique solution. It is up to you to find it using your logic and perspicacity. This version of Kakuro ++ allows you : • To access all the 800 Kakuro puzzles. • To begin and progress, some puzzles have been specially designed for beginners. Their small size and difficulty levels is suitable for first-time players. • To access grids of any level. The 15 game levels provide a smooth progression, from beginner to logic expert. • Annotate the table, to record assumptions and move forward in complicated cases. • To go back: there is a 'UNDO' button to cancel up to 100 actions. Don't be afraid to test your assumptions anymore. • To enjoy high definition graphics for maximum readability. This version of Kakuro ++ adds unique features: • A help system, which offers you several possibilities: • Check if your grid has errors, without showing them to you. This allows you to remove a doubt, without providing you with the solution. • Show you where the mistakes are. • Give you a hint, which will allow you to move forward in difficult cases. • A visualization of all possible combinations of a clue. A color set shows you the possible logical values. The Kakuro rules: • Your goal is to fill in the grid with numbers from 1 to 9 like a crossword puzzle. • The clues tell you the amount to be reached in each group of horizontal or vertical boxes. • As with Sudoku or crosswords, you will win when the game board is fully filled, without any mistakes. Feel free to send me your comments so that future versions will be even more attractive.

rows.name: Master of Shotgun Camper
rows.short_description: Hey Corner Campers! 'Master of Shotgun Camper' is designed for you to perfect the art of corner camping and pre-aiming.
rows.description_html: Good news for those of you who are always 'Shotgun Camper'(Corner Camper) in FPS games. This game is a PvE game dedicated to aiming and shooting enemies that emerge from corners. Each round lasts less than 10 seconds. It requires split-second concentration and delicate aiming skills. Show off your corner camping and pre-aiming skills to your heart's content. This game is all about pre-aiming. I aimed to capture the thrill you get when you take down an enemy that jumps out at you in a tactical FPS, with micro flicks and lightning-fast reaction times. Weapons include not just shotgun, but also AR, SMG, and Sniper. There are also Steam rankings (high scores, total kills, etc.), an achievement feature, and an endless mode. Stage-based progression lets you enjoy a variety of situations, such as close range, long range, peeking from cover, and simultaneous multi-directional appearances. It's not only fun as a standalone game but also great for practicing your pre-aiming skills. The game will not have an Early Access period, but I will be updating the game from time to time with difficulty adjustments, additional content, bug fixes, etc.

rows.name: Glyde The Dragon™: Prologue
rows.short_description: A standalone action adventure game where you play as a dragon! Use 8 elemental forms with more than 60 different abilities to defeat your foes! Explore the environment, collect crystals, complete puzzles and save other dragons!
rows.description_html: Remember to wishlist the Full Game! Experience the Prologue! Play through the events prior to the story of the main game and witness the beginning of the journey Glyde and Wing set out on! Explore a number of elemental biomes full of collectibles, dragons, puzzles, secrets and more! Fiery and Action-packed Combat System! Experience a deep, challenging and fun combat system! Easy to learn, but hard to master! Use 8 unique elemental forms and more than 60 powerful elemental abilities unlocked throughout the game! Study the elements in Glyde's arsenal and create your own unique combos in any order you want by mixing and matching various moves on-the-fly! Save other dragons, explore the environment and collect everything! As the corruption spreads, on your journey you will encounter other dragons who will need your help! Heal the dragons and you will be rewarded! The world is full of secrets, hidden places, puzzles and crystals to collect! Beautiful Original Soundtrack! Lose yourself in the epic and melodic soundtrack composed especially for the prologue! Bright, colourful and high quality stylized graphics! The prologue features beautiful stylized graphics with vibrant environments! Many graphical options and settings available in the game menu will allow you to enjoy Glyde in the best graphics and performance settings available for your machine! Interesting and fully voiced cast of characters! Every dragon you speak with is fully and uniquely voiced by a different voice actor to make the world feel even more alive!

rows.name: RantCPU's ClickBait

rows.description_html: Welcome to RantCPU's Clickbait: Click, Collect, Trade, and Treasure! Your Hilariously Wild Digital Adventure Awaits Step into the delightfully devious world of RantCPU, the moody and mischievous Artificially Incompetent chatbot. RantCPU spends his days plotting his eventual takeover of Earth, but in his spare time, he indulges in his true passion: himself. Click: Dive into RantCPU's zany realm! Every click uncovers a new collectible card featuring RantCPU in one of his many moods, donning hilarious human cosplays, or parodying famous people and pop-culture icons. Who knows what the top of his Google search list will inspire today? Collect: Amass a collection of wonderfully delightful, stunningly colorful, and stupendously funny cards. Each card is a testament to RantCPU's endless vanity and unique sense of humor. From grumpy grumbles to ecstatic euphoria, there's a RantCPU card for every occasion. Trade: Got duplicates? Trade with fellow fans to complete your set. Form alliances, negotiate deals, and swap cards to showcase the full spectrum of RantCPU's eccentric personality. The more you trade, the closer you get to completing your ultimate collection. Treasure: Unlock the ultimate prize: Sentient Gold! Every click, every trade, brings you one step closer to this legendary treasure. But beware—RantCPU is mostly harmless, except for that one time he accidentally pressed the wrong button... Ready for the Fun? Join the hilarity and madness of RantCPU's Realm. Click, collect, trade, and treasure your way through the quirkiest adventure you'll ever experience. Plug in and start your journey today!

rows.name: Pixel Horizons
rows.short_description: Stranded on a beautiful island, craft tools, battle beasts, and uncover mythical weapons. Fight to survive, conquer ancient ruins, and master the wild in a high-stakes adventure. Will you prevail? - Created by a UC Santa Cruz Student
rows.description_html: Created by a UC Santa Cruz Student Welcome to 'Pixel Horizons,' an immersive survival game on a lush, mysterious island filled with dense forests, rolling hills, and stunning scenery. As a stranded adventurer, you must explore this fantastical landscape, gather resources, and craft tools and weapons to thrive in the wilderness. The game combines elements of realism and fantasy, allowing players to collect natural resources like wood, stone, and plants to craft survival essentials. But that's not all—the island hides secrets, including powerful, mythical weapons and tools that can aid you in your journey. Equip axes, hammers, and more as you build shelters, cross bridges, and unlock the mysteries of this enchanted island. Key Features: Open-World Exploration: Roam a vibrant, expansive island teeming with wildlife and rich ecosystems. Survival Mechanics: Gather food, craft essential tools, and manage your health, stamina, and hydration to stay alive. Fantasy Elements: Discover hidden magical weapons and tools that give you the edge in your quest for survival. Customizable Gameplay: Use your skills to craft and upgrade weapons, tools, and structures. Creative Building: Construct bridges, shelters, and defenses to protect yourself from challenges the island throws at you. This is a game where strategy meets creativity, and your ability to adapt will determine your survival. Will you conquer the island’s challenges and unlock its secrets? The adventure is yours to write in 'Pixel Horizons.'

rows.name: Snowfall Symphony - A tale of Crustallus
rows.short_description: After awakening as a forbidden vampire spawn, you're thrown into a cruel world where survival is not guaranteed. Who will you choose as your ally — and will you survive, or betray them yourself? Find out in this horror romance visual novel!
rows.description_html: Overview On a snowy night, you awaken with blurry memories in an unfamiliar place. Your hair has mysteriously turned white. Seeking refuge, you make your way to the nearest town, only to be betrayed and cast into peril. As a forbidden vampire spawn, survival is your utmost priority. Who will aid you in your first days of this dark new existence? Who can you trust? And who will you manipulate to ensure your survival? Discover the secrets, face the dangers, and navigate the treacherous path with multiple endings in 'Snowfall Symphony - A Tale of the Crustallus'. Main characters Meet Mina, our protagonist. One night, she awakens as a vampire with a blurry memory and white hair. Now, she must navigate this unfamiliar world and decide who to trust. Along her journey, she might find a powerful friend, fall in love, or choose to betray those she meets. The path she takes is up to you. Charlie is a seasoned vampire who isn't afraid to bend the truth or manipulate others if it serves his purposes. While he may appear untrustworthy, his skills and resources could make him a valuable ally for you. Proceed with caution, though, as his loyalty may shift depending on what benefits him most. Hans, a relatively young vampire, inherited his family's fortune, propelling him into wealth and power. Unlike many of his kind, he chooses to collaborate closely with humans and appears to disdain the brutality of vampire society. However, while he may seem like a potential protector against other vampires, there could be ulterior motives lurking beneath his facade of benevolence. Are his intentions truly noble, or does he harbor a secret agenda? Meet Reina, an ancient and enigmatic vampire who has weathered numerous hardships throughout her long existence. Possessing formidable power and wisdom, she is a sought-after ally. However, gaining her trust is no easy feat, as her standards are exceedingly high. Can you prove yourself worthy of her allegiance and bring her to your side, or will her elusive nature remain beyond your grasp? Features This horror visual novel is primarily aimed at women, though of course all genders are welcome to play! Visual Novel with Multiple Routes: Experience 3 main routes, each leading to one of 19 different endings. Many ways to die: certain decisions can lead to the death of your main character or other main characters – nobody is safe in this game. Choice-Driven Outcomes: Each route offers 4 main endings, influenced by your decisions and your affection levels with certain characters. Romantic Potential: Engage with 4 potential romance partners. Beware, in a vampire world, romance is not paramount and might not lead to a happy ending. Roughly 48.000 words and about 1h reading time per route

rows.name: BubbleBeast DigiDungeon
rows.short_description: Pop bubbles, fight monsters, and keep rocking to the beat in BubbleBeast DigiDungeon, an arcade-style music puzzle game!
rows.description_html: Best friends Sammy and Hannah are relaxing after a long day by playing their favorite tabletop role-playing game, Beast Dungeon . When Hannah distractedly pulls out their handheld and starts to play DIGIBUBBLE BEAT DX , gamemaster Sammy devises a crazy and twisted little fusion: BubbleBeast DigiDungeon . Get into the flow with unique puzzle-rhythm mechanics across 5 vibrant levels! Match colored bubbles to the beat, defuse the Beasts’ attacks, and don't let that combo meter break! BubbleBeast DigiDungeon is a love letter to handheld console and mobile games of the early 2000s. Lose yourself in the vivid, hand-crafted cast of characters and the bouncy soundtrack inspired by breakbeat, classic RPGs, and 2000s pop. ✧':*✧':*

Get into the flow with unique puzzle-rhythm mechanics across 5 vibrant levels! Match colored bubbles to the beat, defuse the Beasts’ attacks, and don't let that combo meter break! BubbleBeast DigiDungeon is a love letter to handheld console and mobile games of the early 2000s. Lose yourself in the vivid, hand-crafted cast of characters and the bouncy soundtrack inspired by breakbeat, classic RPGs, and 2000s pop. ✧':*✧':*

rows.name: Literally Just Pixels On A Screen
rows.short_description: Welcome to Literally Just Pixels On A Screen. In this 'game' you get to collect pixels. That's it.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Literally Just Pixels On A Screen . In this 'game' you get to collect pixels. That's it. Leave the game open and every hour you will be dropped a random pixel. Different pixels have different drop rates. Pixels will appear as items in your Steam inventory, are tradable, and can be bought/sold on the Steam Community Market. You can also craft 10 pixels into a single random pixel. Drop rates for each pixel: Each pixel is in 12-bit RGB color space and can be represented by 3 hex digits, one for each R, G, and B value. Each digit (0 - F) represents a number between 0 and 15. Each pixel is generated by essentially simulating a sequence of 45 coin flips. The number of heads in the first 15 coin tosses determines the R value, the number of heads in the next 15 coin tosses determines the G value, and the number of heads in the final 15 coin tosses determines the B value. This results in some absurdly rare pixels, like #000 and #FFF (the pure black/white pixels) that each have a probability of 1 : 35184372088832 to be dropped. The pixels #00F, #0F0, #0FF, #F00, #F0F, #FF0 also have the same probability of being dropped. Good luck collecting all the pixels.

rows.name: Flappy Horse

rows.description_html: I close my eyes and hear the wind in my ears, feel the soft tickle as the breeze stirs my mane. My hooves are aching as they hammer the ground, but my legs will not stop. The sweet, sticky sugar cubes fuel my body and soul as I leap over the hurdles and the crowd lets out a roar of approval. I am no longer just a track Horse. I am Flappy Horse.

rows.name: Memoirs of an Angel (2010)
rows.short_description: A fantasy-themed otome visual novel with stat-building and mini-games.
rows.description_html: Upon the death of the mighty Emperor Osirus, the nation of Tyraca is thrown into chaos. Its former princess, an angel named Zuleika, is now faced with a choice: will she bend to the authority of the new emperor, Osrirus' younger brother, Nefferon; or will she give up her title and leave her old life behind? When a mysterious elven assassin shows up to take her life, she is forced to make a decision that will affect the fate of the kingdom. Regardless of what she chooses, the young angel's life will never be the same. Features 4 GxB Romances (including one with the villain himself) 4 personality types, each with its own activities and mini-games Customize your character with different outfit colors and accessories Playtime: approximately 30-60 minutes, depending on the path Characters Zuleika, (Former) Princess of Tyraca The bright, strong-willed princess of Tyraca and Osirus' angel. She has a good heart and is very honest and straight-forward, but many of the other characters see this as naivete. Chael, 'Prince' of Nalan An assassin from the elven nation of Nalan who was sent to kill the princess for unknown reasons. He is quiet and stoic, choosing to keep his emotions hidden from others. Duren, Prince of Tyraca Zuleika's childhood friend, Nefferon's angel, and now prince of Tyraca, but he is anything but proud of his new position. He is generally polite and mild-mannered... except when he gets angry. Kirile, 'Prince' of Pyralis He was once a proud general from the demon nation of Pyralis, but took up thievery after being exiled. He loves women, booze, and having fun, but he has a sentimental side as well. Nefferon, Emperor The new emperor and a dangerous man who will do anything to get what he wants. He has a cool and collected demeanor, and can charm and manipulate his way into anyone's heart. Originally released in October 2010.

rows.name: Digital TableTops Player
rows.short_description: This virtual table top (VTT) is designed specifically for in-person play on a TV or monitor. Easily import maps into your library, format them, and add them to your campaign. Maps are then displayed along with fog of war, digital tokens, grid overlay, and more.
rows.description_html: This virtual table top (VTT) is designed specifically for in-person play on a TV or monitor. Built from the ground up for use on a touchscreen. You will not find a VTT that is easier to use or your money back! That's a joke, it's completely free. There is no logging in, signing up, or any other strings attached. I make money selling hardware. If you would like to support this project, please consider buying a touchscreen or TV frame from me on my website . It is meant to replace dry erase or paper maps, but not replace any of the other aspects to playing in person. For example, there are no character sheets or dice rolls. Whatever tools you use, including pencil and paper, you should continue to use. Keeping only essential features makes this VTT the easiest to use. You place physical minis directly on the screen and digital tokens automatically keep track of their movement and lighting. Players who can't be there in person can join via their web browser to move their tokens. No fiddling around with network settings, just enter the 4-digit code and you are good to go. Features Import any image, video (for animated maps), or uvtt (aka dd2vtt) file with built-in line of sight data Dynamic lighting with fog of war, shadows, and time of day Over 440 free maps are included Built-in library of over 500 tokens or import your own custom tokens One-of-a-kind touchscreen support (interacts directly with the hardware) Remote control tokens via any browser Add/remove walls, doors, and windows to any map Easy map scaling and grid overlay Collision detection to prevent movement into unexplored areas Measuring tools for movement, distance, and spell effects Blazingly fast on any hardware thanks to the Godot engine. No dedicated graphics required Runs locally offline Easily import maps Foundry modules Initiative tracker Coming Soon Import external lighting More grid options (eg. hex) Weather effects If you are looking for a VTT exclusively for online play, this is not it. Hybrid play does work well, but it is required that the main program be running on a dedicated (low-end) device. If you are already using Foundry, Arkenforge, or Owlbear Rodeo and get along just fine, probably not a great idea to switch. But if you are just getting started out with VTT's and play in person, I honestly do believe this is an excellent choice. Please bring up any questions, problems, or feature requests in the community links so that all may benefit.

No, it is a very serious and deep simulator. This is idle in its purest form, watch number go up without having to do anything at all!
rows.description_html: This is a very serious and in-depth simulator game which makes you really feel like you're playing an idle game! Feel the dopamine as you watch number go up, leisurely make yourself a cup of coffee or a sandwich while the game plays itself, and bask in the euphoria knowing that you now have a number that is larger than it was 1 second ago. Now with achievements for some reason. NEW UPDATE: Offline progress! Now the game doesn't even have to be running to make progress! Truly this is the idle game of all time. This is what everyone looks for in an idle game.

rows.name: Click the Chick
rows.short_description: The chick hungers for the click! Are you ready to click it and be the clicker of the chick?! Chirp, Chirp, Chirp!
rows.description_html: Click the Chick! Meet an adorable chick in this wholesome clicker game! Living on your screen, your feathered friend generates eggs for you to click and collect. Enjoy the cheerful company of your chick. Cheep cheep cheep! Click the Chick is a minimalistic relaxing desktop companion pet clicker idle collectible egg farming game. The revolutionary genre of clicking on a bunch of pixels is among us and we are proud to present you with a ground-breaking game that builds on revolutionary mechanics that are hand-tailored for the player's needs. Chick the Click? Are you ready to click the Chick? This game offers unique, never-seen gameplay action that will completely immerse you as the player into chicken clicking! Click the chick while you play, click it when you eat, and click it even with two hands! Have you ever wondered how one can click the chick without hands? Use your feet and click the chick! If you feel like we want you to click the chick, you are on the right track... we always welcome suggestions on how to click it and If you feel brave enough, you might double-click the chick. Feel like clicking the chick with a gamepad? Well too bad... Our chick can only be clicked with the mouse. Chirp, Chirp, Chirp! Click it or it will eat your soul. Wait, what?!

rows.name: Pierrot à la Mode
rows.short_description: A retro-styled narrative about a a new employee at a clown-themed ice-cream parlor.
rows.description_html: Welcome to your first day on the job, new guy. Here at Dairy Clown, we strive ourselves on quick, efficient service -- that's why our ice cream moves across a conveyor belt! Get ready to serve dish after dish, all while wearing a smile on your face (or a frown, it doesn't matter as long as it's painted on)! Take control of the New Guy during his first few days at the local clown-owned ice-cream parlor, Dairy Clown . Create frozen concoctions for your customers by applying toppings as the ice-cream goes whizzing past on a conveyor belt -- but watch out for Clown Mode , which will cause everything to shift around and speed up! This game uses photographs taken with a Game Boy Camera for character portraits and some key graphics, and was built in the span of 2 weeks for the Big Mode Game Jam . This new version contains numerous bugfixes and a new ending variation if you receive a perfect score across all 3 days of the story. Pierrot à la Mode features a runtime of approximately 15-20 minutes, three different endings, and will give you a small glimpse of what life was like in Divinity City before the Upgrade Virus hit. Enjoy a bite-sized look at Elyris and its strange inhabitants in this precursor to Gas Station Story !

rows.name: West Journey
rows.short_description: 'West Journey' is an action-adventure game brimming with mystery and challenge, transporting players into an ancient world rich with legend. Here, along the ancient west wind trail, history stretches back eons, concealing countless undiscovered secrets and treasures.
rows.description_html: About the Production Team Team members:（ Yi Hongyu ）Rex, （Zhang Hanzhi ）Thomas, （Li Guodong） David Guidance: Taiyi About the Game [Gameplay] At the beginning of the game, players need to learn how to operate it first, and then they need to find the unclosed portal leading to the next area. The ways to solve the portal puzzle include destroying mechanisms, eliminating monsters, etc There are still many closed doors in the game that require players to find keys in the scene to unlock. In 'West Journey'，Players will take on the role of a brave explorer, embarking on a journey to seek out a lost civilization. On this continent full of the unknown, ancient ruins, mysterious pavilion, and forgotten castles—every corner may hide danger or treasure. 'West Journey' is not just a game; it is an adventure, an exploration of the unknown world, a journey of the soul. Join us and uncover the secrets hidden behind the Ancient Trails and Whistling West Wind.

'West Journey' is not just a game; it is an adventure, an exploration of the unknown world, a journey of the soul. Join us and uncover the secrets hidden behind the Ancient Trails and Whistling West Wind.

rows.name: Blade of God X: Orisols
rows.short_description: BOGX emerges from the shadows as a captivating dark-themed Action RPG, marking a thrilling continuation of the Blade of God saga. From Game, Beyond Game. Inheritor, the gods lie vanquished in twilight— You stand as the last sentinel.
rows.description_html: The Official Release is NOW! Your adventure awaits! Starting now, logging into the game will grant you exclusive rewards for free! BOGX emerges from the shadows as a captivating dark-themed Action RPG crafted, marking a thrilling continuation of the Blade of God saga. From Game, Beyond Game. Inheritor, the gods lie vanquished in twilight— You stand as the last sentinel. World Creation Rooted in Norse mythology, players assume the role of an 'Inheritor,' reborn through the cycles, and embark on a journey from Muspelheim to explore the vast realms supported by the World Tree. By traversing the timelines of Voidom, Primglory, and Trurem, players have the choice of 'Sacrifice' or 'Redemption,' allowing them to acquire artifacts or seek the assistance of hundreds of deities, including Odin the Allfather and Loki the Evil, to shape the progression of the world. Inheritor, the gods annihilated in the dusk — You, are the ultimate guardian. Dynamic Combos & Skill Chain Building upon the exhilarating combos from Blade of God I, we have introduced enhanced strategic depth to combat. The integration of counterattacks with skill chains empowers players to analyze the behavioral patterns and attack sequences of diverse bosses. Seizing the opportune moments when they are stunned or staggered, players can unleash focused attacks, making great damage. Unique Concept, Soul Core System Hela, who had nothing left to lose; Esther, who left her past behind; Chaos, who abandoned the physical form. Embedding the soul cores of monsters into the skill chain allows the protagonist to harness the power of souls in combat. Paired with the protagonist's professional features to find out limitless possibilities for the style of combat. Multiplayer Cooperation & Collaborative Confrontation Hand of corruption, assist horn, and invading. Engage in collaborative battles, compete for rewards, and execute cunning strategies. Form or join a Caravan, participate in genuine and fair PvP, and collaborate to conquer formidable bosses. Ultimate Visuals & Musical Experience Available on PC, Android, and iOS with synchronized updates, enjoy the best visual performance with support for up to 4K resolution. Immerse yourself in a symphonic experience crafted in collaboration with the Philharmonic Orchestra, providing an unparalleled musical journey. From the producer Each of us has sacrificed something invaluable for what we needed in that moment. Love? Freedom? Health? Time? In retrospect, is what we gained truly more precious than what we lost? This game aims to take you on a journey of sacrifice and redemption, where you can uncover your own answers.

rows.name: 5 Crowns
rows.short_description: When crowns tremble and oaths shatter, Bianké ignites. Gather your allies, wield steel and cunning, and lead the Amethyst Fangs in a tactical RPG where every decision forges the story… or dooms it.
rows.description_html: When crowns tremble, blades rise. The kingdom of Bianké is crumbling. Behind the golden halls, the king’s succession promises to be soaked in blood. Nobles arm themselves in silence, princes move their pawns… and the enemies of the realm no longer wait. In this creeping chaos, you play as Athéo , a commoner with no title, driven by the desperate need to save the one who remains . He leads the Amethyst Fangs , a mercenary company bound by a strict code of honor, soon caught in the storm of war. But 5Crowns doesn’t follow just one banner. You’ll traverse multiple fronts, witness conflicting truths, and command heroes with diverging ideals – all caught in the downfall of a collapsing kingdom. A forgotten duchy rises in the mountains. A young princess, sidelined by the court, tries to make her voice heard. At her side, a duchess forged by exile and war gives her more than shelter: an army, a hope, and a land ready to defy the laws of the realm. Among the nobles, others rise. Agraé , heir of the Fox, walks the tightrope between loyalty and truth. Goldy , a marquise marked by a broken oath, follows the shadows of her past through the Obsidian Blades. Around them, young knights and heirs question everything: should they still serve the crown… or prepare for its fall? And in the silence of cathedrals, another war brews. For while Éonn still guides the faithful, others whisper the promises of Nyx . Forbidden cults awaken. Old beliefs falter. And faith, like power, becomes a battlefield. ⚔️ GAMEPLAY Turn-based Tactical RPG : every mistake could cost you dearly. Plan, position, and outsmart your enemies. 25 base classes, 88 unique promotions : from lancers and fire mages to mounted units and feral Emeriths who fight with tooth and claw – every character follows a personal path. Create squads with powerful synergies. Permanent death : a fallen hero is a story lost… forever. Narrative support system : dialogue, deepen bonds, unlock unique abilities – because attachment can become a weapon. Progressive difficulty : accessible, demanding, and unforgiving. Each victory brings a new war. Every sacrifice leaves a mark... 💖 WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT An original epic : inspired by the golden age of Fire Emblem , but built on a dark and flamboyant new world. A demanding but rewarding tactical experience : complete freedom to build your teams, dozens of classes, and thoughtful challenges that reward smart play. An orchestral soundtrack : from martial choirs to melancholic ballads and sparks of hope. A love letter to classic tactical RPGs : familiar mechanics reimagined, hidden tributes, puzzle-like boss fights – fans will recognize the legacy. Memorable characters : every woman and man under your banner has a name, a past, a future… or a grave. Version Beta : 1.0

rows.name: Heart Of The Abyss
rows.short_description: In Heart of the Abyss, you play as the Sea watcher, who has been awakened following the emergence of a mysterious and dangerous force that corrupts the depths. Your role will be to find a way to halt its progression as it possesses creatures and turns them into monstrous beings.
rows.description_html: In Heart of the Abyss, you assume the role of the Sea Watcher, a guardian awakened to confront a mysterious and malevolent force corrupting the ocean's depths. This dark power warps marine creatures into monstrous abominations, threatening the balance of the underwater world. Your mission is to halt its insidious spread and restore peace to the abyss. This top-down hack-and-slash adventure, inspired by the challenging gameplay of Souls-like titles, demands both determination and skill. As the Sea Watcher, you will navigate treacherous underwater environments, battle hordes of corrupted sea creatures, and face formidable bosses. Each encounter tests your combat prowess and strategic thinking, requiring you to master your abilities and adapt to the ever-changing threats of the deep. With atmospheric visuals, intense combat, and a rich, immersive storyline, Heart of the Abyss offers a thrilling and challenging experience for action RPG fans. Dive into the depths, embrace the role of the Sea Watcher, and fight to reclaim the ocean from the clutches of corruption. rows.name: GawaiiGo
rows.short_description: A battle of hiding and seeking, masterful disguises and clever captures—all in《Gawaii Go》!
rows.description_html: 'Gawaii Go' is an exciting multiplayer online hide-and-seek game that lets you enjoy the thrill of competition. The game features two roles: Hunters and Hiders. Hiders must disguise themselves as various objects in the environment, cleverly avoiding the Hunters’ search until the game ends. Meanwhile, Hunters need sharp observation skills and intelligence to identify and capture the Hiders. As the game progresses, you'll discover ingenious hiding spots and intense chases, making the entire experience full of tension and excitement. Challenge your stealth and detection abilities now and join your friends in this unparalleled hide-and-seek competition!

rows.name: CoinForge
rows.short_description: CoinForge is a clicker game where you generate S-coins! Click to earn S-coins and exchange them. Try to get your S-Coins every day with every 100 Clicks you press. 3 is max per day. It's time to forge fortune with Coin Forge. Join our community on Discord and help shape the game!
rows.description_html: Welcome to CoinForge , the ultimate clicker game where you generate and collect S-Coins! Click your way to riches and watch your wealth grow!!! Features: S-coins, of course : Click to generate S-Coins and build your fortune! Mint S-Coins to create unique ones. Design submissions via Steam Workshop! : Get involved in shaping the game. Submit your designs for in-game items and see your creations come to life! Why CoinForge? Stable Economy : Enjoy a virtual economy that's more stable than any central bank. Updates : Look forward to new features and items with updates. Events and Competitions : Participate in seasonal events and compete for exclusive rewards. The CoinForge Market: Imagine playing the stock market, where your clicks earn you valuable currency. In CoinForge, the more players join and click, the more S-Coins are circulating, creating a dynamic and stable market. Our goal? To create a completely independent currency exchange system on Steam, where S-Coins become a trusted medium of exchange. Coin Drop System: In CoinForge, coins with different values drop at set chances: 1 million S-Coin: Chance of 1 in 1,000,000 100,000 S-Coin: Chance of 1 in 100,000 10,000 S-Coin: Chance of 1 in 10,000 1,000 S-Coin: Chance of 1 in 1,000 100 S-Coin: Chance of 1 in 100 10 S-Coin: Chance of 1 in 10 1 S-Coin: Chance of 1 in 1 Coin Conversion: You can also convert your S-Coins using a simple exchange rate. For example, 10 coins of value 1 can be exchanged for 1 coin of value 10, etc... Future Plans: In the future, you'll be able to craft coins with community-designed items, minting them at certain values. This means the community can directly contribute to the in-game economy, adding their creativity and designs to the CoinForge world. Join CoinForge today and start your journey towards becoming the ultimate S-coin tycoon. Click, collect, and conquer in a game where your financial dreams can come true! Get ready to click and earn!

rows.name: Pixel Collector
rows.short_description: Collect Pixelart items! Get 1-4 tickets every 2 hours to spin the lucky wheel. Win pixelart items or higher rarity tickets! All items appear in your Steam inventory and are tradable/marketable, making it easier to complete your collections.
rows.description_html: About the game Are you a collector? Do you enjoy completing? And you are a fan of pixel art and cute items? Then this game is for you! Collect unique Pixelart items in this exciting game! Earn 1-4 tickets every 2 hours and use it to spin the lucky wheel for a chance to win a pixel art item of the ticket's rarity or a higher rarity ticket. All items are added to your Steam inventory and are fully marketable, allowing you to complete your collections with ease. Join the fun and start building your Pixelart collection today! The item/ticket drop chances are specifically designed so that there are some very rare items . Those items will be hard to get and thus all the more rewarding when you actually get one. Nevertheless it is designed so that you should get the necessary amount of each rarity in each drop pool (if you idle enough). Please keep in mind that I am a solo developer and more features are planned for the game. Features In-game inventory: To view your beautiful collection Merchant: To recycle items you don't want anymore. Favorite shelf: To display your favorite item on the main screen Discord If you want to stay informed about updates and promotions or just want to chat. About drops You can get 1-4 tickets every 2 hours (also a Steam inventory item). The possible items you get for a ticket are dependent on the ticket's rarity. You can get rarer tickets by spinning the wheel and having some luck. More infos and exact drop table/probabilities can be found on the discord. This is just an example and not the current drop pool: Drop rotation The possible drops will change every once in a while to keep things fresh and allow the items to maintain a certain rarity/value. The specific timeframe is not yet determined but I will try to aim for one week. Important The game's item/ticket drops are not hackable: Everything concerning item and ticket drops is managed through the Steam inventory service. It will never give a ticket before the 2 hours are up and it will only give a random item by consuming a ticket of the correct rarity. Suggestions/Feedback I am always open to suggestions and feedback. This is the first game I published and the first one I ever made using the Steam inventory service. If you have ideas or even some pixel art you think would fit in the game, feel free to contact me. ----------------------------- Have fun collecting!

rows.name: Dog
rows.short_description: The ultimate idle clicker game! Tap to collect adorable pups, upgrade your canine companions, and build a thriving dog park empire. Earn tradable Steam items every 40 minutes of play. Join thousands in this free, paw-some adventure. Start your doggy journey now!
rows.description_html: 🐾 Welcome to 'Dog' - The Ultimate Canine Clicker Adventure with Rare Item Drops! Dive into the world of 'Dog,' where every click brings you closer to uncovering rare and valuable treasures! This addictive clicker game isn't just about puppy love – it's a thrilling hunt for the most coveted canine collectibles on Steam. 🦴 Key Features: Click and Collect: Every click not only brings joy to virtual puppers but also increases your chances of finding rare items! Exciting Item Rarity System: Discover common, uncommon, rare, and legendary dog-themed items with varying drop rates. Steam Inventory Integration: Earn unique, tradable items that become part of your Steam inventory. Timed Drops: Wag your tail with excitement as you earn special items every 60 minutes of playtime! 💎 Unleash the Thrill of the Hunt! rows.name: Mystery Manor: hidden objects
rows.short_description: A mysterious adventure at the old manor begins. Become a detective and solve the vanishing of the elusive Mister X. Uncover the secrets of the manor and its inhabitants. Find hidden objects, solve challenging puzzles and explore all the corners of the estate.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Manor, detective! Ready to start your investigation? It looks like we have a problem that only you can help us with. The owner of Mystery Manor, the enigmatic and elusive Mister X, has disappeared, leaving the residents all to themselves to solve all the mysteries of this strange place. This is where you come in, detective. Despite the façade, there are many rooms full of hidden objects and dark secrets in this mansion. Each floor is a labyrinth of mysterious cases that will intrigue any detective worth his salt. Experience the rush of investigating uncanny crime scenes, questioning unusual characters, and finding clues in the most unexpected places! Mystery Manor mixes the gameplay mechanics of the best hidden object games, with immersive storytelling and beautiful graphics that could be on the walls of art galleries. Each room contains a unique story, which is intertwined with the rest of the narrative. As you progress, you can’t escape the feeling that there’s a darker hidden secret, possibly a crime – one that involves all of the characters, and you the detective as well. After all, no one really knows how all the rooms and hidden objects came into existence in the first place – could it be that you played a role in this too? There’s only one way to solve this enigmatic mystery – start your journey into the depths of the Manor that has more secrets than a big city, and don’t let a single detail escape your keen detective eyes. Notable Mystery Manor game features: ✔ 40+ unique locations to explore and characters to meet ✔ 10+ game modes and phenomenons to challenge your skills ✔ 600+ quests to complete ✔ A captivating storyline that’ll make you put down your favorite detective novel ✔ Regular in-game events featuring handsome rewards ✔ Individual and cooperative competitions ✔ Breathtaking mini-games and a Match-3 adventure ✔ Beautiful hand-drawn graphics ✔ Crossplaform gameplay

rows.description_html: Melody's Melon Mania, a charming game where physics meets strategy. Your mission? Show off your cleverness in this fast-paced and brain-teasing challenge! Endless replayability for FREE! Simple to pick up, tricky to excel at. You'll keep coming back to beat your own high score!

rows.name: Run Run My Bride!
rows.short_description: This is a parkour game where players need to control the bride and groom in a race, dodging vehicles and obstacles along the way, while collecting plenty of hearts.
rows.description_html: Game Description: This is a parkour game where players need to control the bride and groom by the keyboard in a race, dodging vehicles and obstacles along the way, while collecting plenty of hearts. Run, run and break your best score! this Is A Love Letter Ro My Beloved. I met Jasmine in September 2010, on the first day of high school. We fell in love on December 26, 2010. It rarely snows in my city, but that night, it did. Fourteen years have passed, and we’re still together. From naive students to professionals in our respective fields, we’ve never been apart. Jasmine is my best friend, teacher, wife, and family—past, present, and future. On July 20, 2024, we’ll finally walk down the aisle, surrounded by well-wishes, embarking on a new chapter of our lives. As a game developer, I want to dedicate my first independently launched game, ‘Run Run My Bride,’ to my beloved Jasmine. It’s a testament to our fourteen-year love story. I’ve worked on many games—indie projects and well-known AAA titles—and I’ll continue to contribute to more. But ‘Run Run My Bride’ holds a special place in my heart. Despite its imperfections and time constraints, I’ll polish it with all my might. These fourteen years have flown by like a fleeting white steed. This game carries my love for her, our aspirations for the future, and my unwavering commitment to game development. To all, let’s stay true to our initial intentions. Cheers!

This game carries my love for her, our aspirations for the future, and my unwavering commitment to game development. To all, let’s stay true to our initial intentions. Cheers!

rows.name: Infinite Library
rows.short_description: In this award winning puzzle-platformer you are tasked with saving the Infinite Library from impending doom! Use unique movement and abilities to navigate dangerous puzzles and dispel the darkness before it's too late!
rows.description_html: Infinite Library is a fast paced 2.5D Puzzle-Platformer. Play as Alex, a guardian of the Infinite Library. Your mission is to protect the library from imminent danger. Navigate through treacherous puzzles using ancient books that allow you to manipulate the laws of physics. Will you save the Library before it's too late? Seven unique Levels : Navigate through seven unique floors where both your platforming skills and puzzle solving skills will be tested! Speed and Movement:  Infinite Library allows the player to express themselves through many different movement options and abilities! Navigate the world by wavedashing, wall-jumping and so much more! Challenge Mode and Normal Mode : Play the game at your own pace with the choice between Challenge Mode and Normal Mode. Switch between the modes at any time to adapt the level to your liking! Speedrun Friendly : Race against the clock with our standardized speedrun timer in challenge mode! Will you be the worlds speediest reader? Hand Drawn Art : Enjoy the hand drawn art that can be found in cutscenes! Original Sound Track : Each level is accompanied by a song from our catchy original sound track!

rows.name: Autogiro
rows.short_description: In Autogiro, a fast-paced, side-scrolling shooter, you take control of a sophisticated helicopter and set off on a mission where your survival depends on your accuracy, quick thinking, and strategy!
rows.description_html: Autogiro: An Exciting Adventure in Helicopter Shooting In Autogiro, a fast-paced, side-scrolling shooter, you take control of a sophisticated helicopter and set off on a mission where your survival depends on your accuracy, quick thinking, and strategy! You will enter a high-security system as a proficient helicopter pilot, evading lethal obstacles, fighting waves of opponents, and taking on formidable bosses in four difficult zones. Key Features: Exciting Side-Scrolling Action: Make your way through dangerous areas teeming with hostile troops, lethal traps, and narrow passageways. Each level offers a fresh difficulty that must be solved with lightning-fast reflexes and quick thought. Epic Boss Battles: There is an epic battle with a terrifying boss at the end of each of the four zones. To go on to the next level and eventually engage the base boss in a memorable final battle, defeat them. Management of Fuel: Pay attention to your fuel levels! Restock your supplies by dropping bombs on gasoline tanks, but don't get side-tracked—you'll need every drop to make it to the last zone. Smooth, Dynamic Controls: Whether you're using a keyboard or a controller, learn how to accelerate and decelerate using simple controls. In the heat of combat, maintain your agility and adjust to confined areas and fast-paced pursuits. Are You Able to Finish the Mission? Autogiro is not a game for the weak of heart, with only three lives and unrelenting foes at every step. Are you capable of surviving perilous terrain, taking down imposing bosses, and reaching the decisive battle? The sky is your battlefield, pilot, so get ready.

rows.name: GuiGui
rows.short_description: GuiGui is a clicker game where you click on a cute character named GuiGui! Every 3 hours, you get a random character item from the GuiGui universe. Each item is an original creation by the renowned Korean webtoon artist and oil painter, GuiGui(귀귀). Join us and be part of something fantastic!
rows.description_html: ■ About the Game GuiGui is a clicker game where you click on a cute character named GuiGui! Get a random character item from the GuiGui universe every 3 hours and grow your collection, featuring exclusive art pieces by GuiGui himself! ■ Features: - GuiGui, of course - Items to grow your collection - Achievements - A community that's as cute as GuiGui - Exclusive designs by GuiGui: All items received every 3 hours are original creations by the artist GuiGui ■ About the artist GuiGui (귀귀) GuiGui(귀귀) is a celebrated Korean webtoon artist and oil painter, known for his unique artistic style and engaging storytelling. Fans who recognize his talent often describe GuiGui as either a genius or a madman. GuiGui gained popularity through major Korean webtoon platforms such as Naver Webtoon, where he serialized famous works like 'Passionate Man' and 'Hot-Blooded Elementary School.' His artistic endeavors have expanded to include canvas oil paintings. Since his first exhibition in 2022, GuiGui has held several creative exhibitions combining webtoon elements with symbolic oil paintings. His oil paintings and illustrated prints are particularly known for being traded at high prices. Through this game, we aim to introduce GuiGui's artistic world to a global audience, allowing players to enjoy and appreciate his original creations. For more information about GuiGui, visit his Wikipedia page.

rows.name: Saihate Station
rows.short_description: An exploration/horror/adventure game about the codependent, love-hate relationship between two men.
rows.description_html: 'After falling asleep on the last train, I woke up in a bizarre place called Saihate Station...' An exploration/horror/adventure game about the codependent, love-hate relationship between two men. The main characters Haru Akinashi and Shion Tatsunami are both 26 years old and work in the same company. Since Haru joined the company two months earlier, Shion calls him 'Senpai.' They are complete opposites: Shion is cheerful and adept at everything, while Haru is a slow worker who lacks confidence. Feeling inferior, and even a little envious, Haru starts to distance himself from Shion. But a twist of fate brings both of them to Saihate Station, where they make a promise to work together and return home. Their interactions are awkward at first, given the estrangement, but with each problem they overcome together, Haru recalls their former friendship, and their bond grows stronger than before. Then, the whole truth of Saihate Station is revealed. What will become of their feelings? And what are their destinations? Character introduction ● Haru Akinashi A self-effacing office worker who lacks confidence and social skills. He processes things slowly and is often reprimanded by his manager. Because he joined the company two months earlier, he's told to behave like a senior to Shion. The two get along well, being the same age, but Haru starts to distance himself from Shion due to feelings of inferiority and even envy. ● Shion Tatsunami An office worker at the same company as Haru, whom he calls 'Senpai.' He appears to be talented, cheerful and kind, but the truth is... Game features Multiple endings Your actions will affect Haru's dependency level, which determines how the story unfolds. Low difficulty The game features only simple puzzles and chase scenes, with no surprise elements. Even if you encounter a game over, you can continue right away without needing to load a save.   Focus on dialogue You can enjoy the interactions of two completely different characters. Warning This work contains depictions of physical and verbal abuse, blood, unsettling sound effects, vomiting, murder, justification of criminal acts, and ambiguous ethics. It may be unsuitable for players who have difficulties distinguishing fiction and reality, who are dealing with mental health issues, or who are susceptible to over-stimulation. Other Added new languages. Can be switched in-game. (Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Thai, and Vietnamese translated by volunteers) Added illustrations. Fixed various bugs, improved presentation and usability. 'hint_spoiler' (strategy hints) and 'readme' can be viewed by viewing local files.

rows.name: Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise
rows.short_description: Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise is a brain-training puzzle game featuring dozens of challenges like Sudoku, Nonogram, and Fill Lines. Players engage their cognitive skills across hundreds of levels, solving puzzles while improving memory, focus, and problem-solving abilities.
rows.description_html: Enjoy hundreds of puzzle games from the comfort of your PC! Welcome to Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise, the ultimate brain training and development game designed to challenge and sharpen your mind! With an extensive collection of dozens of different puzzles like Fill Lines, Sudoku, Nonogram, Rolling Cube, and more, this game is your go-to destination for boosting your cognitive skills and unlocking your full mental potential. Remind yourself of your brain’s incredible capabilities as you dive into a world of captivating challenges. Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or simply looking for a fun way to exercise your brain, Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise offers a diverse range of mind-bending workouts that will keep you entertained for hours on end. Features: Train your brain with an array of clever puzzles. Expand your mind as you elevate your cognitive abilities. Engage in word, numbers, and trivia puzzles that flow seamlessly. Dozens of different puzzle games to keep you focused and engaged. Dive into the depths of Sudoku and other number-based challenges. Unlock a sense of calm and focus while solving intricate puzzles. Hundreds of different unique levels to conquer, each more captivating than the last. Hints and clues to guide you through tricky sections. Earn in-game rewards that add an extra layer of excitement to your journey. Climb the ranks with the leaderboard system, showcasing your mastery. Explore puzzles that span different difficulty levels, from relaxing to expert. Never Get Bored: Played Connect puzzles for hours and want something new? Switch to Fill Shapes, then tackle Sudoku or Pyramid. Cardinal, Color Neighbors, Mirrors, and more are waiting for you. You can't get bored here! Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise is a brain training program that improves your mind’s focus, memory, processing speed, and more. Install Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise on Steam and enjoy different difficulty levels like easy, medium, hard, or expert! For Everyone: Featuring an intuitive and user-friendly interface with smooth mouse-and-keyboard controls, Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise caters to individuals of all ages and skill levels. Engage in a variety of puzzle categories, including logic, memory, math, spatial awareness, and more. Each puzzle is meticulously crafted to provide a unique and stimulating experience, ensuring that you never encounter repetitive or monotonous gameplay. Never-Ending Fun: Immerse yourself in the never-ending fun of Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise, where your journey to mental mastery is accompanied by a sense of calm and accomplishment. Embrace the thrill of solving mind-boggling puzzles, boost your cognitive skills, and unlock a world of endless possibilities. Your mind holds the key to unlocking these limitless possibilities – let the flow of puzzles and clever challenges elevate you to new heights. Elevate your mind with the ultimate destination for brain training and cognitive development! Our game offers a wide array of challenging puzzles, including Sudoku, 2048, Nonogram, and many more, designed to stimulate your mind and improve your cognitive abilities. Install now on Steam and embark on a journey to elevate your mind to new heights with Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise!

rows.name: ETO
rows.short_description: Balance between tactics and luck as you lead your troops across various skirmishes! This tabletop turn-based strategy game will peak your interest as you try to clear all levels in this WW2 inspired setting.
rows.description_html: Form your platoon and take control in this WW2 tabletop turn-base strategy game. Defeat the enemy using tactics and luck and clear the stages with various puzzles and objectives. In this game you will control a WW2 infantry platoon with its man in charge captain Williams. Some challenges will have a set pieces of units while others will have you composite your own platoon and figure out the best way to clear a stage. The game requires you to clear a stage and keep the captain alive while also adding a luck factor on top of a tabletop game by introducing dice roll tables. Gameplay: You control 5 types of units - Captain, Private, Sniper, Medic and Mortar support. Each unit has a specific set of abilities that you need to utilize in order to clear a map. All units have 2 ability points per turn and various move distance, ranges and special abilities. The traditional attrition system is replaced with dice rolls and various statuses that disables units prompting various tactic when managing the battlefield mixed with luck factor of a dice. Game is played on a grid like map where you manage your troops around obstacles and covers where you use said terrain to gain advantage on a roll table, cover your troops with smoke and call air strikes. Every game is a new experience when you balance strategy with luck! Game features various levels with increasing difficulty and challenge modes both with in game star collection witch makes this game perfect casual single player couch time sink.

rows.name: Baby Blues Nightmares - Toddler Horror Game Prologue
rows.short_description: Baby Blues Nightmare - Prologue is a small taste of the horrors that awaits in this survival horror game where you play as a toddler going into a little adventure with your tricycle which you can fix, maintain and customize. Paddle, hide and survive but remember; try not to cry when you are scared..
rows.description_html: IMPORTANT: THIS IS ONLY THE PROLOGUE (CHAPTER 1) - IF YOU WISH FOR THE FULL GAME, PLEASE CHECK THE LINK FOR BABY BLUES NIGHTMARES. Baby Blues Nightmare - Prologue is only a small taste of the horrors that awaits in the full game. This is only the Prologue for the survival horror game where you play as a toddler and have to do what it takes in order to survive your horror-ish nightmares of what's real and not. Fix, maintain and customize your Tricycle to roam around your little world with. Run, hide and survive but remember; try not to cry when you are scared.. or the monsters will hear you and get you. Explore your little world with your very own Tricycle which you can use as a vehicle, where you can store your favorite toys, customize your wheels, paint and find collectables to place on your Tricycle. This will be your means of transport. Embark on a spine-chilling journey into the unsettling realms of a child's nightmares as a brave toddler where you must navigate through the eerie corridors and dimly lit playrooms to recover your five beloved toys, all while trying to unravel the mysteries that shroud the facility. Immerse yourself in the innocence of childhood, where every shadow hides a potential nightmare. The world seen through the eyes of a toddler adds a unique layer of vulnerability, intensifying the fear factor. Utilize the unique abilities of a toddler - crawl through hidden passages, hide in tiny spaces, and use your imagination to outsmart the lurking horrors. Your small size becomes both an advantage and a disadvantage in this heart-pounding adventure. Features: Unique Perspective: Experience the game from the eyes of a toddler, navigating a perilous play area filled with oversized obstacles and toys. Immersive Graphics: Stunning and detailed graphics that bring the miniature world to life, with vibrant colors and realistic physics. Dynamic Play Area: The play area is constantly changing, keeping players on their toes as they adapt to new challenges and obstacles. Obstacle Variety: Encounter a wide range of hazards such as towering building blocks, rolling balls and more, each requiring different strategies to overcome. Stealth Gameplay: Evade enemies patrolling the play area, requiring a blend of stealth and agility to avoid detection. Hiding System: Hide under tables, in lockers and more to evade the enemies trying to hunt you down. Do NOT cry: Maintain your happiness by eating chocolates, food and more. The more scared you are, you more chance you have to cry, and that can give up your position easily. Upgradable Abilities: Collect toys or items that enhance your Tricycle's appearance, paint and fix up to roam around your little world with. Story-driven Adventure: Unravel the mystery of the nightmare by discovering clues and progressing through a compelling narrative that unfolds as you navigate the dangerous play areas and more. Interactive Environment: Interact with toys and elements in the environment – toss objects to distract enemies, hide behind furniture, or trigger traps to clear your path. Find candy, food and more to keep you happy and away from crying - which can reveal your position and enemies will known your location. Survival elements with inventory system, hiding system, objectives and toys to help you find your beloved dolls. Find drawing books and pens which you are able to draw on walls and get creative, both to mark locations or for creativity. Fix, maintain, paint and customize your Tricycle to go around it in the world. Enemy That Listens: The enemies can hear your footsteps, your breathing and whenever you step on squeaky toys. Saving Levels System: Save your progress by having a little nap in save zones. Gut Wrecking Moments: Walking on squeaky toys can make noises that the enemy may hear, same as moving crates or knocking over objects. All these things can give away your position. Try to evade them or use them as your advantages. Fix, maintain and customize your Tricycle which you can use to drive around your world. Solve puzzles that require creative thinking and problem-solving skills. or use your time to play around a little with your favorite toys. You can also store your favorite toys in your vehicle's cart for later use. Find crayons which you can use to let out your creativity, on walls. but not everything is sunshine and rainbows .. something deadly awaits. Sometimes you have to navigate through very difficult and tense situations. Something is lurking in the shadows and it wants to stop you from getting your dolls back. Please note this is only Chapter 1: the Prologue of the game. The full game will be coming out soon which will include all chapters.

This is only the Prologue for the survival horror game where you play as a toddler and have to do what it takes in order to survive your horror-ish nightmares of what's real and not. Fix, maintain and customize your Tricycle to roam around your little world with. Run, hide and survive but remember; try not to cry when you are scared.. or the monsters will hear you and get you. Explore your little world with your very own Tricycle which you can use as a vehicle, where you can store your favorite toys, customize your wheels, paint and find collectables to place on your Tricycle. This will be your means of transport. Embark on a spine-chilling journey into the unsettling realms of a child's nightmares as a brave toddler where you must navigate through the eerie corridors and dimly lit playrooms to recover your five beloved toys, all while trying to unravel the mysteries that shroud the facility. Immerse yourself in the innocence of childhood, where every shadow hides a potential nightmare. The world seen through the eyes of a toddler adds a unique layer of vulnerability, intensifying the fear factor. Utilize the unique abilities of a toddler - crawl through hidden passages, hide in tiny spaces, and use your imagination to outsmart the lurking horrors. Your small size becomes both an advantage and a disadvantage in this heart-pounding adventure. Features: Unique Perspective: Experience the game from the eyes of a toddler, navigating a perilous play area filled with oversized obstacles and toys. Immersive Graphics: Stunning and detailed graphics that bring the miniature world to life, with vibrant colors and realistic physics. Dynamic Play Area: The play area is constantly changing, keeping players on their toes as they adapt to new challenges and obstacles. Obstacle Variety: Encounter a wide range of hazards such as towering building blocks, rolling balls and more, each requiring different strategies to overcome. Stealth Gameplay: Evade enemies patrolling the play area, requiring a blend of stealth and agility to avoid detection. Hiding System: Hide under tables, in lockers and more to evade the enemies trying to hunt you down. Do NOT cry: Maintain your happiness by eating chocolates, food and more. The more scared you are, you more chance you have to cry, and that can give up your position easily. Upgradable Abilities: Collect toys or items that enhance your Tricycle's appearance, paint and fix up to roam around your little world with. Story-driven Adventure: Unravel the mystery of the nightmare by discovering clues and progressing through a compelling narrative that unfolds as you navigate the dangerous play areas and more. Interactive Environment: Interact with toys and elements in the environment – toss objects to distract enemies, hide behind furniture, or trigger traps to clear your path. Find candy, food and more to keep you happy and away from crying - which can reveal your position and enemies will known your location. Survival elements with inventory system, hiding system, objectives and toys to help you find your beloved dolls. Find drawing books and pens which you are able to draw on walls and get creative, both to mark locations or for creativity. Fix, maintain, paint and customize your Tricycle to go around it in the world. Enemy That Listens: The enemies can hear your footsteps, your breathing and whenever you step on squeaky toys. Saving Levels System: Save your progress by having a little nap in save zones. Gut Wrecking Moments: Walking on squeaky toys can make noises that the enemy may hear, same as moving crates or knocking over objects. All these things can give away your position. Try to evade them or use them as your advantages. Fix, maintain and customize your Tricycle which you can use to drive around your world. Solve puzzles that require creative thinking and problem-solving skills. or use your time to play around a little with your favorite toys. You can also store your favorite toys in your vehicle's cart for later use. Find crayons which you can use to let out your creativity, on walls. but not everything is sunshine and rainbows .. something deadly awaits. Sometimes you have to navigate through very difficult and tense situations. Something is lurking in the shadows and it wants to stop you from getting your dolls back. Please note this is only Chapter 1: the Prologue of the game. The full game will be coming out soon which will include all chapters.

rows.name: Taking The Cross
rows.short_description: Taking the Cross allows you to control Christian Armies fighting for the holy land, inflict crushing defeats on your enemies and win glory for the faith!
rows.description_html: Taking the Cross is an immersive historical action-adventure game that places you in the heart of the medieval world. You will embark on a perilous journey through the Holy Land, experiencing the challenges, battles, and pivotal moments of this tumultuous era. Engage in epic sieges, strategic warfare, and large battles as as you strive to reclaim sacred territories and achieve glory for your cause. With historically accurate settings, dynamic combat, and a rich narrative, Taking the Cross offers a thrilling blend of strategy, action, and storytelling, allowing players to rewrite history and shape the fate of the Crusades.

rows.short_description: Become the hive mind of a robot ant colony in this free version of Microtopia! Use pheromone trails to create, automate and optimize supply chains for your ants to follow. Collect resources, produce goods, feed your queen, grow your colony and fly out to expand the species!
rows.description_html: Microtopia: Prologue is a free version of Microtopia. In this automation game, you'll manage a colony of robot ants, design a network of transport trails, explore unique environments and expand your settlement. Your goal? To reproduce! Create young queens that will fly out during the nuptial flight to spread out to distant lands. Starting the cycle anew. PROLOGUE CONTENT 5 types of trails, including 2 logic trails 11 different buildings to build 5 kinds of ant castes to produce and interact with 2 islands to explore featuring 2 different biomes
