rows.short_description: Day of the Shell: Prologue is a “one-click, one-turn” tactical rogue-lite. In a shattered and flooded world, travel from island to island with only hope and a revolver, challenging and appeasing the gods.
rows.description_html: Day of the Shell: Prologue is the free version of Day of the Shell. It is a fast-paced tactical roguelite, where each turn is played in a single click. The gods have brought down their wrath on humanity, and only a few remote islands remain. A lonely monster huntress has risen to challenge and appease the gods, traveling through what's left of the world. PROLOGUE FEATURES 1 world, 13 islands to explore 2 weapons: revolver and crossbow 9 blessings and 12 relics to combine 7 runes to permanently improve the Huntress’s passive skills 5 unique enemies

rows.name: Downstairs 2 Nightfall
rows.short_description: Can you unlock the secrets of darkness and find out what happened to your girlfriend in Downstair 2 Nightfall, developed by the dreamers who harbor the mysterious secrets of history? I don't think so...
rows.description_html: Are you ready to step into a world of darkness and fear? “Downstairs 2 Nightfall,” will take you to the peak of suspense, horror and action. This unforgettable adventure begins in the relative calm of a safe house (safehouse) and then continues in an abandoned village where mysterious and frightening events take place behind the fog. Our main character must embark on this dangerous journey to find his missing lover Mary. At every step he will face his fears, uncover the secrets of the dark past and try to survive in the midst of unimaginable events. What begins in a safe house turns into a terrifying and complex labyrinth as the hope of saving Mary pulls him deeper into fear and despair. The game includes a weapon and a flashlight attached to the weapon, dangerous enemies on the map, notes you can read in some places, and bullets you can use for your weapon. In this unique experience: Moments of Suspense : Dangers lurk around dark corners and sudden surprises will keep you on your toes. You'll have to tread carefully and anticipate what awaits around every corner. Action-Packed Encounters : You will have to defend yourself and survive using a variety of weapons and tools. Each encounter will require adrenaline-fueled moments and strategic thinking. Mysterious Story : Discover the mysterious secrets behind Mary's disappearance and uncover the dark events of the past. The story will keep you in constant suspense and each new discovery will make the previous question more complex. Immersive Graphics and Sound Effects : The atmosphere of the game will completely immerse you. With detailed graphics and realistic sound effects, you will feel the moments of fear in your bones. From dark forests to abandoned houses, each location is meticulously designed and will draw you in. Do you dare to face your fears and uncover the darkest secrets? Get ready to descend into the deepest darkness with “Downstairs 2 Nightfall” and embark on a dark and terrifying adventure to save Mary. From the sheltered walls of the safe house to the deserted streets of the village, you must be on your guard at all times to survive. Mary's fate is in your hands.

rows.name: Skeleton Hell
rows.short_description: Skeleton Hell is a cooperative horror game where you and your friends must work together to find your missing organs and reclaim your humanity. Using your skeletal form, you can solve puzzles and collaborate with each other to escape, while avoiding the dangers that lurk within!
rows.description_html: Skeleton Hell is a cooperative horror game that takes place in the depths of a underground sanctum where the player's skeletons have been imprisoned. Players must work together and use their bones in order to find their human organs and reclaim their mortality. In their skeleton state, players are able to employ unique abilities to throw their bones or thow one another in order to solve puzzles and progress through the sanctum! Throw your bones! 🦴 As a skeleton, bones are your currency. Use bones to interact with the envrionment, distract enemies and give other players a helping hand. However you must be careful. Bones are also your livelihood - the more you lose, the closer you will be to death! 🦴 Avoid deadly enemies! 🦑 The skeleton hell is filled with deadly enemies, each with their own behaviours and patterns. Avoid these monterous creatures as you journey through hell - otherwise you might just end up back in the cell you started in! 💀 Find your heart and reclaim your humanity! ♥ In this game, each player must find their heart hidden somewhere in the procedurally generated sanctum. You will have to search every corner of the small dungeon to find a heart - your ticket to the overworld. If you are feeling generous, you can even communicate with your friends and help them find their own hearts (if you are so fortunate to have found your own). You may also sabotage them and lead them into dangeous traps while luring them with the promise of a heart 😈 Once everyone has a heart and is ready to escape, you must quickly ascend to the top of the dungeon before time runs out. Do you have what it takes to survive? Other Gameplay Features Proximity Chat 🗣 Steam Achievements and Leaderboard 🏆 Good Vibez 😎 No limit on player count!💀 (But we only tested the game with 4 players 😅, Your mileage may vary!) Join our community discord! The Triple Calavera team is eager to learn more about how we could improve Skeleton Hell with your ideas! Join our community discord and chat with us about your experience - both the good and the bad!

rows.name: Slapstick Bosses
rows.short_description: A wacky boss fighting game with a charming and unique style, where the only goal is to beat them all! Collect Bits to unlock cool cosmetics! Can you master each boss on their hardest difficultys?
rows.description_html: Slapstick Bosses is a heavily stylized boss fighting game, with a sole focus on gameplay and comedy. Explore the game's wacky world and all the outlandish humor it has to offer. Each boss is completely unique, offering different playstyles throughout. What they do have in common is their 3 difficultys, ranging from challenging yet calm to blood-curdlingly difficult; as well as challenges for each, modified bosses that provide a new way to play each boss. Each boss defeat will earn you more of the game's currecy: Bits , which can be used to buy a plethora of cosmetics. The harder the difficulty, the more bits you'll earn. Cosmetics come in the form of heads. Both swappable and stylish, these bad boys are always worth the price.

rows.name: StarDust
rows.short_description: StarDust is a 3D 'looped' space-shooter where you get use of many different weapons, including lasers, dumbfire and homing missiles. When you go out one side of the looped 3D space, you come into the other!
rows.description_html: StarDust is a game about transgalactic exploration, discovery, battle, and conquest. The game currently only features the single player and multiplayer battle modes, where you find yourself in a three-dimensionally looped 'Singularity' in outer space to fight it out for your freedom. Weapons include lasers, dumbfire and homing missiles, some of which have huge detonations. A future release will include a campaign mode where you explore, discover and take over nearby inhabitable planets. The random planet generator that will be used in campaign mode is currently available to create your own planets in the Planet Generator screen.

rows.name: Too Angry To Die
rows.short_description: Take control of Gideon Rageblade in this action-filled clicker game. Click to destroy endless waves of enemies, face epic bosses, and earn unique drops. Embrace the rage and irony in a quest that proves dying once was just a fluke—he's too angry to die again.
rows.description_html: Ever heard of someone being 'too angry to die'? Meet Gideon Rageblade , the world-renowned warrior whose unbridled rage was legendary. So legendary, in fact, that people believed his fury made him immortal. Turns out, they were wrong. Gideon just died. Oops. But death is just a minor inconvenience for someone like Gideon. Now, in the afterlife, he has a new gig. He's been hired as a lieutenant for Varkul, the Lord of Torment. His mission? Clear out the plague of rebellion from The Dead Lands. Gideon might have died, but his rage lives on. And he's still too angry to die—again. Furious Clicker Action Unleash Gideon's legendary rage with every click as you obliterate endless waves of enemies. Infinite Enemies Battle through countless foes in The Dead Lands, with each wave becoming more challenging and absurd. Epic Boss Battles Take on powerful bosses that appear after you make your presence felt, with the kill requirement doubling each time. Who knew the afterlife had level scaling? Unlock Powerful Perks Give Gideon some extra oomph with temporary perks. They’re like coffee for his rage—short-lived but absolutely game-changing. Loot Drops Galore Earn drops just for playing OR for slaying bosses. From common to rare, these items can be sold on the Steam Marketplace —because even in the afterlife, loot matters.
rows.about_html: Ever heard of someone being 'too angry to die'? Meet Gideon Rageblade , the world-renowned warrior whose unbridled rage was legendary. So legendary, in fact, that people believed his fury made him immortal. Turns out, they were wrong. Gideon just died. Oops. But death is just a minor inconvenience for someone like Gideon. Now, in the afterlife, he has a new gig. He's been hired as a lieutenant for Varkul, the Lord of Torment. His mission? Clear out the plague of rebellion from The Dead Lands. Gideon might have died, but his rage lives on. And he's still too angry to die—again. Furious Clicker Action Unleash Gideon's legendary rage with every click as you obliterate endless waves of enemies. Infinite Enemies Battle through countless foes in The Dead Lands, with each wave becoming more challenging and absurd. Epic Boss Battles Take on powerful bosses that appear after you make your presence felt, with the kill requirement doubling each time. Who knew the afterlife had level scaling? rows.name: Crypto Rush
rows.short_description: This game is a parody created under the influence of the hype of crypto airdrops in clickers. Click on a coin to mine coins, sell coins for other coins, buy video cards to automate mining. Buy chests for mined coins to try to get new types of coins or get it on market or by exchanging with friends.
rows.description_html: This game is a parody created under the influence of the hype of crypto airdrops in clickers. In this game you also need to poke on the screen in anticipation of a reward. Click on a coin to mine coins, sell coins for other coins, buy video cards to automate mining. Buy chests for mined coins to try to get new types of coins or look for them in the community on the trading platform or by exchanging with friends. No blockchain was used in this game. How to play Click on big image of coin to fill hashrate field. As soon as you fill it up you'll get a coin. Exchange this coin In 'Exchange' tab for StableCoin of MainCoin. Buy video card for StableCoins in the 'Farm' tab to automize mining process. Buy chests in the 'Shop' tab to get new Coins to mine. Set coin to mine from your coin collection in the 'Collection' tab. Once you have mined a certain number of coins, a “halving” will occur, so the required hashrate to mine the coin will double. After several 'Halvings' requred hashrate may become too hight, so try to use other coin from your coin collection(each coin has it's own 'Halvings'). You can get coins from the chests in the 'Shop' tab or exchange it with friends/find on market.

rows.name: One's Own Exile
rows.short_description: Follow Sybil in her pursuit for survival, having to sacrifice everything - her culture, her identity, her values - to achieve a single objective: escape from a place that is constantly trying to kill her. A short game about persecution and identity.
rows.description_html: A Short Narrative Experience One's Own Exile was initially developed for a Game Jam competition. It is a short narrative experience that tells the tale of Sybil , an outcast in the region where she lives, which when pursued by the local guards needs to find a way to escape a tragic fate by concealing her identity. The game reflects upon what builds one’s identity, values and memories. How painful it is to sacrifice everything you hold dear, if the purpose is survival? Which one is better: the pain of unceasing struggle or the death that follows failure? Persecution and sacrifice Is it better to die or to live in pain? Sybil was discovered; living hidden isn’t an option anymore. The narrative follows the story of a protagonist who, to escape persecution and the threat of death, needs to take all possible measures to trespass the country’s border. Look for items that can help you in some way; Observe the local customs in order to pass as one of them; Find ways to conceal your identity, whatever the cost may be; Lie, deceive and run away. Do what you must to survive. Face Difficult Decisions Sybil holds items and customs that are precious to her and her culture, and it's up to you to decide how much you want to abandon in pursuit of survival. Depending on how much you observe, and sacrifice, the outcome changes... But is every outcome desirable? Is a price too steep to pay? One's Own Exile features multiple endings, that change according to your decisions and to how much information you obtain during the game. With 8 different endings , see if you can reach the desired conclusion to Sybil's fate.

rows.short_description: A 2D puzzle-platformer where you light your way through the darkness. Play as the Light, exploring an abandoned civilization where you find a suit of armor that seems to have magical properties. Suit up using the powers of the suit to channel your light magic to see what this strange place hides.
rows.description_html: KnightLight is a 2D puzzle platformer where you light your own way through the darkness. You play as the Light, exploring a seemingly abandoned civilization where you find a suit of armor that seems to have some magical properties. Suit up, using the powers of the suit to channel your own light magic to see what (or who) else this strange and beautiful place is hiding. Use the suit to protect you from the dangers of this world, and get out of it when you need to be nimble! It seems that you aren't the only one here, explore to find others who may tell you their stories, as well as the lost signifliers, magic balls of light that seem to take a liking to you. Once you have explored the world to its fullest, activate the speedrun timer to test your knowledge of the world and see how fast you can make it through! Explore an abandoned world Channel your magic to unlock new abilities Find all of lost signifliers Race through the game to improve your speedrun time DIGIPEN BOILERPLATE - for each game This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Plague of Athens VR
rows.short_description: Plague of Athens tells the story of Nikos of Athens, a physician during history’s first recorded pandemic, 429 BCE, who struggles to treat the multitude who fall ill during this world-upending ordeal.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in the gripping saga of Plague of Athens VR, a VR journey that transports you back to the darkest days of the first recorded pandemic in 429 BCE. Step into the sandals of Nikos of Athens, a young physician challenged with treating countless Athenians struck by the plague. As Athens descends into chaos, the VR narrative unfolds through the eyes of Nikos. The dilemmas that Nikos encounters shatter his world view, prompting him to question everything he holds dear. His faith in Apollo, the divine healer, is tested, as is the meaning of his Hippocratic Oath. Winner of the prestigious Reimagine Education Gold Medal, Plague of Athens VR is an immersive journey into a pivotal chapter in human history. Whether you're a history enthusiast, curious about ancient epidemics, or a lover of gripping stories, 'Plague of Athens VR' promises an unforgettable voyage into the past. Now available for Meta Quest, explore a world both ancient and hauntingly relevant to our own times.

rows.name: The Museum of Hauntology
rows.short_description: The Museum of Hauntology stands as a monument to a future that never was. Featuring counterfactual digital artefacts drawn from an alternative 1970s that did not quite happen. The work is intended to prompt contemplation of the recent past and the type of future in which we now find ourselves.
rows.description_html: The Museum of Hauntology is a VR environment in PC VR format. It is a limited sandbox game intended to make the most of the experiential potential of VR. Built with Unity's High Definition Render Pipeline, the Museum attempts to push what's possible, while retaining playability. The Museum features several different 'exhibitions'; each can transport the player to a different location to see where items in the exhibition came from. There's no objective in this game. Just like a real museum; take your time and enjoy your visit. But if you do enjoy a challenge, try to unlock the Music Room by finding the hidden four-digit code.

rows.name: IMPACT
rows.short_description: IMPACT is an immersive sci-fi game set on the Moon. Build and manage a lunar base, generating valuable scientific data along the way. This data is used by the European Space Agency to train a real AI that will eventually land on the Moon.
rows.description_html: IMPACT – Your Journey to the Moon Begins Here! Dive into IMPACT, an immersive sci-fi game that takes you to the Moon. Build and manage your own lunar base, generating valuable scientific data used by the European Space Agency (ESA) to train a real AI that will one day land on the Moon. Experience how your decisions directly influence the future of lunar exploration! Key Features: 🌑 Build Your Lunar Base: Construct a state-of-the-art lunar colony. From solar power plants and living quarters to research labs – plan and build the infrastructure necessary to survive and thrive on the Moon. 🚀 Explore New Technologies: Discover and develop groundbreaking technologies to help you overcome the Moon's harsh conditions. Use these technologies to enhance your base and unlock new opportunities for lunar exploration. 🌌 Overcome Extraterrestrial Challenges: Face the unique challenges of the Moon. Whether it's meteor storms, moonquakes, or other cosmic hazards – you must always stay one step ahead to protect your base and crew. 🔍 Generate Scientific Data: As you build and expand your base, you generate valuable data about the Moon. This data is used by ESA to train an AI that will improve the safety and efficiency of future lunar landings. 🌟 Shape the Future of Lunar Research: Your actions and decisions in IMPACT have direct consequences for real-world space research. Help pave the way for the next generation of space missions and the exploration and colonization of the Moon. 🎮 Unique Gameplay Experience: IMPACT combines challenging gameplay with a deep narrative. Experience the journey of your crew, their triumphs and setbacks, and feel like part of an epic mission. 🛰 Join a Global Community: Connect with players from around the world, share your achievements, and collaborate on the exploration of the Moon. Your contributions can make a real difference! Why Play IMPACT? IMPACT is not just a game – it’s a mission. rows.short_description: Run your retail company in this free prologue version of the game. Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products, meet customer needs, and never let your customers leave the store empty-handed. Hire new workers, expand your store, and enjoy the growth of your retail company.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game [Retail Company Simulator: Prologue is a free prologue version of Retail Company Simulator. In this game, you'll have a limited amount of contracts.] This is a first-person simulation game where you run a retail company. Expand your humble store into a huge retail company. Store Workflow Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products with an in-game computer, unpack the boxes, place the products into your store, and set the prices for your products. Consider the market prices while setting up your product prices in the store for customer satisfaction. Products Please make sure your customers find all their needs in the store. Always expand your product portfolio and satisfy your customers. Shirts, jackets, pants, sweatshirts, dresses, t-shirts, shoes, hats, and more... Be aware of the market prices and purchase more products when they're cheap. Customers Place a sufficient number of checkouts and fitting rooms to reduce the waiting time for customers. Scan products and collect payments whether in cash or with card purchases. Expansions and New Teammates Expand your store and warehouse by leveling up your store and budget. Hire stockers to fill the racks. Purchase more cash registers and hire new cashiers to minimize long queues at the checkouts and to reduce waiting time for customers.

rows.name: Malcatras' Maiden
rows.short_description: MALCATRAS' MAIDEN is a toxic yuri visual novel for adults about trauma, bonds, family, and sisterhood.
rows.description_html: On a particularly isolated estate lies a grand mansion that serves as a haven for poor lost girls taken in as daughters by the benevolent Lady Francesca Malcatras to serve as her esteemed maids in a life of privilege. Yet, as the high expectations and frequent disciplining weigh heavily on the loyalty of the girls, the long-held commandment of the manor is questioned; Are these walls surrounding the paradise truly there to keep her daughters safe from the world? Accept the tender beauty of despair, pain, and love. This is MALMAID . Features: Linear Visual Novel - See the world from the eyes of Liliana Malcatras , a painfully loyal maid, who pledged to serve her Lady to the ends of the earth. A Psychosexual Thriller with a queer and trans cast, consisting of 60,000 words, 4-5 hours of playtime. Doomed Toxic Yuri - Experience how the overlap of sexual tension and physical conflict risks driving the sisters apart. Superpowered Maids , ready to serve their master with their lives as they partake in fierce battles with mystical powers. Lively animated sprites so you can see the puppy girl Panic in real time. An original soundtrack that shifts from dark ambience to breakcore to elevate the atmosphere.

rows.name: Fable Grove
rows.short_description: Experience the addictive joy of a chilled, pixel clicker game where capturing different monsters in varied weather feels as fun as popping bubble wrap. Level up by clicking monsters or passively over time, increasing your chance to encounter rare Shinys that reward you with Steam Marketplace items.
rows.description_html: Dive into a relaxing yet captivating pixel clicker game that brings the satisfaction of popping bubble wrap to the world of monster hunting. In this unique game, you’ll explore different weather conditions to capture a wide variety of monsters. Each type of monster appears in specific weather and zones, adding an element of strategy to your clicking frenzy. Keep your eyes open for Shiny Monsters, as catching one of these will grant you a Steam Marketplace Item to trade with your friends! Collect all of the shinies and achieve Grove Greatness. Capture up to 55 monsters and complete your Monster Log! Click until they are caught and get experience points for each click and catch! Level up over time to increase your chance of seeing elusive shiny monsters. Occasionally you'll spot shiny monsters in the wild! Catch one of these and be rewarded with a Steam Marketplace item. Trade with your friends until you complete your Shiny Monster Log. Not all monsters were created equal. Find Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary monsters - each appearing in different weather and zones. Some even only show up at night time... Five different weather conditions and three zones keeps you on your toes as you try to catch every monster! Each click of a monster increases your leaderboard score which resets every month. Stay in the top 5% of clickers to find 3 exclusive monsters!

This is the highly anticipated successor to the worst game on Playstation from 2019. COOP MODE Try the epic extraction challenge across the world that you probably won't survive. You and your friends have to safely transport a huge golden ball from Morocco to China, while the mafia is trying to steal it from you. TIME ATTACK MODE Become a time champion by getting the best speedster records in the time attack mode. This is where you will use your best precision skills to get the best records. PARTY MODE Ready for more fun? Fight against or with your friends in crazy party modes by using one keyboard! Stop the trucks, rooftop master, obstacles and many more to come! Are you ready for some more racing bros?

rows.name: Unstable Star
rows.short_description: Journey through Proximus-3 as Jaughn (pronounced “John”), and embark on a lighthearted and action-packed journey of redemption, quickly becoming embroiled in an unexpected Rebellion to save the galaxy.
rows.description_html: Journey through the galaxy as the hero Jaughn, which is totally not a respelling of John, and fight your way against the dreaded Intragalactic Coalition! As a former Border Guard for the Intragalactic Coalition, Jaughn quickly becomes embroiled in an unexpected Rebellion to save the galaxy. Join a colorful cast of characters and embark on a lighthearted yet action-packed journey of redemption. Lead the Rebellion into victory! Unstable Star is a galactic arcade-style, third-person space-shooter packed with action, comedy, and galactic salvation. Explore the immersive story: Play as Jaughn and his new-found friends as they fight to stop the Intragalactic Coalition from destroying the galaxy and watch as the action unfolds through colorful cutscenes and in-game dialogue. Fight waves of enemies with upgradeable loadouts: Unlock new weapons and abilities such as phase shift or the laser gun to help defeat enemies and destroy environmental obstacles such as asteroids. Customize your loadout before each level to play to your style, and fight the waves of enemies as they approach your ship. Take down bosses in boss battles: Complete levels and objectives to progress the story to the two boss battles in-game. Uncover who is behind the nefarious plans of the Intragalactic Coalition, and take them down! Break out of jail, join a team, start a rebellion, and call upon the galaxy to prevent its total annihilation before it’s too late! About us: Developed by Heatwave Studio (formerly 25PercentGames), a student game development group based out of Arizona State University that aims to complete and publish one game each year. The game is a completely volunteer effort from an interdisciplinary team of students from across the academic and creative spectrum. We hope you enjoy what we made!

You will find a box once every 90 minutes!                    Opening the box will grant you a pet of a selected rarity with the given chances*: Common          50% Uncommon      32,95% Rare                 10% Epic                  5% Mythic              2% Legendary        0.05% Find your favourite combination! rows.short_description: Greengrocer's is a clicker game where you click vegetables! In Greengrocer's, you click vegetables to gain even more vegetables! For every 3 clicks, you get a new vegetable! You will also receive extra vegetables for the time you spend managing your Greengrocer's.
rows.description_html: Just Updated Join our Discord! Keep up to date with all the latest news, create your own vegetables and make money from them! About the Game Greengrocer's is a clicker game where you click vegetables! Get a random vegetable every 3 hours and grow your collection! Features: Vegetables: Carrot, Potato, Tomato, Lettuce, Cucumber, Broccoli, Spinach, Kale, Bell Pepper, Zucchini, Cauliflower, Pumpkin, Sweet Corn, Radish, Eggplant, Asparagus, Green Beans, Peas, Beetroot, Artichoke, Cabbage, Celery, Leek, Brussels Sprouts, Turnip and even more! Items to grow your collection You might get a Rotten Tomato, Cosmic Cabbage, Legendary Eggplant, and more! A community that's veggies-crazy! Design submission via Discord! That's right! ALL our vegetables are made with community effort and inspiration! You also can join us! :D 100 achievements for 100 clicks! Discover the letters of the achievements one by one, note them down and discover the vegetable password! After all, it's better to eat vegetables than some fruit like bananas... Drop pool chances: Every 3 minutes, you earn a new normal or rotten vegetable! (85% chance) Every 45 minutes, you earn a rare vegetable! (58% chance) Every 2 hours, you get a magical or cosmic vegetable! (34% chance) Every 3 hours, you receive a legendary vegetable! (8% chance) Every 4 hours you receive unknown vegetable! (1/4 000 000 chance) Every 5 hours, you have a chance to receive a SUPERSEXYVEGGIE ! It's a true rarity for your Greengrocer's. The chance to get such wonders is only 1/15,000,000.

rows.name: Dungeon Tycoon: Prologue
rows.short_description: Build your own dungeon and attract heroes from all over the realm in this free version of Dungeon Tycoon. Grow your business by exploiting every facet of your visitors' dungeon exploration experience. Will you be able to keep your evil dungeon business going?
rows.description_html: 🎴 CHECK THE FULL GAME The full game is now out on Steam! About the Game In this free version of Dungeon Tycoon, you have complete freedom to build and manage your own dungeon. You not only design the layout, but choose the best places for whatever traps you decide to use, which monsters you will hire to face the heroes, and what treasures await those skilled enough to claim victory. Dungeon Tycoon is all about capitalizing on every second of every hero's adventure in your mighty dungeon. Game Features Create and design a devious dungeon to give the heroes from across the land an exciting adventure experience. Summon and upgrade powerful creatures to challenge heroes in their pursuit to find the treasures that lay within the dungeon. Research new stuff to unlock new ways of improving your dungeon. Enhance the aesthetics of your dungeon with a variety of different decorative and cosmetic items. Inspect and watch your visitors to see how you can further improve your design. Sell potions and other various aids to your visitors. Prologue Content 14 playable days 4 unique visitor classes with distinct skills 10+ monsters to collect and upgrade 30+ researches to complete 40+ objects and items to unlock 6 unique enchantments to unlock that can spice up the gameplay Procedurally generated quests with over 20+ unique rewards 2 fierce realms to summon monsters from

rows.short_description: Join the community of Phat Phrog Clicker enthusiasts today and become the ultimate cute creature collector! Earn 28 unique Steam inventory skins, dropping every 30 minutes of gameplay. These skins can be traded or sold on the Steam Marketplace. Can you collect them all?
rows.description_html: Welcome to Phat Phrog Clicker, the adorable idle clicker game that will captivate your heart and keep you clicking for more! In Phat Phrog Clicker, every 30 or so minutes you’ll be rewarded with a new, charming Steam inventory creature. rows.name: THROUGH
rows.short_description: Through is a multiplayer arcade hack and slash with social cooperative mechanics in which players face challenges in different dungeons to reach the exit.
rows.description_html: Explore various dungeons, fight powerful enemies and recolect treasures in this exciting online multiplayer game! Will you be able to overcome the dungeons of Through with your friends? Or will you get lost along the way? COOPERATE! Play with your friends to reach the end of each of the proposed levels. The more players, the more fun and laughter! Remember that friendly fire is a reality. DISCOVER! Each level contains different paths and options so you can enjoy them with all the character archetypes available. This allows you and your friends to enjoy different experiences in each level depending on your character choices. BATTLE! Whether you prefer to fight alongside your friends or against them, it's always relaxing to take a few hits (and enjoy a moment of each impact). You just have to open one of the Arenas or try the Battle mode, similar to Adventure but against your companions. SCORE! There are shiny little things scattered throughout the levels for you and your buddies to search like good treasure diggers (dwarven folk approves) and get the best score possible. Remember that if you play in battle mode, your score will depend on how well you compete against your teammates! You will embody one of these adventurers in your next exploration in Through. Each character has their own advantages and disadvantages, so choose carefully! As a fierce dwarf, wield your ax to vanquish foes and fill your rage meter. When full, use one of two special abilities for enhanced resistance or damage. Be cautious, your attacks might hit teammates, but we won't stop you. An agile archer keeps a safe distance from enemies, as long as you have arrows. You can retrieve fired arrows or reload at ammo boxes. His keen senses detect nearby traps, allowing you to warn teammates or let chaos reign. Dressed in a grey robe and hat, the sage wields a fire-sparking staff, channeling years of wisdom to cast fireballs. However, using his magic might accidentally scorch his companions too. A tough dwarf with a shield and hammer leads the charge into battle. He can shield himself from damage and kick to push others away. His special ability creates a protective bubble to prevent damage to himself and allies. The ancient dwarven ruins are now overrun by beasts, who have made this place their home. They won't make it easy for you. You can engage these creatures in combat to defeat them, or try to avoid them, but be careful. They can band together and become a significant threat. In this world, a great danger lurks in the shadows. No one knows where they came from, but one thing is certain: they have been sent to prevent adventurers from succeeding. Play on a variety of team-based PvP maps, where the dark ones must stop the adventurers from completing their quest.

rows.name: Ciggy World
rows.short_description: Ciggy World is a clicker game where you click on a cigarette to earn rewards! In Ciggy World, every click brings you closer to a treasure trove of drops, or butts.
rows.description_html: Ciggy World is a clicker game where you click on a cigarette to earn rewards! In Ciggy World, every click brings you closer to a treasure trove of drops, or butts. Every 3, you'll receive a special ciggy drop, each one crafted by our Devs or by our chain smoking community on Discord. Join us and become part of the Ciggy World family, where every puff is a step towards something amazing! You know what we say at Ciggy World 'one small puff for man, one giant wheez for mankind'. Experience the thrill of Ciggy World, a delightful parody of the classic Ciggy World theme park, brought to you with a twist of nostalgia and a wink to the golden age of big tobacco. Come, hang out, and let's build a world where every click brings a little more smoke into the world.

rows.name: Bleeding Roots
rows.short_description: Bleeding Roots is a free fifteen minute horror game about a man taking care of his plants throughout the seasons.
rows.description_html: Bleeding Roots is a short horror walking simulator taking place throughout the seasons. Water the plants in your garden, learn about them, and grow along them over time. Immerse yourself in a story about loss, grief and obsession. The controls are simple, moving the character through tank controls and reading up on the environment with an interact key. Having gone through some hard times recently, you find solace in tending to your garden. While searching for new books on botanics, you stumble upon one that you haven’t seen before. It is somehow enthralling, almost as if it’s calling you. As you begin reading, it quickly becomes clear that it speaks of alternative ways of taking care of plants. It fills you with a feeling of unease, but… maybe it’ll grow into a new friend.

rows.name: There was something in that room
rows.short_description: Move through the rooms of the lab in this short but replayable horror game. Debug the computers in each room, watch out for errors, and fix sabotages. Make sure you always know where you are... and where other things are.
rows.description_html: Move through the rooms of the lab in this short but replayable horror game. Debug the computers in each room, watch out for errors, and fix sabotages. Make sure you always know where you are... and where other things are. Hey, you can also play sounds in different rooms! Why would they add that feature? There is nothing in that room... STORY The MANF lab has just made a groundbreaking discovery in biology! You don't care, of course, you get paid the same as before. Not much. Your job is easy though, each night you come back to the lab and make sure all the computers work just fine. Easy, right? But things have changed these days. You start hearing sounds, and you start to worry. You heard some guys talking about a security breach... But hey! They added a cool feature where you can play sounds in rooms! So much fun! GAMEPLAY Move through rooms while fixing the computers and make sure you know exactly where everything is at all times. Watch out for sabotages that demand you to fix them immediately, and stay put to concentrate and hear where specific sounds come from. Your contract runs out in just a few days, you aren't going to leave now, are you? FEATURES Minimalist gameplay, with few movement options Computers that you need to check and debug to make sure everything is ok Ability to lure living things away by making sounds in different rooms Sabotages that you must go and deal with immediately Short game, but infinitely replayable

rows.name: Fantasmagorie
rows.short_description: Journey through a distorted theatre held together by the fragile mind of a grieving puppet master. With only a needle and thread, traverse through this world and evade twisted and terrifying creations. Shatter the delusion and unravel the truth behind it all.
rows.description_html: “It’s simple enough to make the puppets move–that’s not what makes them special. You see, when children watch our shows, they believe what they’re seeing is real. To them, the puppets are alive.” Journey through a distorted puppet theatre held together by the fragile mind of a grieving puppet master. Take the stage as Viviette—a music box ballerina who's mysteriously free from the puppet master's control. Danger looms around every corner, filling the workshop, backstage, and stage of this theatre with perilous threats. With only a needle and thread by your side, you must swing, climb, and manipulate objects to progress, all while evading twisted and terrifying puppets along the way. Follow the guidance of a mysterious spirit to uncover fragmented memories from the past, revealing more about the one pulling the strings. Shatter the delusion and uncover the truth behind it all. Fantasmagorie is a free 30 minute narrative game created by a team of students. Uncover the story by exploring 3 levels and encountering 3 bosses along the way. Your download will include the full game experience, with a save system and settings for sound/graphics. STEAMDECK USERS: Please enable Proton Experimental before playing for the game to operate correctly! NOTICE: If your game runs slowly (or slow movement of character) please go to Settings in the Main Menu and turn down the video settings!

rows.name: Reverse: 1999
rows.short_description: Reverse: 1999 is a 20th Century Time-Travel Strategic RPG developed by Bluepoch. As the Timekeeper, the observer of eras, you will embark on a journey across time and space, from the Roaring '20s to the turn of the millennium, uncovering the truth about the 'Storm' and the mystery of the year 1999.
rows.description_html: On the last day of 1999, the 'Storm' fell upon the world. You witnessed an era reversed beneath the rising raindrops. Defying all reasons, what unfolds in front of you is the world of an era long past. As the Timekeeper, observer of eras, you are free to travel through these eras after each 'Storm.' With the aid of Sonetto, a powerful Arcanist and ally from the Foundation, your mission is to travel through eras to where the 'Storm' is most active, find other Arcanists who can sense the coming 'Storm,' and save them from being 'sifted out' of the timeline. ▶▶Stunning Visuals Blending Retro and Modern Aesthetics◀◀ Step into the mysterious alt-history animated by unique visual elements that blend Pop Art, classical oil painting, and more art styles in history. ▶▶A Cinematic Adventure across the 20th Century◀◀ From the Roaring '20s to the turn of the millennium, you will embark on a journey across time and space, and uncover the truth about the 'Storm' and the mystery of the year 1999. ▶▶Full English Voice Acting with Authentic Accents◀◀ Immerse yourself in ages past. Enjoy a story performed by diverse cast of voice actors with British, Italian, French, and other accents. ▶▶Fantastic Arcanists from Different Times and Regions◀◀ People once called them 'mages,' 'wizards,' and 'freaks.' Now they live in uneasy coexistence with regular humans … But who are the Arcanists, really? ▶▶Weave Arcane Incantations to Attain Glorious Victories◀◀ Build your team, cast spells, and use gorgeous arcane skills to defeat your enemies. Begin your exciting adventure through time in this all-new RPG.

rows.name: Haunting Memories
rows.short_description: Haunting Memories is a psychological horror, walking simulator, platforming and puzzle game. You play as a middle aged man that has made a deal with the devil and must now face the consequences. The game takes place in an old mansion with occult themes and a rich story ready to be uncovered.
rows.description_html: Haunting Memories is a psychological horror, walking simulator and platforming game. You play as a middle-aged man struggling with mental health. He is an artist, specializing in oil portraits, but has not gotten any jobs in the last year. He has recently divorced his wife and she has taken their young daughter and moved out of the house, since he can’t take care of himself. His mental health is worsening since he became alone in the big mansion. To deal with his inner “demons”, he tried to seek help in the mansion's library, where the previous owner left a large collection of occult and spiritual books. This put him on a path toward ritualistic sacrifices, contaminating and blurring his memories, and releasing various creatures into his home and mind.

rows.name: NIGHTMARE BREAK
rows.short_description: 'NIGHTMARE BREAK' is a single-player 3D action adventure game that pursues the 'fun of sword fighting action'. Conquer stages filled with powerful enemies and fragmented stories, and aim to escape from the nightmare world.
rows.description_html: 'NIGHTMARE BREAK' is a single-player 3D action adventure game that pursues the 'fun of swordplay action.' Although it consists of only one bleak stage, there are enemies to defeat and fragmented stories to discover. You control a knight wielding a great sword and aim to escape from the nightmare world by clearing the stage. There are no growth elements such as equipment or builds, but you can become stronger by picking up items scattered along the way. Although strong enemies await, there are also checkpoints, so you can enjoy the game with peace of mind. The Nightmare Lore No one knows the lore. The Challenger got two choices. Kill the Nightmare Lord and will be the Lord myself. Or must break this nightmare.

rows.name: Project ZipZap
rows.short_description: Hack and Dash through waves of enemies in Project ZipZap, an isometric, fast-paced, movement game. Chain together dash abilities to blitz through levels and race your way up the global leaderboards. Hone your skills and achieve mastery.
rows.description_html: Freed by the shockwaves of a dangerous threat, you, Project ZZ , have to traverse a cyberpunk world, battle your way through waves of Projects , and face Project E-Dog head on! Features Project ZipZap is a fast-paced, speedrunner friendly, hack and dash game that incentivises skill expression and rewards mastery of game mechanics. Featuring: Fast-paced movement-based combat: Dash to evade, and dash back to destroy. Five hand-crafted levels including an explosive boss battle. Three different dashes, each with special abilities, ultimates and interactions. Achieve mastery by speedrunning levels and getting a high rank during combat. Compete against players and friends on the leaderboards, and stay competitive by racing their ghosts. Project ZipZap was developed as a final year university project over the course of seven months by eleven developers.

Compete against players and friends on the leaderboards, and stay competitive by racing their ghosts. Project ZipZap was developed as a final year university project over the course of seven months by eleven developers.

rows.name: Replikant Chat
rows.short_description: Engage with unique AI characters, each with distinct personalities, in immersive 3D environments. Currently in Early Access, a subscription is required for the full experience. Discover a growing roster of educational, entertaining, gaming, narrative, and creative interactions.
rows.description_html: Embark on a journey into the future of AI-powered conversations with our innovative 3D chatbot experience. Important: We offer a demo version of Replikant Chat. Each month, we provide credits for a brief experience, allowing you to explore the app before deciding on a subscription. A subscription is necessary, as Replikant relies on external AI services like ChatGPT and ElevenLabs. This cost primarily covers those services rather than being a charge from us. AI service prices are decreasing, so this will evolve over time. Steam labels our app’s download button as 'Free to Play,' though we prefer 'Demo' to better reflect the experience. The official category for Replikant Chat is 'Simulation,' not 'Free to Play.' Thank you for your understanding! Unleash the possibilities: User-Friendly Interface: our extraordinary 3D characters, navigating them with ease through an interface as familiar as your favorite streaming service. Connect in real-time with one or more characters, each uniquely crafted with rich personalities, expressive voices, and captivating animations that bring them to life. Diverse Content: a vast array of topics, from education and entertainment to quizzes, relationships, comedy, and storytelling—each conversation a new adventure. Immersive Environments: yourself in highly realistic 3D environments, where cinematic camera angles make every interaction feel like a scene from your favorite movie. Witness the magic as real and AI-generated images seamlessly blend within these dynamic 3D stages, enhancing every narrative and communication. Real-Time Interaction: like never before—our characters see you through your webcam and respond to your world in real-time, creating a deeply personal and interactive experience. Multimedia Integration: your world with them—whether it’s documents or images, our characters are ready to access, display, and discuss anything you bring to the table. Stay inspired with regular updates and new characters, ensuring that your journey with us is always fresh, exciting, and full of surprises. Our platform doesn't just offer conversations; it creates immersive, interactive experiences that push the boundaries of AI technology. Whether you're seeking knowledge, entertainment, or a unique way to explore ideas, our 3D chatbot experience opens up a world of possibilities. Embark on this journey where technology meets imagination, and every interaction is an opportunity to learn, be entertained, and explore the vast potential of AI-driven communication.

rows.name: Gavin Tyler's Game Collection
rows.short_description: A collection of classic games made by Gavin Tyler, now for the first time on Steam!
rows.description_html: Gavin Tyler's Game Collection is a collection of old games released by Gavin Tyler. It goes from his earliest work to his newest. Some games are bad, while some games are good. There are 7 games in total! GAMES LIST: - Rage Game: The Game The first game released by Gavin Tyler! Can you finish all levels without dying? - Rage Game: The Game Cancelled Demo A 'polished' version of the original Rage Game: The Game, with one large level! - Room Service A jam game for 'Secret Santa Jam'. You work as a janitor at a sketchy hotel! - Passageways 3D A roguelike horror game about endless passageways. How long can you survive until the comic monsters catch you? - Passageways 3D Dev Version A developer version of Passageways 3D. This is the first time it is being publicly released! - Bus Survivalist Originally made as a joke, Bus Survivalist is a game about trying to withstand a bus ride to school. The catch? It's the elementary bus! - Gavin's Wonderhouse Gavin's Wonderhouse is a parody of the typical mascot horror game. Grab all the birthday cake you can before getting caught by Gavin!

rows.name: Resurrection of Santiago
rows.short_description: Hunt for the notorious and unrelenting outlaw Santiago known for his reign over the dystopian city of Dorai. Endure the dangerous desert pushing your way through GDI officers and marauders as you fight for Caloria’s survival.
rows.description_html: Captain Jase is a bounty hunter who keeps Dorai safe and gives planet Caloria hope as the GDI are fighting in a war protecting Caloria for what little they have left. Your mission is simple, apprehend the dangerous outlaw Santiago: Go from friendly citizens to corrupt individuals as you blast your way through the GDI officers and marauders that roam the desert or that are pitched up around the city. Traverse this compact open world by strafing, sliding, jetpack boosting. . . or maybe just jump in a hover car and drift around with ease, mowing down enemies as they pop up. Whether you’re packing the laser shotgun, hauling the weapon of MASS DESTRUCTION or just strapping your laser handgun. There is no doubt an enemy is equipped to rush you at any moment. Shooting down common enemies will become easier as you become stronger and more skillful. But gaining these skills will come in handy once you are ready to face Santiago. But after what you’ve done to him, he now only sees red. Storyline: Captain Jase and his other bounty-hunting allies are faced with an unrelenting outlaw named Santiago. Once Jase takes action and seems to have come up on top, Santiago returns seeking blood and revenge.

rows.name: Pan Beats
rows.short_description: Cute simple rhythm game! All you have to do is press the falling notes in time with the rhythm! The game can be enjoyed by both sound game beginners and those who are familiar with sound games, with familiar songs and three different difficulty levels. Please try to play this game!
rows.description_html: A simple rhythm game created by a Unity beginner! All you have to do is press the falling notes in time with the rhythm! The initial 43 songs include 'Shining star', 'Cat life', 'SUMMER TRIANGLE' and other free BGM often heard on Youtube, etc. The game has a large volume of songs! The fun of rhythm games is maintained, but the image of a hardcore sound game is given a cute atmosphere, making it easy for even those who have never played a sound game to play along with familiar tunes. Scores are saved for each song, so those who are used to playing sound games can compete with each other for ranking. In addition, since the randomization function of the notes is implemented, the same song can be permanently enjoyed with hundreds or thousands of different patterns of music! There are three difficulty levels for each song: 'Easy,' 'Normal,' and 'Hard,' so both beginners and experienced players can enjoy playing rhythm games at a level that suits their abilities. Whether you are a music game lover or have never played music games before, you should definitely try this game!

rows.name: TobPaCharge
rows.short_description: An anime 2d turn-based fighting game. Fireball away!
rows.description_html: A rock-paper-scissor style turn-based fighting game. Practice with bot or challenge your friend to a duel! In each turn, both players present their option! There are 3 option available which are Charge a charge is requires to be able to do a fireball. Fireball If this hits a charging opponent you win! Block this can negate fireball however.... I lied! there are actually 4 options! Big fireball this requires 3 charges this beats anything except itself. Here is a rock-paper-scissor chart for reference Remember! always charge on first turn! since both players cannot do fireball so there is no need to block. Happy TobPaCharge!

rows.name: GreenBulb
rows.short_description: GreenBulb is a vibrant, single-player jump-and-run game for all ages, where players use skill and dexterity to solve puzzles and tackle challenges across 20 exciting levels. GreenBulb offers a delightful and accessible experience for players of all skill levels.
rows.description_html: GreenBulb is a fun and colorful single-player jump-and-run game where you will be challenged in your skill and dexterity as you solve puzzles and tests of skill across 20 levels. GreenBulb has the ability to ‘convert’ a shape either by delivering a kick or by leaping onto it. Achieving multiple shape conversions without touching the ground will result in higher scores. GreenBulb must battle the Shape Machine, a terrible duplication device that unleashes an unending stream of repetitive forms, devoid of meaning or essence. Only GreenBulb can save the world from this grim fate by transforming these lifeless shapes into objects full of color and joy! Note: Levels 1-8 are free to play, providing a fun and challenging experience at no cost. To access levels beyond Level 8, players can make a one-time purchase of the “Unlock All Levels” item for $2.99 USD, allowing seamless progression through the final Boss Level.

Your reward system inside your brain will be pushed to its limits, you won't be able to stop. Despite difficulty increasing with each passing second. The game offers: 3 difficulty levels! Arcade based gameplay! Fantastic art-style and graphics! Over a hundred of different, randomly chosen level skin schemes! Incredible soundtrack, which perfectly fits in the gameplay and blends with the rest of graphical design.

rows.name: Geometry Dabs - Save the World
rows.short_description: Geometry Dabs, a dangerous drug, has brainwashed countless individuals into becoming mindless slaves for its creator, RopTob. The exact purpose of RopTob's control over these victims remains unclear, but it surely cannot be anything good. Your goal is to rescue these people from RopTob
rows.description_html: Geometry Dabs, a dangerous drug, has brainwashed countless individuals into becoming mindless slaves for its creator, RopTob. The exact purpose of RopTob's control over these victims remains unclear, but it surely cannot be anything good. You play as Mohammed Ja'kalem Al-abdula, the ruler of his own kingdom, Mohammedland. Mohammed cannot stand by and allow people to be brainwashed while he does nothing. He has made it his mission to defeat RopTob and save everyone from the clutches of the Geometry Dabs drug. This story-driven, FPS-focused game features 12 unique levels that form the main campaign. It also includes a 6-level co-op mission where you and someone else play as Mohammed's friends, Todd and Emil. Also includes Arena mode where you battle Geometry Dabs enemies for a max of 20 waves for as long as possible in different maps.

rows.name: NETHER DUNGEONS
rows.short_description: Nether Dungeons is an action-packed dungeon crawler. Battle through procedurally generated dungeons, face relentless enemies, and defeat epic bosses. Customize your hero, wield diverse weapons, and survive intense challenges as you descend into ever-changing, dangerous depths.
rows.description_html: Nether Dungeons is an action-packed dungeon crawler that puts your skills to the test as you fight through procedurally generated dungeons with deadly monsters, powerful bosses, and hidden treasures. Play as Farfadox , or choose from a roster of quirky heroes, each with their own weaknesses and abilities. Your goal is to survive relentless enemies through multiple unique phases, from wimpy minions to high-powered bosses, and ultimately emerge victorious from the depths of the Nether Dungeons. Test your strategies, reflexes and adaptability with a vast array of distinctive weapons, from swords and magic, to guns and explosives, you've got numerous choices to eliminate your enemies! Procedurally Generated Dungeons : No two dungeons are the same. Face new layouts, traps, and enemy encounters with every run. Epic Boss Fights : Take on powerful and uniquely designed bosses that require strategy and skill to defeat. Character Customization : Use the in-game editor to create and customize your own hero, designing your hero exactly how you want! Mascots : Adopt cute pets that follow you through the dungeons, helping you fight enemies and offering unique support abilities. Spell Cards : Acquire unique buffs that grant special abilities or powers, giving you an edge in combat. Hardcore Mode : For those seeking a bigger challenge, Hardcore Mode offers much harder difficulty for the most skilled warriors. Replayability : Procedural generation, diverse heroes, and random loot make every playthrough a new experience. Are you ready to descend into the depths of the Nether Dungeons and face its dangers ahead? The challenge awaits!

rows.name: Twilight Wars
rows.short_description: A team based top-down shooter game. Pick up weapons and fight enemies with allies. Mission-based storyline leads you into this fantasy world.
rows.description_html: A team based top-down shooter game. Pick up weapons and fight enemies with allies. # Features You pick from two sides, Royal knights or Skydow warriors to play as. Eliminate all enemies in the arena to win. Join The-Third-Force as a mercenary if both sides are not for you. When play as a mercenary, eliminate all players including other mercenaries to win. Various types of weapons help you make your own tactics. No repetitive weapon type in this game. Every weapon comes with different special abilities as well to make every battle unique. # Story Mode Addictive and challenging missions in the story mode open up the world of Twilight Wars. Play with AI or your friends to adventure in the post-apocalyptic earth, find out the truth of the catastrophe 700 hundreds years ago.

rows.name: The Little UNI
rows.short_description: The game is a point-and-click adventure game in the form of a story with hand-drawn illustrations. Go on an adventure to the planets with various characters and listen to their stories, and find a new planet for Uni to stay on.
rows.description_html: *The game is a fangame for the Korean vocaloid 'Uni,' and the character and story shown in the game are not related to the official setting The little girl, Uni, who is the main character in The Little UNI, left the planet she was living in after a fight with the 'Rose' and left to find a new planet where she could live. It won’t be easy to leave the planet you have lived throughout your life to find a new planet, but the experience of listening to stories of people living on planets with their own personalities and spending time with them will certainly be wonderful. Listen to the various characters' stories with various hand-drawn illustrations. Between the various planets, people, and stories, please watch what will be Uni’s final decision. Will Uni return to the planet where ‘Rose’ is, or will she find a new planet to settle in?

rows.name: Legacy of Defense - Prologue
rows.short_description: Become the hero of a fantasy world and defend against monsters! 'Legacy of Defense - Prologue' is the intro to the innovative game 'Legacy of Defense' combining side-scrolling action and deck-building. Collect cards, use skills, gain experience, upgrade, and defeat the final boss!
rows.description_html: Full Version About the Game Game Description: Become the hero of a fantasy world and defend against monster invasions! Legacy of Defense - Prologue is an innovative defense game that combines side-scrolling action and deck-building elements. In the prologue, you can play the introductory version of Legacy of Defense and earn prologue-exclusive achievements. Key Features: Side-Scrolling Action: Experience intense battles with stunning 2D graphics and intuitive controls. Feel the thrill of defending against waves of incoming monsters. Deck-Building Strategy: Collect various cards to build your own deck. Each card contains powerful skills that require strategic play. rows.name: Canto I
rows.short_description: Face the Dark Forest of the Divine Comedy in this action platformer inspired by the Sommo Poeta’s masterpiece! Help Dante avoid pitfalls, spikes & specters using double jumps, magical attacks and dashes. Find the scrolls containing the triplets of the Canto exploring this gloomy, pixelart forest!
rows.description_html: Midway upon the journey of our life… In Canto I, you take control of Dante, the Sommo Poeta, in a small adventure that reimagines the first canto of the Divine Comedy as a videogame. Finding yourself in the Forest Dark, you’ll need to use all abilities at your disposal to traverse it! Features Spread your wings and overcome every obstacle, bounce on magical books, dash through spike traps and defeat helmet-equipped specters! Fun pixelart style that will get a laugh out of you even when you’ll fall into a pit (there are lots of them) Rebuild the Canto I — Spread around the four levels, scrolls containing the triplets of Canto I hide. Find them all and read the poem in the menu page! Different game modes — play Classic mode for an experience without modifiers, Story mode for a relaxed experience or Hell mode for a real challenge! How to play • Movement: Arrow keys or WASD. • Double jump: Up arrow key or W in the air. • Attack: C, P or Space. • Dash: X or O. • Looking down: Hold the down arrow key or S. Then he moved on, and I behind him followed. Canto I is a personal, small love letter to the platform genre and to the Divine Comedy. Thank you for reading all the way down here and I hope you’ll enjoy the game, if you wanna try it. Have a wonderful day! :D

rows.name: Warmage: Prologue
rows.short_description: Your city is under attack Warmage ! In this grid-based turn-based roguelite, defend the many different districts of your city against waves of enemies with the help of one of your students, and in between, buy and upgrade spells to prepare for the worst.
rows.description_html: Warmage: Prologue is a free version of Warmage. Discover and explore the universe and core gameplay of this tactical roguelite and get a preview of the experience that awaits you in the full game. Warmage: Prologue is a roguelite grid-based turn-based tactical combat game where you play as a young warmage tasked with defending his city against an unknown evil. Features: Play as 3 different archetypes with unique gameplay Varied and refreshing tactical combat After each battle, power up your warmage and buy various attacks and items Choose your next mission on the city map carefully Differents objectives for each battle Over 45 spells and 38 items to combine to create the ultimate warmage Fight Use a wide variety of weapons and spells to defeat waves of ennemies in a turn by turn combat. Various ennemies will challenge you in different ways, think carefully about each movement and each attack as a single error can put you in perilous situations. Upgrade Use the gems collected during the fights to buy new spells, upgrade the ones you already have and buy new items. With each level gained, you can upgrade one of you primary caracteristic which will improve the power of your attacks. Burn them all Now that you have a deadly warmage with powerfull spells, defeat all whom will stand in your way ! Use your environment The surroundings aren't just for show, they can be your greatest ally in escaping deadly situations. Learn to harness them to your advantage ! Defend your city Your city is attacked by an unkown evil. You have to help the citizens, others warmages and important people to survive!

rows.name: Valis: The Fantasm Soldier Collection Launcher
rows.short_description: The legendary action game Valis: The Fantasm Soldier appears on Steam! Please note: This is only the game launcher and does not include the games themselves.
rows.description_html: *'Valis: The Fantasm Soldier Collection Launcher' is a free game launcher that lets you play the Valis series titles. Please note, you need to purchase the Valis games separately. The launcher does not include the games themselves; it is simply a program to run the purchased game ROMs. About Valis The legendary side scrolling action game Valis: The Fantasm Soldier series is making a triumphant appearance on Steam! The highly popular PC Engine versions of Valis: The Fantasm Soldier, Valis II, and Valis III have been fully ported for this collection. Side-Scrolling Action Traditional side-scrolling action. Players will adventure through various levels, battling enemies and bosses using a combination of close combat attacks and magical powers. Storytelling Valis is famous for its strong narrative elements. It combines anime-style cutscenes with the action gameplay to tell the story. Anime Sprite Style The game features vibrant, Japanese anime style sprite graphics and character designs. The visual presentation and animated cutscenes set it apart from many other action games of the 90's. Variety of Weapons and Power-Ups Players can find various weapons and power-ups throughout the stages, allowing them to power-up Yuko's abilities and combat skills. A Popular Game with a Devoted Fanbase Valis: The Fantasm Soldier is a side-scrolling action game originally released by Telenet Japan in 1986. Its unique setting, featuring a heroine in a sailor uniform and bikini armor battling monsters, combined with high-octane action and deep storytelling, won the hearts of many gamers. The Origin of the Bishojo Game Genre The original PC Engine versions were groundbreaking for their time, featuring animation sequences and voice acting. The game's blend of 'moe' appeal, solid action gameplay, and captivating narrative led to it being recognized as a pioneer in the bishojo game genre. Additional Features for Smooth Playthroughs While faithfully preserving the original PC Engine experience, this release adds modern conveniences such as key configuration options and a rewind feature for a smoother gameplay experience on Steam. *To play Valis: The Fantasm Soldier, Valis II, and Valis III, you must purchase the respective DLCs: Valis: The Fantasm Soldier, Valis II, and Valis III. *This title preserves the original content as it was at the time of release. Therefore, we do not take responsibility for any designs, company names, or other elements displayed in the games. *PC Engine and PC Engine logo are trademarks of Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. and BIGLOBE Inc.

Fight alone or alongside your friends. Create massive structures, or keep it simple with just a small house. Are you ready for the Mortal Valley?
rows.description_html: Set foot in the mortal Valley. This sandbox, semi survival fantasy game brings you into a world where you are the ruler. Build entire towns, protect your territory from monsters and level your character. When the night falls, be prepared to meet your foes, or if you're quick enough to build a house you can stay out of their sight. Command over armies and protect your home from goblins. Dig holes into the ground, or place entire plots for your buildings.

rows.name: NokNok
rows.short_description: NokNok is a unique cross-platform open world idle game with elements of self-governance. As a player, you're tasked with earning coins and treasure chests through idle mechanics, which in turn allow you to unlock and upgrade a variety of rare hammers.
rows.description_html: Just Updated Apologize ! After our game was launched, the server was attacked. Since our team consists of only two people and this is our first game, we lack experience in dealing with such attacks. We are currently working on an urgent fix, which is expected to take two days. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. About the Game NokNok: A Cross-Platform Idle Game Welcome to NokNok, a revolutionary cross-platform open world idle game that combines the excitement of autonomous world-building with the ease of idle gaming. As a player, you can earn coins and treasure chests by simply hanging out, and use these rewards to unlock various rare types of hammers. These hammers will help you accelerate your battle power, allowing you to take on and defeat the mighty bosses that stand in your path. Key Features: - Cross-platform gameplay: Play NokNok on any device and platform of your choice. - Open world exploration: Discover and roam in a vast, immersive world at your own pace. - Idle mechanics: Earn coins and treasure chests even while you're away or offline. - Rare hammers: Collect unique hammers from treasure chests to enhance your battle power. - Hammer upgrades: Use your hard-earned coins to level up your hammers and increase their strength. - Epic boss battles: Challenge and defeat powerful bosses to progress through the game. - Self-governance: As you progress, take on the responsibility of governing your own community within the game world. Join the world of NokNok today and start your idle adventure in an open world where your actions shape the society around you!

rows.name: Monkey Mischief
rows.short_description: Monkey Mischief is a online multiplayer VR game that is dependent on the locomotion of your hands. Run to the top of the mountains when lava is rising, fly like a racing car across the map with friends, or run from two twins with tentacles in a underground advanced cave system!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Monkey Mischief. The game that has little bits of everything. There are three game modes, with more to come in the future, that are playable in all three maps! Fly like a high speed racing car across the map with friends, climb mountains to get away from rising lava, or run from two spider-monkey twins with tentacles in a underground advanced cave system! You can even scale multiple trees at once, do backflips on trampolines, or explore the Mischievous Mall, where more then 30 cosmetics are for sale to wear on your physical VR character! Or, you can explore the Horror maps that has three upcoming levels, all scaling higher in atmosphere, and lowering your sanity. No matter what you do, it's ensured you will have fun!

rows.description_html: Orc Wizards have broken your defenses and invaded your gardens! As a humble gardener, you do not have any tools to attack these Orcs. rows.name: Bat Bots
rows.short_description: Enjoy a modern take on timeless arcade action with Bat Bots, a nostalgic shooter inspired by the classics. Take down waves of robotic bats using precise aim and quick reflexes. Engage in solo play, challenge your friends and family, or work together to defend against the oncoming waves.
rows.description_html: Bat Bots is a retro shooter that brings the feel of 80s arcades right to your screen. Stun the Bats Stun the latest prototypes of robotic bats that have escaped into the gloomy forest surrounding your secret lab. Customize Your Player Choose from a variety of crosshair designs and colors. Enter your initials to make your mark on the leaderboard. Stun with Friends and Family NOTE: Local Multiplayer Requires At Least One Controller. Multiplayer is NOT supported with ONLY a Mouse & Keyboard Play with your friends and family as you compete to get the highest score! Or work together to defend your top-secret lab before the Bat Bots escape! Power-Up with Modifiers Enhance your gameplay by shooting the Power Cores dropped by Mod Bats. Once stunned, these cores grant a limited-time modifier that can turn the tide of the game and offer unique advantages in any game mode.

rows.name: UniqKiller: Urban Shooter
rows.short_description: UniqKiller is an intense F2P topdown tactical shooter, PvP, with automatic shooting. Combine different types of bodies, classes, skills, weapons, skins, to create unique heroes, both in appearance and gameplay, for battles in urban environments.
rows.description_html: Tired of the same old shooters? We hear you. In Uniqkiller, you create heroes with distinct appearances, skills, and styles for PvP battles in urban environments! The controls are so simple, that even your grandma could play. But don’t get us wrong – it’s fast, intense, and packed with endless possibilities. Play on PC or mobile, build your own path, and watch your 'Seekers' shine and reach the spotlights. Instead of settling for pre-made characters that need to be unlocked, you customize your operator by combining body type and parts, outfits, combat classes, skills and weapons to create a unique hero. Shape your gameplay and progression path. In Uniqkiller, your choices in creating and improving characters directly impact how you play and grow! With an auto-shooting system and simple, intuitive controls, Uniqkiller is easy to pick up and play. But the depth of customization for your operators, the variety of game modes, the top-down perspective, and tactical combat mechanics push the limits of strategic thinking — challenging players to truly stand out, whether you’re a rookie or a pro. Play with or against your friends. Form alliances or start wars. It’s all about standing out — solo or with your squad. Uniqkiller gives you all the tools to make your mark. To connect with other players and share your experience, join our Discord community. UniqKiller is a free to play cross platform and crossplay (PC and mobile), meaning that you can play whenever you are.

rows.name: NugQuest
rows.short_description: Smoke. Eat. Survive. Play through 4 levels of action packed survival. Search for food and money to maintain your high, and hide yourself from the enemies trying to stop you. Can you beat your high score and unlock the next level?
rows.description_html: Smoke. Eat. Survive. Millennia of evolution have engineered the ultimate super predator. Enter the Stoned Age as a degenerate named Tyler, with the objectives of maintaining your high, keeping your life-threatening munchies at bay, and evading a variety of enemies who wish to mold you to society's constraints. This. Is. NugQuest. Run and hide to avoid enemies, search around the house for food and contraband. Survive as long as possible, and unlock all 4 levels. - What you can expect with the purchase: 4 survival maps to unlock and beat your high score in, a tutorial, original soundtrack and art. Once a map is unlocked by gaining enough points, it is infinitely re-playable.
